This object specifies the configuration for a free-text question in the Amazon Connect evaluation form, defining constraints such as the maximum number of characters allowed for the answer and an optional placeholder text for the answer input field.
Automatically populates the text question's answer from a specified contact attribute, enabling evaluation forms to prefill text responses based on the associated contact's data.
Defines the source (e.g., a contact attribute) that supplies the value for a text question's automated answer in an AWS Connect evaluation form.
Specifies whether the text question's automated answer is sourced from the agent or customer conversation (e.g., AGENT or CUSTOMER), used as part of the automation answer source configuration.
The unique reference identifier for this question, used to programmatically refer to the question when defining outcomes and conditions within the evaluation form.
Specifies the scoring mode (numeric, single-select, or weighted) and, for weighted mode, the weight assigned to the question, controlling how responses contribute to the total evaluation score.
When true, this question is excluded from the overall evaluation score, meaning its response does not contribute to the form's computed score.
Defines the points awarded to an evaluation form question when the agent selects the answer option specified by the option_id, used when scoring is enabled via the parent scoring_configuration.
Indicates whether the question is a bonus question, meaning that its points are added to the total evaluation score when the answer is correct but no points are deducted if the answer is incorrect.
In an Amazon Connect evaluation form, the maximum points assignable to this question, which sets the upper limit of the score a respondent can earn for it.
The lowest numeric score that can be awarded for this question within the evaluation form's points-based scoring configuration.

Defines the automatic scoring thresholds for a question in the evaluation form, where each object contains a threshold value and the associated score label (e.g., 'Excellent') used to classify the question response for scoring.

The upper bound percentage for a single score threshold band, defining the maximum score percentage a response can receive to be classified under that threshold in the evaluation form's question scoring.
Defines the lower-bound score percentage (0-100) for a threshold band used to calculate the score for a Connect evaluation form question.

The name of the performance category (e.g., 'Needs Improvement', 'Meets Expectations') assigned to a score threshold in an AWS Connect evaluation form, used to classify and display agent performance levels.
The display text of the question presented to the agent in the evaluation form, serving as the prompt or title for that question item.
The weight assigned to the question, which determines its relative contribution to the overall evaluation score.
Defines a subsection within a section of an AWS Connect evaluation form, containing its own title, instructions, and nested items, enabling hierarchical grouping of evaluation questions.
The unique reference identifier for a section within an Amazon Connect evaluation form, used to uniquely identify and reference the section from other form items or external systems.

Defines a list of score thresholds for a section, where each threshold maps a numeric score value to a descriptive attribute (e.g., 'Exceeds' or 'Meets') to categorize the section's total score into performance levels.
Defines the minimum score percentage (lower bound) for a score threshold label in a section of the Amazon Connect evaluation form, used to categorize section scores into performance levels.

Specifies the performance category label (e.g., 'Excellent' or 'Needs Improvement') assigned to a score threshold in an AWS Connect evaluation form section, used to identify the category when the section score meets the threshold value.
The heading text of a section within the Amazon Connect evaluation form, used to label that section when presented to evaluators.
The weight assigned to this section, which determines its relative contribution to the overall evaluation score.

aws_connect_evaluation_form.review_confi.text: The type of the review notification recipient (either USER or GROUP) that determines how the recipient ID is interpreted for evaluation form review notifications.
The user ID of an Amazon Connect user designated as a notification recipient in the evaluation form's review configuration, so that user is notified when a review is requested.

aws_connect_evaluation_form.scoring_stra.text: Defines the list of score thresholds for the evaluation form's scoring strategy, where each object contains a numeric threshold and its associated status (such as PASSED, FAILED, or PARTIAL) to categorize the total score.
The maximum percentage score that defines the upper bound of a threshold category within the evaluation form's scoring strategy, used to classify the total score into performance levels.

The minimum percentage of the overall evaluation score that must be achieved to meet this score threshold, which determines the performance level (such as Excellent, Good, Fair, or Poor) assigned to the evaluation result.

The performance category label (such as 'Excellent', 'Good', or 'Poor') that a score threshold in the evaluation form's scoring strategy represents, used to categorize evaluator scores into performance levels.

aws_connect_evaluation_form.tags.key.text: The key of a tag that can be attached to the evaluation form, used to label or categorize the resource.

aws_connect_evaluation_form.tags.value.text: The value part of a user-defined tag assigned to the Amazon Connect evaluation form, used to apply metadata for filtering and resource management.

aws_connect_hours_of_operation.config.da.text: Specifies the day of the week (e.g., MONDAY, TUESDAY) that this hours of operation configuration applies to in the AWS Connect HoursOfOperation resource.

aws_connect_hours_of_operation.config.en.text: The time at which the hours of operation end for a given day, specified as an object with hours and minutes in a 24-hour format.
Specifies the hour (0-23) in 24-hour format at which the operating hours end for the configured day.
The minutes component of the time of day when the hours of operation configuration ends, used together with the end_time hour to define the daily closing time.

aws_connect_hours_of_operation.config.st.text: The start_time field specifies the time in HH:MM format (24-hour) when the hours of operation begin for the configured day.
The hour of the day (0-23) at which the hours of operation configuration starts.
The minute component (0-59) of the start time for a given day's hours of operation configuration in Amazon Connect.

aws_connect_hours_of_operation.hours_of_.text: Specifies the starting timestamp (in ISO 8601 format) from which this hours of operation override takes effect.
Specifies the end date and time (in ISO 8601 format) for which this hours of operation override remains in effect, after which the standard hours of operation schedule applies.

This field provides a unique, user-defined identifier for a specific hours of operation override entry within the hours_of_operation_overrides list, allowing each override to be individually referenced and managed.
The override config defines the alternative schedule of days and times that overrides the default hours of operation during a specified date/time window.
Specifies the day of the week (for example, MONDAY) to which this hours-of-operation override applies.
Specifies the time of day, in 24-hour HH:MM format, when the override hours of operation end for the corresponding day in this override configuration.
Specifies the hour of the day (0-23) in the override's end time, determining when the custom hours of operation override ends.
The minute component (0-59) of the override's end time, specifying the minute at which this hours of operation override stops applying.
In an Amazon Connect hours of operation override configuration, the start_time field defines the beginning of an active time interval, specified in 24-hour HH:MM format (e.g., '09:00').
The hour of the day (0-23) when the override start time begins, used in AWS Connect hours of operation overrides.
The minute component (0-59) of the time of day when this hours of operation override starts.
Provides a human-readable description for an hours of operation override, enabling administrators to label special schedules such as holidays or one-off events.
The display name assigned to a specific date override (e.g., a holiday) within an Amazon Connect hours of operation configuration, used to identify the custom schedule for that date.
Indicates the type of override, either HOLIDAY or OVERRIDE, determining how the specific-date hours override the weekly configuration.

Configures the recurrence pattern (e.g., daily, weekly, or monthly interval and specific days) for applying the hours-of-operation override across a repeating schedule defined in the recurrence configuration.
Specifies the months (1-12) during which this hours-of-operation override recurrence pattern is active, used in combination with other recurrence fields to define a monthly scheduling rule.
Defines the days of the month (1-31) on which the hours-of-operation override recurs, used when the recurrence pattern is set to a monthly interval.
Specifies the occurrence(s) of the weekdays within a month (e.g., 1 for first, 2 for second, -1 for last) on which this hours of operation override recurrence applies.
The frequency unit for the recurrence pattern of this override (e.g., daily, weekly, or monthly), defining how often the override schedule repeats.
The number of time units (e.g., weeks or months, based on the recurrence pattern's frequency) between each occurrence of the recurring hours of operation override, such as 2 for every other week.

aws_connect_hours_of_operation.tags.key.text: The key part of a tag for the Amazon Connect hours of operation, used to organize and identify the resource.

aws_connect_hours_of_operation.tags.valu.text: The value part of a tag key-value pair attached to the Amazon Connect hours of operation resource, used for resource categorization and management.

aws_connect_instance.attributes.text: Defines feature configuration flags for the Amazon Connect instance as key-value pairs (e.g., enabling or disabling inbound/outbound calls, contact lens, or auto-resolve best voices).

aws_connect_instance.tags.key.text: The key of a user-defined tag applied to the Amazon Connect instance, used to categorize and manage the resource in AWS.

aws_connect_instance_storage_config.kine.text: Configures an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream as the storage destination, requiring the Firehose stream ARN to be specified.
Defines the Kinesis Data Stream settings (stream ARN and optional encryption) for the storage config when the storage type is set to Kinesis Stream.
Specifies the Kinesis Video Stream configuration for storing Amazon Connect instance data, including the stream ARN and encryption settings.
Specifies the encryption configuration for the Kinesis Video Stream data storage, including the encryption type (KMS) and the KMS key ID used to encrypt the stream.

aws_connect_instance_storage_config.s3_c.text: Configures Amazon S3 as the storage destination for Amazon Connect instance data, specifying the bucket name (and optional prefix) where objects are written.
Specifies the encryption configuration for the S3 bucket, including the AWS KMS key ID used to encrypt data at rest.

aws_connect_integration_association.tags.text: The key of a tag attached to the AWS Connect integration association, used to categorize or identify the resource.

aws_connect_metric.metric_calculation.ca.text: A list of metric filter objects, each specifying a dimension (like QUEUE, AGENT, or CHANNEL) and its accepted values, that determines which data points contribute to the calculated metric component.
Specifies the comparison operator (such as EQUALS or NOT_EQUALS) used to evaluate the boolean condition in the metric filter.
Specifies the string comparison operator (e.g., EQUALS, CONTAINS) used to evaluate the metric filter's string condition against an attribute value in Amazon Connect.

Defines the list of string values that Amazon Connect evaluates against the string condition's operator to determine which metric records match the filter and are included in the calculation component.
The identifier of the metric that this calculation component references as an input to the overall metric calculation.

aws_connect_prompt.tags.key.text: The key of a tag assigned to the AWS Connect prompt, used for identifying and categorizing the prompt resource.

aws_connect_queue.additional_email_addre.text: Specifies the ARN of an additional email address to associate with the Amazon Connect queue, enabling the queue to handle email contacts from multiple addresses.

aws_connect_queue.tags.key.text: The key of a tag assigned to the Amazon Connect queue, used for metadata and resource filtering.

aws_connect_queue.tags.value.text: The value of a tag attached to the Amazon Connect queue.

aws_connect_quick_connect.tags.key.text: The key of a tag attached to the Amazon Connect quick connect resource, used to categorize and organize the resource.

aws_connect_routing_profile.manual_assig.text: Specifies the queue and its contact channel (such as VOICE or CHAT) that manual assignment uses to route contacts, containing the queue ID and channel type.

Specifies the contact channel (VOICE, CHAT, or TASK) for the queue reference in this manual assignment queue configuration, determining which channel the queue handles for manual assignment in the routing profile.
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Amazon Connect queue that is included in the routing profile's manual assignment queue configuration, allowing agents to manually assign contacts to that queue.

aws_connect_routing_profile.media_concur.text: Specifies the contact channel type (e.g., VOICE, CHAT, or TASK) to which the media concurrency limit applies in the Amazon Connect routing profile.
The maximum number of concurrent contacts of the channel (e.g., VOICE, CHAT) that an agent assigned to this routing profile can handle at the same time.

Specifies how contacts from other channels are routed when this channel's concurrency limit is reached, with a `behavior_type` value (`ROUTE_CURRENT_CHANNEL_ONLY` or `ROUTE_ANY_CHANNEL`) controlling whether only the current channel or any channel can be routed to the agent.
Determines whether contacts from other channels are allowed to be routed to the agent while the agent is handling a contact on this media channel, with valid values ALLOW or DENY.

aws_connect_routing_profile.queue_config.text: Specifies the delay in seconds that a contact waits in this queue before the routing profile attempts to route the contact to a lower-priority queue (or to an available agent, if no other queues are configured).
The priority assigned to a specific queue in the routing profile, where lower numbers indicate higher routing priority and contact distribution order.
Specifies the Amazon Connect queue to which this routing profile queue configuration applies, identified by its queue ID or ARN.
Specifies the contact channel (VOICE, CHAT, or TASK) associated with the queue in the routing profile's queue configuration.
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Amazon Connect queue that this routing profile configuration references, identifying the queue to which contacts are routed.

aws_connect_routing_profile.tags.key.text: The user-defined key of a tag that can be attached to an Amazon Connect routing profile to add custom metadata for resource management and categorization.

aws_connect_routing_profile.tags.value.text: The value portion of a tag associated with the AWS Connect routing profile, used for resource metadata and categorization.

aws_connect_rule.actions.assign_sla_acti.text: This object defines the Service Level Agreement (SLA) configuration that is assigned to a case when the Assign SLA action is executed in the Amazon Connect rule.
Specifies the unique identifier of the case field that holds the SLA target date/time value when executing the assign SLA action on a Connect case.
The name of the Service Level Agreement (SLA) to assign to the case when this rule's assign SLA action is executed.
Specifies a list of case field values (field identifier and value pairs) that are applied to the case when the SLA assignment action is triggered.
Specifies the string value for a target field that is set on a case when the AssignSla rule action executes, as part of the case SLA configuration's target field values.
The number of minutes that defines the target service level agreement (SLA) for the case when the assign-sla action is invoked.
This field specifies the time unit for the case SLA's duration in the assigned SLA action, using values such as `HOURS` or `DAYS`.
Determines whether the service level agreement (SLA) is assigned as a custom percentage or based on the queue's existing SLA configuration.

aws_connect_rule.actions.create_case_act.text: Defines the case fields and their assigned values for the case created by this CreateCase action, using each field's identifier and value.
The unique identifier of the Amazon Connect Cases field that the create-case action sets to the specified value.

The value assigned to the case field (keyed by the sibling 'key' property) in an Amazon Connect Cases CreateCase action, which can be a static string or a dynamic contact attribute reference like {{Contact.Attributes.attributeName}}.
Specifies the boolean value to assign to a case field in the CreateCase action of an Amazon Connect rule.
This field holds the numeric value of a case field when creating a case through the create case action of an Amazon Connect rule, used when the field's data type is a number (double).
Set the empty_value block inside a create-case action field's value to signal that the new case's corresponding field should be created with a null/empty value.
The string value to assign to a case field when a Create Case action runs in an Amazon Connect rule.
The ID of the Amazon Connect Cases template that defines the structure of the case created by this rule action.

aws_connect_rule.actions.event_bridge_ac.text: The unique name for this EventBridge action within the Connect rule, used to identify the action when multiple actions are configured.

aws_connect_rule.actions.send_notificati.text: The body text of the notification message sent when the rule triggers, such as the content of an email or chat message for the recipient.
Specifies the MIME type of the notification content (for example, 'text/plain' or 'text/html'), determining how the message body is formatted for recipients of the notification.
Specifies the delivery channel for the notification, such as EMAIL or SMS, in a send-notification action of an AWS Connect rule.
List of Amazon Connect user ARNs to exclude from receiving the notification.
A list of key/value user tag pairs that define an exclusion filter; Amazon Connect excludes users with any of these tags from receiving the notification sent by this SEND_NOTIFICATION action.
Specifies the recipient of the notification sent by this send notification action, allowing you to target users, queues, or a contact in the Amazon Connect contact flow.
The ARNs of Amazon Connect users who should receive the notification when this rule triggers.
Specifies the user tags used to select recipients for the SendNotification action, such that only users matching all provided key-value tag pairs receive the notification.
The subject line for the email notification sent by this action, used when the delivery method is EMAIL.

aws_connect_rule.actions.submit_auto_eva.text: The ARN of the Amazon Connect evaluation form that is automatically submitted for the contact when this rule action triggers.

aws_connect_rule.actions.task_actions.co.text: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Amazon Connect contact flow that the task action invokes to create and initiate the task.

aws_connect_rule.actions.task_actions.de.text: The description of the task to create when this rule is triggered, providing context for the task.

aws_connect_rule.actions.task_actions.na.text: The name of the task that Amazon Connect creates when this rule's task action is invoked.

aws_connect_rule.actions.task_actions.re.text: The references field defines a map of key-value pairs attached to the outbound task action created by the rule, supplying task-specific contextual data (e.g., customer identifiers or case numbers) that the contact flow and agents can utilize.

aws_connect_rule.actions.update_case_act.text: Specifies the list of case fields, each with a field ID and value, to update when the rule action triggers, allowing dynamic updates to Amazon Connect Cases data.
The unique identifier of the Amazon Connect Cases field that the update case action sets to the corresponding value.

Specifies the typed value (e.g., string, number, boolean, or empty) to assign to the case field when the update-case action executes, matching the field's data type in the associated Amazon Connect Cases field.
When an Amazon Connect rule updates a case, this boolean supplies the true/false value to set for the selected case field in the update-case action.
Specifies the double-precision numeric value to assign to a case field in an update-case action within an Amazon Connect rule.
Set to true to clear the case field's value in the update case action, effectively setting it to an empty/null state.
When an Amazon Connect rule executes an update-case action, this field specifies the literal string to assign to the target case field within the fields.value object.

aws_connect_rule.rule_arn.text: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Amazon Connect rule, uniquely identifying it within your AWS account.

aws_connect_rule.tags.key.text: The key of a user-defined tag that can be attached to an Amazon Connect rule to organize and manage the rule within AWS.

aws_connect_rule.tags.value.text: The value part of a key-value tag applied to the Amazon Connect rule, which you can use to organize, identify, and manage the rule alongside other AWS resources.

aws_connect_security_profile.allowed_acc.text: The key of a tag entry in the allowed_access_control_tags map, which specifies a tag key that this security profile is permitted to use for access control.
The value of a tag key that, when present on an AWS Connect resource, grants the user access to that resource according to the tag-based access control rules defined in the security profile.

aws_connect_security_profile.allowed_flo.text: The identifier of an Amazon Connect flow module that this security profile is permitted to use.

aws_connect_security_profile.application.text: Specifies the list of permission keys that define the actions a user with this security profile can perform within the associated application namespace (for example, making outbound calls or managing contacts in the agent application).

Specifies the namespace of an Amazon Connect application (for example, 'amazon_connect') for which the security profile grants functional permissions, effectively limiting access to that application's resources.
Defines the type of application (e.g., Amazon Connect or Contact Lens) that the security profile's permissions apply to within the Applications list.

aws_connect_security_profile.granular_ac.text: Specifies the granular access control settings for the security profile, including the allowed access control tags and whether access is restricted by the agent's hierarchy group.

Specifies the type of access (read, write, or both) that the security profile has to data table entries matching the associated primary attribute value in the AWS Connect granular access control configuration.
The name of the primary attribute (e.g., a contact or customer attribute) whose allowed values are defined in this configuration to restrict access to a data table in Amazon Connect.

The list of primary attribute values (such as queue IDs or other defined attributes) that determine which data records are accessible for the given data table in the security profile's granular access control.

aws_connect_security_profile.tags.key.text: The key part of a user-defined tag assigned to the AWS Connect security profile, used to categorize and manage the resource for cost allocation and access control.

aws_connect_security_profile.tags.value.text: The value of a user-defined tag applied to the Amazon Connect security profile, providing arbitrary metadata for resource categorization and management.

aws_connect_task_template.constraints.in.text: In a task template's constraints, the id object for an invisible field specifies which task template field to hide by referencing the field's name (e.g., a system field name or custom field name) and its type (SYSTEM or CUSTOM).
The name of the task template field that is specified as an invisible field in the constraints of the AWS Connect task template, hiding it from the agent's view.

aws_connect_task_template.constraints.re.text: The identifier of a field that is configured as read-only within the task template's constraints, preventing agents from editing it.
The name of a field in an AWS Connect task template that is configured to be read-only for agents using the template.
Identifies a field defined in the task template that must be completed for the template's required-fields constraint to be satisfied.
The human-readable name of a required field that must be filled in when an agent creates a task from this task template.

aws_connect_task_template.defaults.text: Specifies a list of default field values (each containing a field identifier and a default value) that are automatically applied to tasks created using this task template.

aws_connect_task_template.defaults.defau.text: The default value that is pre-populated for a specific task field when an agent creates a task using this AWS Connect task template.

aws_connect_task_template.defaults.id.text: The unique identifier of the Amazon Connect task template field to which this default value applies.

aws_connect_task_template.defaults.id.na.text: Specifies the name of the field within the task template that the corresponding default value applies to.

aws_connect_task_template.fields.descrip.text: The description of each field in the task template, which is displayed to agents as a hint or instruction for completing that field.

aws_connect_task_template.fields.id.text: The unique string identifier of a field within the Connect task template (e.g., 'email' or 'subject'), used to reference the field in task definitions and constraints.

aws_connect_task_template.fields.id.name.text: The name attribute of the field identifier (Id) that uniquely identifies each field within an AWS Connect task template, used to reference standard or custom task fields.

aws_connect_task_template.fields.single_.text: The list of allowed choices for a task template field whose type is SINGLE_SELECT, defining the selectable options in the AWS Connect interface.

aws_connect_task_template.fields.type.text: The data type of a task template field in an AWS Connect task template, which must be one of the supported AWS Connect field types such as TEXT, NUMBER, or DATE_TIME, determining how the field's value is stored and displayed.

aws_connect_task_template.tags.key.text: The key of a tag that can be assigned to an Amazon Connect task template for resource organization, access control, and cost allocation.

aws_connect_task_template.tags.value.text: The value of a tag key-value pair attached to the Connect task template, used for metadata and resource management.

aws_connect_test_case.tags.key.text: The tag key for a label attached to the AWS Connect test case, where each key identifies a specific tag and must be unique among the resource's tags.

aws_connect_test_case.tags.value.text: The value portion of a key-value tag used to label an AWS Connect test case for resource management and categorization.

aws_connect_traffic_distribution_group.t.text: The value of a user-defined tag key applied to the AWS Connect traffic distribution group, used for metadata and resource organization.

aws_connect_user.after_contact_work_conf.text: Configures a specific after-contact work task for the user, such as AGENT_CALL or AGENT_GREETING, and the duration in seconds allowed for that task.
Sets the after contact work (ACW) mode for the user, with valid values typically DEFAULT to use the default ACW duration or CUSTOM to allow specifying a custom timeout.
The maximum time in seconds an agent is allowed to spend on after-contact work (ACW) before being marked unavailable, as configured for this Amazon Connect user.

Configures the agent-first-callback feature, which determines whether an agent's first interaction after completing after-contact work is a callback from the previous contact, including whether it is enabled and the timeout period.

Specifies the after-contact work mode for the agent first callback configuration, controlling whether the agent takes a callback before completing after-contact work (e.g., AGENT_FIRST_CALLBACK) or completes after-contact work before taking a callback (e.g., CALLBACK_FIRST).
The duration in seconds an agent has to complete after-contact work before the system offers their first callback.
The contact channel (e.g., VOICE, CHAT, or TASK) to which this after-contact-work configuration applies for the user.

aws_connect_user.auto_accept_configs.age.text: Indicates whether the agent will automatically accept the first callback in Amazon Connect.

aws_connect_user.auto_accept_configs.aut.text: When set to true, this Amazon Connect user automatically accepts incoming contacts (such as phone calls) without requiring the agent to manually accept them, as configured by the auto-accept settings.

aws_connect_user.auto_accept_configs.cha.text: The contact channel (e.g., VOICE or CHAT) for which this auto-accept configuration applies, enabling automatic acceptance of incoming contacts on that channel.

aws_connect_user.persistent_connection_c.text: This string indicates which agent communication channel (e.g., CHAT, VOICE, or TASK) the enclosing persistent connection configuration applies to.
When set to true, this enables the persistent chat feature for the Connect user, allowing customers to resume a previous chat session after disconnecting.

aws_connect_user.phone_number_configs.ch.text: The channel (e.g., VOICE or SMS) that this phone number configuration applies to for the Amazon Connect user.

aws_connect_user.phone_number_configs.ph.text: The phone number assigned to the Amazon Connect user, used for desk phone or other non-softphone devices, typically in E.164 format.
Specifies the type of phone for the user's phone configuration, which can be either `SOFT_PHONE` or `DESK_PHONE`.

aws_connect_user.tags.value.text: The value of a tag key attached to the Amazon Connect user, used to manage and categorize the user resource within AWS.

aws_connect_user.user_proficiencies.attr.text: The name of the attribute for a user proficiency in AWS Connect, such as a skill or language, which is paired with an attribute value and proficiency level in the user's proficiency assignments.
The value of the proficiency attribute (e.g., 'English' for the 'Language' attribute) that defines a user's skill level for routing.

aws_connect_user.voice_enhancement_confi.text: Specifies the audio channel (CUSTOMER or AGENT) for this voice enhancement configuration, determining whether the enhancement is applied to the customer's audio or the agent's audio for the Connect user.
Specifies the voice enhancement mode for the Connect user, with 'ENHANCED' enabling enhanced audio processing or 'DISABLED' turning it off.

aws_connect_user_hierarchy_group.tags.ke.text: The key of a tag attached to the Amazon Connect user hierarchy group, forming the key portion of a key-value pair that helps categorize, organize, and manage the resource.

aws_connect_user_hierarchy_group.tags.va.text: The value portion of a tag (key-value pair) attached to the Amazon Connect user hierarchy group.

aws_connect_view.tags.key.text: The key of a single tag assigned to the Amazon Connect view resource.

aws_connect_view.tags.value.text: The value of a tag attached to the AWS Connect view, used to categorize or identify the view for cost allocation and access management.

aws_connect_workspace.media.type.text: Specifies the media channel type (such as PHONE, CHAT, or TASK) that this Amazon Connect workspace configuration supports.

aws_connect_workspace.tags.key.text: Specifies the tag key used to label the Amazon Connect workspace resource.

aws_connect_workspace.theme.dark.text: Configures the dark-mode color scheme and styling for the Amazon Connect agent workspace's user interface.

aws_connect_workspace.theme.dark.palette.text: Defines the color palette for the dark theme of the Amazon Connect workspace, specifying the colors used for the user interface components.
The canvas object within the dark palette defines the color configuration for the main background (canvas) of the Amazon Connect workspace UI when dark mode is active.
Sets the background color of the active (focused) canvas area in the dark theme of the Amazon Connect workspace.
Specifies the background color for container elements in the canvas area of the dark theme in the Amazon Connect agent workspace.
Sets the background color (hex string) of the page region within the canvas area when the Amazon Connect agent workspace is in dark theme.
Configures the color palette for the header section of the Amazon Connect agent workspace when the dark theme is applied, including background and foreground colors.
The background color of the header in the dark theme of the Amazon Connect workspace.
When set to true, this inverts the colors of action buttons in the header of the dark palette theme for the Amazon Connect workspace.
Defines the text color (hex value) used in the header area of the dark theme palette for the Amazon Connect workspace.
Specifies the color (hex value) of the header's text in the dark theme palette when hovered, used in the Amazon Connect workspace theme.
Contains the color configuration for the navigation bar when the Amazon Connect workspace uses the dark theme palette.
Specifies the background color for the navigation area in the dark theme palette of the Amazon Connect Workspace interface.

When set to true, this property inverts the colors used for action elements (such as buttons or icons) in the navigation section of the dark color palette, enhancing their visibility against the dark background.
The color value (e.g., a hex code) for the text displayed in the navigation area when the Amazon Connect agent workspace uses the dark theme.
Specifies the hex color used for active navigation text in the dark palette of an Amazon Connect workspace theme.
Specifies the background color of active text in the navigation section of the dark theme palette for the Amazon Connect workspace UI.
Defines the background color for text in the navigation bar when hovered, within the dark theme palette of the Amazon Connect Workspace.
The color applied to the text of navigation menu items when the user hovers over them, within the dark theme palette of the workspace's UI.
Defines the primary color object for the dark mode palette of an Amazon Connect agent workspace theme, controlling the color of key UI elements such as buttons, links, and selected states.
Specifies the hexadecimal color code used to render the active state (e.g., pressed or selected) of primary UI elements in the dark theme of the Amazon Connect workspace.
The color code for text displayed on top of the primary color in the dark theme palette of the Amazon Connect workspace.

The `theme.dark.palette.primary.default` field defines the default color (as a hexadecimal value) for the primary color in the dark theme palette of an Amazon Connect workspace, which is applied to primary actions like buttons and selection highlights in the agent interface.

aws_connect_workspace.theme.dark.typogra.text: Defines the typography settings (such as font family, size, and weight) for the dark theme of the Amazon Connect workspace, controlling text appearance in that theme.
Specifies the font family used for text in the dark theme of the Amazon Connect workspace UI.

aws_connect_workspace.theme.light.text: Specifies the light mode color theme of the Amazon Connect agent workspace, applying a custom color scheme to the interface when the workspace is displayed in light mode.

aws_connect_workspace.theme.light.palett.text: Defines the color palette for the light theme of an Amazon Connect workspace, specifying UI colors such as background, foreground, and accent tones used in light mode.
The canvas color setting within the light palette of the Amazon Connect workspace theme, which controls the background color of the workspace canvas area.
This string property defines the background color used for the canvas area when it is in an active or selected state within the light theme of an Amazon Connect workspace.
Sets the background color (as a CSS color value, typically a hex code) for the container region of the canvas area when the workspace is displayed in the light theme.

Specifies the background color for the main page within the canvas region of the light theme palette, using a CSS color format (such as hexadecimal or named color), to customize the appearance of the AWS Connect agent workspace.
Defines the color and styling properties for the header section of the Amazon Connect Workspace when the light theme is in use.
Defines the background color (hex string) for the header section of the light theme palette in the Amazon Connect workspace's agent interface theme.
When true, inverts the colors of the action icons (such as minimize, maximize, and close) in the header for the light theme, ensuring they contrast with the header background.
Sets the color value (typically a hex code) used for the header text in the light color palette of the Amazon Connect workspace theme.
Sets the hover-state text color for the header component within the light theme palette of the Amazon Connect agent workspace.
Sets the navigation bar color used in the light color palette of the Amazon Connect agent workspace theme.
Defines the background color of the navigation element in the light theme palette for the Amazon Connect workspace.

When set to true, inverts the colors used for action elements (such as buttons or menu items) in the navigation area of the light theme palette for the Amazon Connect workspace, while false keeps the standard palette colors.
The text color used for navigation elements in the light theme of the Amazon Connect workspace.
Specifies the text color for the active item in the navigation menu within the light theme palette of the Amazon Connect workspace.
Specifies the background color (hex value) applied to text in an active state within the navigation area of the light theme for the Amazon Connect agent workspace.
The background color of the navigation text when hovered, in the light theme's navigation palette of the Amazon Connect workspace.
For the Amazon Connect Workspace's light theme navigation palette, this property defines the text color applied to navigation items when the user hovers over them.
Defines the primary color for the light color palette of the Amazon Connect workspace theme, controlling the main brand accent color applied to agent workspace UI components in light mode.
Specifies the color code (such as '#RRGGBB') for the active state of the primary color in the light theme palette of the Amazon Connect workspace interface.
The contrast text color used for primary-colored UI elements in the light theme palette of the Amazon Connect workspace interface, ensuring text readability against the primary background color.
Specifies the default primary color (as a hex code) for the light theme palette of the Amazon Connect agent workspace.

aws_connect_workspace.theme.light.typogr.text: Specifies the typography settings (such as font family and size) used in the light theme of the Amazon Connect workspace's user interface.
Specifies the font family used for typography in the light theme of the Amazon Connect workspace's UI.
Specifies the default font family applied to text in the light theme typography of the Amazon Connect workspace.

aws_control_tower_enabled_baseline.basel.text: The ARN of the AWS Control Tower baseline to enable for the specified account.
The version of the baseline to enable, used to specify a particular released version of the baseline identified by BaselineIdentifier.

aws_control_tower_enabled_baseline.enabl.text: The unique identifier (Amazon Resource Name) of the enabled baseline, assigned by AWS Control Tower when the baseline is enabled on the target account or organizational unit.

aws_control_tower_enabled_baseline.param.text: A list of parameter key-value pairs that customize the configuration of the enabled baseline when it is applied to an account.
The key (name) of a baseline parameter, used to identify a specific configuration parameter defined for the selected baseline in AWS Control Tower.
The value of a key-value pair supplied as a configuration parameter to the AWS Control Tower baseline being enabled on an account.

aws_control_tower_enabled_baseline.tags.text: Specifies a list of key-value tags to associate with the AWS Control Tower enabled baseline resource, enabling metadata, cost allocation, and access control.

aws_control_tower_enabled_baseline.tags..text: The key of a tag assigned to the AWS Control Tower enabled baseline, used to categorize and identify the resource.

aws_control_tower_enabled_baseline.targe.text: Specifies the ARN of the target AWS account or organizational unit to which the baseline is applied, such as an account ARN or OU ARN.

aws_control_tower_enabled_control.parame.text: The key (name) of a parameter to supply when enabling the AWS Control Tower control, which identifies the specific configuration option being set.
Assigns the value for a Control Tower enabled-control parameter key (e.g., the tag key or allowed region list) that configures the behavior of the control being enabled.

aws_control_tower_enabled_control.tags.k.text: The key of a tag attached to the AWS Control Tower enabled control, enabling you to organize and identify the control with custom metadata.

aws_control_tower_landing_zone.arn.text: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that uniquely identifies this landing zone.

aws_control_tower_landing_zone.drift_sta.text: Indicates the current drift detection status of the landing zone (e.g., DRIFTED, IN_SYNC, NOT_CHECKING), showing whether the landing zone's configuration has deviated from the expected baseline.

aws_control_tower_landing_zone.landing_z.text: The unique identifier (ARN) of the AWS Control Tower landing zone, assigned by AWS when the landing zone is created.

aws_control_tower_landing_zone.latest_av.text: The latest available version of the AWS Control Tower landing zone that you can update to.

aws_control_tower_landing_zone.manifest.text: The manifest is a structured JSON document that defines the landing zone configuration, including the version, governed Regions, organizational structure, and security controls, which AWS Control Tower uses to create or update the landing zone.

aws_control_tower_landing_zone.status.text: The current lifecycle status of the landing zone, such as ACTIVE, FAILED, or PROCESSING.

aws_control_tower_landing_zone.tags.text: The tags to associate with the AWS Control Tower landing zone, enabling cost allocation, access control, and resource identification.

aws_control_tower_landing_zone.tags.key.text: Key of a user-defined tag to apply to the AWS Control Tower landing zone resource.

aws_control_tower_landing_zone.version.text: The version of the AWS Control Tower landing zone to provision (e.g., 3.0 or 3.1), which determines the set of controls and configurations applied.

aws_cur_report_definition.tags.text: Specifies the list of tag key-value pairs to attach to the AWS Cost and Usage Report definition, enabling resource-level identification and management.

aws_cur_report_definition.tags.key.text: The key of a user-defined tag applied to the AWS Cost and Usage Report definition, used for resource categorization and cost allocation tracking.

aws_customer_gateway.customer_gateway_id.text: The unique identifier assigned by AWS to the customer gateway, such as cgw-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8.

aws_customer_gateway.tags.key.text: The key for a tag assigned to the AWS Customer Gateway resource, used for identification and resource management.

aws_customer_gateway.tags.value.text: The value portion of a tag assigned to the customer gateway, used for arbitrary metadata.

aws_customer_profiles_calculated_attribu.text: Specifies the name of a source attribute in the Customer Profiles profile that is used as an input for the calculated attribute expression.
The key of a user-defined tag assigned to the calculated attribute definition, enabling categorization and access control for the resource.

aws_customer_profiles_domain.rule_based_.text: Defines a single matching rule by listing the profile attribute names (e.g., '_account.Phone') that must have identical values across profiles for them to be considered a match.

The current status of the rule-based matching configuration for the Customer Profiles domain, with values ACTIVE (enabled and running), IN_PROGRESS (being enabled or updated), or DISABLED (turned off).

aws_customer_profiles_domain.tags.key.text: The key of a user-defined tag that can be attached to the Amazon Connect Customer Profiles domain.

aws_customer_profiles_domain.tags.value.text: The value of a tag attached to the Amazon Connect Customer Profiles domain, used to assign arbitrary metadata for resource organization and cost allocation.

aws_customer_profiles_domain_object_type.text: The key of a tag attached to the AWS Customer Profiles domain object type, used to organize and identify the resource.

aws_customer_profiles_event_stream.tags..text: The key of a user-defined tag applied to the event stream resource, which is used for metadata organization, cost allocation, and access control within AWS Customer Profiles.
For an AWS Customer Profiles event stream, this is the value component of a tag entry, used to define a custom attribute for the resource.

aws_customer_profiles_event_trigger.even.text: Specifies a list of event trigger dimensions, each defining the object type and matching attribute dimensions (type and values) that together form a condition under which the event trigger fires.
Defines the list of customer profile object attributes, along with their comparison operators and values, used as dimensions to evaluate whether the event trigger conditions are met.

The comparison operator that determines how the referenced object attribute's value is evaluated against the configured values (for example, EQUAL, GREATER_THAN, LESS_THAN, or BETWEEN) in an event trigger condition.
Specifies the name of the profile object attribute (e.g., 'Email' or 'LastName') that the event trigger condition evaluates to determine whether to activate the associated workflow.
The name of the source object type (e.g., Profile or Order) whose field is used as the grouping dimension in the event trigger condition.
The list of attribute values that the object attribute (specified by the parent object_attributes.source field) must equal for the event trigger condition to be satisfied.

Specifies the logical operator (AND or OR) used to combine the event triggers within this condition group in the AWS Customer Profiles event trigger, determining whether all or any of the triggers must match.
Defines the maximum number of times the event trigger can be invoked for a single customer profile within the specified time period.

In an Amazon Customer Profiles event trigger limit period, this value specifies the number of time units (such as days or hours) that define the duration during which the trigger's maximum invocations are constrained.

aws_customer_profiles_event_trigger.tags.text: The tag key component of a key-value pair assigned to the event trigger, identifying the tag's name within the resource's tag set.

aws_customer_profiles_integration.flow_d.text: Defines the Amazon AppFlow flow configuration for the integration, specifying the source, transformation tasks, and trigger settings that govern how customer data is ingested into Amazon Connect Customer Profiles.
Specifies a human-readable description of the AppFlow flow defined in the integration, used to provide context about the data being imported into Amazon Connect Customer Profiles.
The name of the Amazon AppFlow flow that this integration uses to transfer data into Amazon Customer Profiles.
The ARN of the AWS KMS key used to encrypt data flowing through the flow definition in this Customer Profiles integration.

Defines the source connector configuration for the AppFlow flow used by the integration, including connector type, source entity, and any source-specific settings for pulling data into Amazon Connect Customer Profiles.
The name of the AppFlow connector profile that contains the source connection credentials and configuration for the integration flow.
The connector type that identifies the source system for the data flow (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow, or S3) when integrating data into Amazon Connect Customer Profiles.
Configuration for incremental data pulls from the source, specifying the datetime field name (datetime_type_field_name) used to identify new or updated records.
The name of the source field containing a datetime that AppFlow uses as a watermark to identify records for incremental pulls in scheduled flows.

Defines the connector-specific properties (such as the source object or entity name and any relevant filters) that AppFlow uses to read data from the selected source connector within the Customer Profiles integration flow.
Provides the Marketo-specific configuration for the source connector, identifying the Marketo object (such as a lead or contact) from which data is extracted during the integration flow.
The name of the Marketo object (e.g., Lead, Company) from which the integration source connector reads data.
Specifies the configuration for an Amazon S3 source connector, including the bucket name and prefix from which to read data for the integration flow.
Name of the S3 bucket that contains the source data for this flow.
The object key prefix within the S3 bucket that filters which files are ingested as the source for the AppFlow integration.

Contains the Salesforce source connector properties (such as the Salesforce object name) used by the AppFlow-based integration to define what data is pulled from Salesforce into Amazon Connect Customer Profiles.
Indicates whether the Salesforce source connector automatically updates the field mapping to include newly added fields in the source object during subsequent data transfers.
When enabled, the flow includes Salesforce records that have been deleted and moved to the Recycle Bin, so they are processed by the integration.
Name of the Salesforce object (such as an account or contact) that the source flow reads records from.
Specifies the ServiceNow source settings for the flow, including the ServiceNow object name from which data is pulled during the integration.
The ServiceNow object (table) from which data is retrieved as the source for the integration flow.
Specifies the Zendesk source connector properties for the flow, including the Zendesk object (for example, tickets) from which data is extracted.
The name of the Zendesk object (such as Ticket, User, or Group) that the integration flow reads data from when using Zendesk as the source connector.
Specifies the list of data mapping and transformation tasks (e.g., field mapping, filtering, concatenation) that define how source records are processed before being written into Customer Profiles.

Specifies the connector-specific operation (operator) to apply to the source data for this task, mapping each source connector type (e.g., S3, Salesforce) to the operator that defines how data is read or transformed (e.g., PROJECTION, EQUAL_TO) within the flow definition.

Specifies the Marketo-specific connector operator (such as PROJECTION, EQUAL_TO, or BETWEEN) applied to records in this flow task, controlling how source fields are read or transformed before being written to the destination.

Defines the S3-specific operator (e.g., PROJECTION, EQUAL_TO) applied by this flow task when the connector is S3, controlling how records are transformed or filtered in the Customer Profiles integration flow.

Specifies the operator for the Salesforce connector in the flow task, such as PROJECTION, EQUAL_TO, GREATER_THAN, LESS_THAN, or NO_OP, which controls how data is filtered or transformed during the integration.
Specifies the operation (such as PROJECTION, EQUAL_TO, or BETWEEN) that ServiceNow applies to the data in this flow task, used when ServiceNow is the connector in the flow definition.

Specifies the AppFlow connector operator for a Zendesk source or destination in a flow task, defining the comparison/filter condition used when processing records (e.g., PROJECTION, EQUAL_TO, GREATER_THAN, LESS_THAN).
The name of the destination field in the target (e.g., a Customer Profiles profile attribute) where the value from a source field is written, as defined in the task's mapping.
Specifies the list of source fields that a particular AppFlow task in the Customer Profiles integration flow definition operates on, such as fields used in a mapping, filter, or validation task.
A list of key-value pairs that define task-specific properties for each AppFlow task in the flow definition, such as source/destination field mappings and transformation settings.
The key or name of a task property in a flow definition task, used to configure task-specific settings for the AWS Customer Profiles integration (e.g., 'UNIQUE_ID').
The type of AppFlow task to execute in this integration flow, such as Map, Filter, Mask, or Concatenate, determining the operation performed on the source fields.
Determines how and when the integration flow is executed, including the trigger type (such as scheduled or event-based) and associated schedule or event settings.

Specifies the properties specific to the selected trigger type (for instance, schedule expression and timezone for scheduled triggers, or the event-based data pull configuration) that determine when the flow runs within the Customer Profiles integration's flow definition.
Defines the schedule settings for the flow's scheduled trigger, including the schedule expression and timezone that determine when the integration flow runs.
Determines whether the scheduled flow pulls only new or updated records (incremental) or all records (complete) on each scheduled run.
The Unix epoch timestamp (in seconds) that specifies when the scheduled trigger should first start the integration flow, defining the earliest execution time for the scheduled data transfer.
Specifies the numeric Unix timestamp at which the scheduled trigger for this integration flow should stop executing, ending the recurring schedule.
Specifies the cron expression that determines when the integration flow runs on a schedule, used when the trigger type is scheduled in the Customer Profiles integration.
Defines the number of seconds (0-3600) by which the scheduled flow's start time is delayed relative to the schedule expression in the flow's scheduled trigger properties.
The timestamp (in epoch milliseconds) at which the scheduled trigger for this Customer Profiles integration flow is first activated, marking the start of the recurring schedule.
Specifies the timezone in which the scheduled trigger's schedule expression is evaluated, such as 'America/New_York' or 'UTC', for the flow definition in the AWS Customer Profiles integration.
Specifies the type of trigger for the integration flow, such as Scheduled, Event, or OnDemand, which determines when data is ingested from the source into Customer Profiles.

aws_customer_profiles_integration.object.text: The name of an object type in the external source system (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow) that maps to a corresponding Customer Profiles object type name as the value in this map entry.
The `value` field specifies the Customer Profiles object type name that the external source object type (identified by the corresponding `key`) is mapped to in the integration.

aws_customer_profiles_object_type.fields.text: The name of the field in the Customer Profiles object type, which uniquely identifies the field and must be unique among all fields in the object type.

This object defines how a field in the Customer Profiles object type maps to a specific attribute from the source profile data, specifying the source location, target field name, and data content type.

Configures the content type of the object type field, such as STRING, NUMBER, PHONE_NUMBER, or EMAIL_ADDRESS, which determines how the source data is interpreted and validated in Amazon Customer Profiles.
Specifies the name of the source data field (e.g., a customer record attribute) that maps to and populates this profile object type field.
The name of the field in the target Customer Profiles standard schema to which the source data field is mapped.

aws_customer_profiles_object_type.keys.n.text: Specifies the unique name of the key definition, used to map a set of field names that uniquely identify a profile in the object type for search and matching.

aws_customer_profiles_object_type.keys.o.text: Defines a list of object type key definitions for a key name in the object type's keys map, where each definition specifies the field names and standard identifiers used to uniquely identify and link customer profile objects.
Specifies the list of field names that together form the unique key for this Customer Profiles object type.

This field specifies the standard identifiers (such as PROFILE, ACCOUNT_NUMBER, EMAIL_ADDRESS, or PHONE_NUMBER) that classify how the key's field names are used for profile matching and deduplication in AWS Customer Profiles.

aws_customer_profiles_object_type.tags.k.text: The key of a tag assigned to an Amazon Connect Customer Profiles object type, used to categorize and manage the resource for cost allocation and access control.

aws_customer_profiles_object_type.tags.v.text: The value of a tag attached to the AWS Customer Profiles object type, used for metadata and cost allocation.

aws_customer_profiles_recommender.latest.text: Specifies the type of event (such as 'OrderPlaced' or 'ProductViewed') from the customer's profile history that the recommender uses as input for generating recommendations.

Determines the minimum value that an event's associated metric must have for the event to be considered by the Customer Profiles recommender, filtering out events that fall below this numeric threshold.

aws_customer_profiles_recommender.recomm.text: Specifies the type of customer interaction event (for example, a purchase or sign-up) that the recommender uses as an input signal when generating recommendations.
The numeric threshold that an event parameter's value must meet or exceed to be considered relevant for the recommender's analysis.

aws_customer_profiles_recommender.tags.k.text: The key of a user-defined tag assigned to the AWS Customer Profiles recommender, used for resource identification and cost allocation.

aws_customer_profiles_recommender.tags.v.text: The value part of an optional user-defined tag assigned to the Amazon Connect Customer Profiles recommender configuration, used for labeling and metadata such as environment or cost center.

aws_customer_profiles_recommender.traini.text: training_metrics is a computed list of objects, each containing a metric name and numeric value, that summarize the performance of the recommender's machine learning training job in AWS Customer Profiles.
The coverage metric in the recommender's training metrics, indicating the proportion of distinct items from the catalog that appear in at least one recommendation.
The hit rate of the recommender model, representing the percentage of times the model's predicted recommendation matched the actual outcome during training.
The popularity metric value indicates the model's predictive performance on popularity-based next-best-action recommendations within the recommender's training metrics.

The recall metric in the recommender's training metrics indicates the proportion of relevant recommendations that were correctly retrieved out of all relevant items in the training data, providing an evaluation of the recommender model's performance.

aws_customer_profiles_segment_definition.text: The segment_groups object defines the logical grouping of criteria that determine which customer profiles are included in or excluded from the segment, specifying the groups and an include/exclude flag.
Defines the list of segment groups within the segment definition, where each group contains profile attribute conditions used to evaluate and define customer profile membership in the segment.
Defines the list of attribute-based criteria (each with an inclusive/exclusive type and matching values) used to filter profiles within this segment group.

Specifies the calculated attribute conditions for this dimension, where each key is the name of a calculated attribute and the value defines the filter or comparison applied to that attribute's value to include profiles in the segment.

Specifies a map of profile attribute names (e.g., Email, Phone, or custom attributes) to their dimension definitions, which are used to filter or segment customer profiles within the group's dimension criteria.

Specifies the dimension configuration for the account number profile attribute, defining the inclusion/exclusion type (INCLUSIVE or EXCLUSIVE) and the specific account number values used to segment customer profiles.
Defines the data type (e.g., STRING, NUMBER, DATE) for the account_number profile attribute as it is used as a dimension in the segment definition's criteria.
Specifies the list of account number values to match against a customer's profile account number for this segment dimension.

For the 'additional_information' profile attribute within a segment group dimension, this object specifies the dimension (inclusive/exclusive values) or criteria rule (e.g., equals, greater than) that determines how profiles are included or excluded from the segment based on that attribute.
Defines the address-based dimension criteria (such as city, state, country, and postal code) used to filter profiles in this segment definition.
Defines the dimension criteria for the city field within the customer's address profile attribute, specifying whether to include or exclude a set of city values for segment matching.
Determines how the address city attribute is used in the segment, where INCLUSIVE includes profiles with a matching city and EXCLUSIVE excludes profiles with a matching city.
Specifies the list of city values that a profile's address city must match for the profile to be included in the segment.
Configures the address country attribute as a per-profile dimension for the segment, allowing filtering based on the country value of each profile's address.
Specifies whether the address country values defined for this dimension are included (INCLUSIVE) or excluded (EXCLUSIVE) when matching customer profiles in the segment group.
Specifies the list of country values (such as 'US' or 'CA') used by the segment dimension to match against the address country attribute of customer profiles.
Specifies the county of the customer's postal address, used as a profile attribute for segment filtering in AWS Customer Profiles segment definitions.
Defines the data type for the county attribute in a Customer Profiles segment definition, determining how the attribute's values are interpreted during segment evaluation.
Specifies the list of county names to match against a customer's address county when evaluating this segment group dimension of the AWS Customer Profiles segment definition.

Specifies the postal code attribute of a customer's address as a profile dimension in a segment definition, including the matching condition and postal code value used to filter customers for the segment.

Specifies the dimension type (comparison operator) used to evaluate a profile's postal code attribute in the segment definition, such as `IN`, `NOT_IN`, or `CONTAINS`, to determine segment group membership.
The list of postal code values to match against a profile's address postal code attribute when evaluating this segment dimension.
Configures the dimension for the customer's address province, specifying how to match profile provinces against a set of values for inclusion in the segment.
Specifies the list of province (state) values that the profile's address province must match for the segment dimension condition to be true.
This object defines the segment dimension condition based on the customer's address state, such as specifying state values like 'CA' or 'NY' to include or exclude customers in the segment.

Specifies whether the address state attribute condition is inclusive (profiles matching the specified states are included) or exclusive (profiles matching those states are excluded) in the segment definition.
A list of state values used to filter customer profiles by their address.state attribute within a segment dimension.
A map of profile attribute names to their dimension criteria (such as inclusion/exclusion values) used to determine which profiles match in this segment group's dimension.
Defines the billing address attributes of a customer profile (e.g., city, state, postal code, country) used for segment filtering criteria.
Represents the city component of the billing address profile attribute, used as a dimension for defining segment group criteria in a Customer Profiles segment definition.

Specifies the dimension type for the billing address city profile attribute as either PROFILE (using the standard customer profile field) or CALCULATED (using a custom calculated attribute), determining the data source for this segment dimension.
Specifies the list of city names to match against the billing address city attribute when evaluating this profile segment condition.
Configures a dimension condition on the country field of the customer's billing address, specifying whether to include or exclude profiles with certain countries when evaluating the segment.
Specifies the data type (e.g., string or number) of the billing address country attribute, determining how it is evaluated in segment group dimensions.
The list of country values that a profile's billing address country must match (be one of) for the profile to be included in this segment dimension condition.
Defines the segment dimension based on the county of the customer's billing address.
Defines the comparison operator (such as EQUAL or LIKE) applied to the billing address county value when determining whether a profile matches the segment group's dimension criteria.
Specifies the list of county values used to match against the billing address county of customer profiles when evaluating this segment dimension.
Defines the postal code criteria for the billing address dimension in a segment group, allowing profiles to be filtered by matching postal code values or ranges.
Indicates whether profiles with postal codes matching the specified values are included (INCLUSIVE) or excluded (EXCLUSIVE) from the segment group.
Specifies the list of postal code values that the profile's billing address postal code must match for the profile to be included in the segment.
The province field specifies the state or province component of a customer's billing address, used as a dimension for filtering segment groups.

Defines the data type of the billing address province attribute dimension used in the Customer Profiles segment definition, telling the service whether to treat the value as text, number, or date when filtering customers.
Defines a list of province (state/region) values to match against the billing address province attribute of a customer profile, so that profiles with a matching province are included in the segment.

This object configures the dimension condition for the 'state' component of a profile's billing address, allowing segment definitions to filter customers based on the state or province in their billing address.
Determines whether the billing_address.state profile attribute dimension includes or excludes profiles whose state matches, with allowed values INCLUSIVE and EXCLUSIVE.
The list of state values that a profile's billing address state must match for the profile to be included in the segment when this dimension is applied.
Defines the dimension configuration for the customer profile's birth date attribute, enabling segment definitions to filter profiles based on their date of birth.
Specifies the comparison operator used to evaluate a profile's birth date against the configured values, such as BETWEEN for a date range.
Specifies the list of birth date values to match in the segment definition, controlling which customers are included based on their BirthDate profile attribute.
Configures the customer profile's business email address as a profile attribute dimension used for segment filtering, allowing segment definitions to target profiles based on this email field.

For the business email address profile attribute in a Customer Profiles segment definition, this field sets the dimension type (such as EMAIL or STRING) that determines how the attribute's value is interpreted when segment filters are applied.
Defines the list of business email address values to match when filtering customer profiles on the business_email_address profile attribute.
Defines the matching criteria for the 'Business Name' profile attribute within a dimension of a segment definition, used to filter customer profiles by their business name.
For the business_name profile attribute, this value determines whether the attribute is evaluated as a PROFILE or ACCOUNT dimension in the segment definition.
Specifies the list of business name values used to match profiles when the business_name profile attribute serves as a segment dimension, determining which profiles are included in the segment.
Specifies how profiles are matched on their business phone number for this segment, using include/exclude criteria and an inclusive/exclusive dimension type.
Defines the dimension type for the business phone number profile attribute, which should be set to PHONE to treat it as a phone number dimension within the segment group.
Specifies the list of business phone number values used as filter criteria in this dimension to include or exclude customer profiles whose business phone number matches any of the given values.
Specifies the segmentation dimension for the profile's email address attribute, defining the criteria (such as matching values or ranges) used to determine which profiles belong to the segment.
Determines the comparison or matching operation applied to the email address attribute in the segment dimension, such as EXISTS, CONTAINS, or BETWEEN, to filter profiles for segmentation.
Defines the list of email address values used as an inclusion condition for this profile attribute dimension, so profiles whose email address matches any of these values are included in the segment.

Represents the configuration for using the 'FirstName' profile attribute as a dimension in a segment group, defining the condition (e.g., equal, contains, range) that determines which profiles match the segment.
Defines the matching operator for the first_name profile attribute in the segment dimension, such as INCLUSIVE or EXCLUSIVE, to include or exclude profiles based on their first name.
Specifies the list of first-name values that the segment dimension condition matches against a customer's profile to determine segment membership.
Specifies the string dimension for the customer's Gender profile attribute (e.g., matching 'Male' or 'Female' values) within a segment group's dimension criteria.

Defines whether the gender string attribute acts as an inclusive dimension (matching profiles are included in the segment) or an exclusive dimension (matching profiles are excluded) within the segment group's dimensions.
Specifies the list of gender string values (such as 'Male' or 'Female') to match when determining which profiles are included in this segment definition's dimension.

In an AWS Customer Profiles segment definition, this object defines the home phone number dimension, letting you filter which profiles are included in the segment based on matching phone number values (e.g., as an inclusive or exclusive condition).

The values field defines the list of home phone number strings used to match customer profiles in the segment, operating with the associated dimension type (INCLUSIVE or EXCLUSIVE) to include or exclude matching profiles.
Defines the dimension configuration for the customer's last name profile attribute, used to segment profiles based on the LastName field.
Determines the operator or condition type (e.g., 'EXISTS', 'STARTS_WITH', 'BETWEEN') used to evaluate the last_name profile attribute within this segment dimension.
The list of last-name values that a profile's `last_name` attribute must match (exact match against any value in the list) for the profile to be included in the segment dimension.
Defines the mailing-address components (such as city, state, or postal code) used as a dimension for segmenting customer profiles within a segment definition.
Specifies the city portion of the customer's mailing address to be used as a profile attribute dimension in the segment definition.
Determines whether the mailing address city attribute is treated as an ORDINAL (ordered) or DISCRETE (categorical) dimension within the profile attribute dimension for this segment group's criteria.
This field specifies the list of city names used as matching criteria when evaluating a profile's mailing address city in the segment definition's dimension.
Defines the matching condition (such as a set of acceptable countries and the operator to apply) for the country attribute of the mailing address when building a Customer Profiles segment.
Specifies whether the mailing address country attribute is treated as a standard profile attribute or a calculated attribute when used as a segment dimension.

In an AWS Customer Profiles segment definition, this list specifies the allowed country values for the mailing address profile attribute, and a profile is included in the segment only if its mailing address country matches one of these values.
Defines a segment dimension for the county of the profile's mailing address, allowing include/exclude criteria based on county values.

Specifies the data type (such as TEXT) for the county field of the mailing address profile attribute, which controls how the county value is interpreted when used to group customers in a segment definition.
List of county names used to match a profile's mailing address county attribute when evaluating this segment group dimension.

This object defines the segment dimension criteria for the profile's mailing address postal code, specifying whether to include or exclude certain postal code values using the DimensionType and Values attributes.
Specifies the data type (e.g., STRING) of the postal code attribute used for filtering profiles in the segment definition.
The list of postal code values that a profile's mailing address postal code must match for the profile to be included in the segment definition.
Specifies the province/state of the customer's mailing address to be used as a dimensional attribute in the segment definition, enabling segmentation based on this geographic filter.

Specifies the match operator for the mailing address province within a segment dimension, controlling whether profiles whose province matches the given value are included in or excluded from the segment.
Specifies the list of province (state) values that a profile's mailing address province must match for the profile to be included in the segment.
The state or province of the customer's mailing address, used as a dimension within a segment group to filter customer profiles by geographic location.

Specifies the comparison operator (e.g., 'IN', 'EXISTS', 'NOT_IN') used to evaluate the customer's mailing address state against configured values, controlling whether the state matches for segment membership.
Specifies the list of state values (e.g., 'CA', 'NY') used to match profiles against the mailing address state attribute in the segment definition's group dimension rule.

Defines the matching criteria for the profile's middle name attribute within a segment group's dimension, including the dimension type (e.g., STRING), allowed values, and operation used to evaluate profiles.
Specifies whether the middle name attribute dimension is inclusive or exclusive for segment membership, controlling which profiles are included or excluded when the segment is evaluated.

Specifies the list of middle-name values to match against the middle_name profile attribute when evaluating this segment group's dimension, filtering customers based on the configured include/exclude type.
Specifies how to filter profiles by mobile phone number in a segment dimension, using a dimension type (e.g., INCLUSIVE, EXCLUSIVE, CONTAINS, BEGINS_WITH) and a list of values to match.
Defines the dimension type for the mobile phone number profile attribute, using PHONE_NUMBER to indicate the value is treated as a phone number in the segment definition's filtering criteria.
The list of mobile phone numbers to match against a profile's mobile_phone_number attribute for inclusion in the segment.

This object holds the dimension criteria (inclusive/exclusive match on a set of string values) applied to the `party_type_string` profile attribute when evaluating customer profiles for segment membership.
Determines whether the provided party type string values are used to either include or exclude matching profiles from the segment, with accepted values 'INCLUSIVE' or 'EXCLUSIVE'.

Provides a list of string values that the 'party_type_string' profile attribute must match for a profile to be included in the segment, enabling segmentation by party type (e.g., 'Business' or 'Individual').
Defines the segmentation criteria (such as dimension type and matching conditions) applied to the profile's personal email address within the profile attributes of a segment group's dimensions.

Determines how the personal email address profile attribute is interpreted as a dimension in a segment group, specifying its data type so that the correct comparisons and filters are applied when building the segment.
Specifies a list of personal email addresses used as filter values for the personal_email_address profile attribute in the segment dimension.
Specifies the dimension condition for the profile phone number attribute, with fields for the comparison operation and value used to include profiles in the segment.
