aws_kinesis_analytics_application.id.text: The application name, which serves as the unique identifier for this Kinesis Analytics application.

aws_kinesis_analytics_application.inputs.text: Specifies the streaming sources (e.g., Kinesis streams or Kinesis Firehose delivery streams) that the Kinesis Analytics application reads data from, including source stream identifiers and the schema mapping for how records are parsed into in-application streams.

Configures the input parallelism by specifying the number of in-application streams (Count) to create for the input, which controls how Kinesis Data Analytics processes the streaming data concurrently.
Specifies the number of in-application streams to create for the input, controlling how the source data is partitioned for parallel processing within the Kinesis Analytics application.

Configures an optional Lambda function that pre-processes and transforms input records before they are consumed by the Kinesis Analytics application, enabling data cleaning or enrichment on the streaming source.

Defines a Lambda function used to pre-process records in the input stream before Kinesis Analytics reads them, including the function's ARN and the IAM role ARN that Kinesis Analytics assumes to invoke it.
The ARN of the AWS Lambda function that Kinesis Data Analytics invokes to preprocess and transform records in the input stream before they are processed by the application.
The ARN of the IAM role that grants Amazon Kinesis Analytics permission to invoke the specified Lambda function for input preprocessing.

Defines how raw records from the streaming source are parsed into in-application columns, specifying the record format (e.g., CSV or JSON), encoding (e.g., UTF-8), and column definitions including names, types, and optional mapping from source fields.
Defines the list of record columns for the input schema, each specifying the column name, SQL type, and optional mapping to the field in the streaming source data.
Specifies how the column maps to a field in the source record, typically a JSON path (e.g., '$.user_id') for streaming JSON data or a zero-based column position for CSV/TSV inputs.
The name of the column in the in-application stream that maps to a data element in the streaming source record.
Specifies the SQL data type (e.g., INTEGER, VARCHAR, TIMESTAMP) of the column in the input record schema for the Kinesis Analytics application.
Specifies the character encoding of the records in the input stream (for example, UTF-8) that the Kinesis Analytics application uses to parse the input schema.

Defines the record format of incoming source data (e.g., JSON or CSV), including the type and mapping parameters used to parse each record in the input stream before it is processed by the Kinesis Analytics application.

Defines how the raw input record is parsed and mapped to the schema's columns, either via CSV delimiters (record row delimiter and column delimiter) or via a JSON record row path, depending on which mapping parameter type is supplied.
Configures the CSV-specific mapping parameters, such as record column and row delimiters, used to parse the input stream records into the application schema.
Specifies the single character used to separate fields (columns) within each CSV-format record of the input stream for the Kinesis Analytics application.

Specifies the character used to separate rows (records) in the CSV mapping parameter of the record format, such as a newline ('\n'), so that Kinesis Analytics can parse each record from the input data stream.
Defines the JSON mapping parameters used by the Kinesis Analytics application to parse JSON-formatted input records, including the record row path (RecordRowPath).
Specifies the JSONPath expression pointing to the array of records within the incoming JSON payload, which Kinesis Data Analytics uses to extract each data row for mapping.
The record format type for the input stream, specifying whether records are parsed as CSV or JSON.
Configuration for a Kinesis Firehose delivery stream as the application's streaming input source, specifying the delivery stream ARN and the IAM role that Kinesis Analytics assumes to read from it.
The ARN of the Kinesis Firehose delivery stream that supplies the application's input data.
ARN of the IAM role that the Kinesis Analytics application assumes to read records from the referenced Kinesis Firehose delivery stream.
Configures a Kinesis stream as the input source for the Kinesis Analytics application, specifying the stream ARN and the IAM role ARN used to read from the stream.
The ARN of the Kinesis stream that the application reads from for this input.
The IAM role ARN that the Kinesis Analytics application assumes to read records from the associated Kinesis stream.
Specifies a name prefix used to generate the names of in-application streams that Kinesis Analytics creates from the input, and this prefix must be unique within the application.

aws_kinesis_analytics_application_output.text: The name of the Kinesis Analytics application to which this output is attached.
The unique read-only identifier assigned by AWS to this Kinesis Analytics application output, used by Terraform to track the resource.
Defines the output destination and schema for a Kinesis Analytics application, specifying the output name, target (Kinesis stream, Firehose, or Lambda), and the data format.
Specifies the record format (CSV or JSON) used by the Kinesis Analytics application to write output to the destination stream or Firehose.
Specifies whether the output records are formatted as 'JSON' or 'CSV' when written to the configured destination stream or delivery stream.

Configures the Kinesis Firehose delivery stream to which the application output is sent, specifying the delivery stream's ARN and an IAM role ARN that grants Amazon Kinesis Analytics permission to write to it.
The ARN of the Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to which the application output is written.
The ARN of the IAM role that the Kinesis Analytics application assumes to write records to the Kinesis Firehose delivery stream.
Configuration for delivering the application's output to an Amazon Kinesis stream, specifying the destination stream's ARN and the IAM role ARN that grants the application write access to it.
The ARN of the Kinesis stream to which the Kinesis Analytics application delivers its output records.
The ARN of the IAM role that the Kinesis Analytics application assumes in order to write records to the destination Kinesis stream.
Configures the AWS Lambda function as a destination for the application's output, specifying the function's resource ARN and the IAM role ARN that the application assumes to invoke it.
The ARN of the Lambda function to which the Kinesis Analytics application output delivers records.
Specifies the ARN of the IAM role that the Kinesis Analytics application assumes in order to invoke the Lambda function configured as this output.
The name of the application output, which serves as a unique identifier for the output within the Kinesis Analytics application.

aws_kinesis_analytics_application_refere.text: The name of the Kinesis Analytics application to which this reference data source is associated.

The reference_data_source field defines the reference data source for the Kinesis Analytics application, including the table name, the S3 location of the reference data, and the reference schema that maps it to the application's input.
Defines the structure (columns, data types, and encoding) of the reference data source, mapping its attributes for use in SQL queries and join operations.

Defines the list of columns in the reference data source schema for the Kinesis Analytics application reference data source, where each column object specifies the column name, SQL type, and optional mapping.
Specifies the JSONPath expression that maps this record column to the corresponding field in the reference data source's input record.
The name of the column within the reference data source schema, which is used to reference that column in SQL queries against the reference data source.
The SQL data type of the column in the reference data source's record schema, such as VARCHAR(16) or DOUBLE, used to define how the incoming record column is parsed.
Defines the character encoding used for the reference data records, such as 'UTF-8', so that Kinesis Data Analytics can parse the reference data correctly.
Defines the record format for the reference data source, specifying whether records are CSV or JSON and the corresponding mapping parameters.
Specifies the CSV or JSON mapping parameters (such as the record column delimiter for CSV or the record row path for JSON) that define how reference data records are parsed and mapped to columns.
Specifies the CSV-specific mapping parameters (row and column delimiters) used to parse the reference data source records when the record format is set to CSV.
The delimiter character that separates columns in CSV records of the reference data source, such as a comma.
The delimiter character used to separate records in the CSV reference data source, such as a newline (\n).
Specifies the JSON mapping parameters for the reference data source, including the JSON record row path that identifies the root node of the records in the JSON input.
The JSONPath expression that identifies the location of the top-level JSON element containing the data records, typically '$' for the root object, used for mapping reference data source's JSON input.
Specifies the record format type for the reference data source, which must be either 'JSON' or 'CSV' and determines how the reference schema parses incoming records.
Configures the Amazon S3 bucket and file key, along with the IAM role, that provide the reference data source for the Kinesis Analytics application.
The ARN of the S3 bucket that stores the reference data source for the Kinesis Analytics application.
The S3 object key (file name) of the reference data file within the S3 bucket, which is read by the Kinesis Analytics application as reference data.
This field specifies the ARN of the IAM role that Amazon Kinesis Analytics assumes to read the reference data from the S3 bucket defined in the S3ReferenceDataSource.
The name of the in-application reference table that maps to the external reference data source (e.g., an S3 bucket), which you can then reference in your Kinesis Analytics SQL queries.

aws_kinesis_analytics_v2_application.app.text: A unique identifier that names this property group within the application's environment properties, used to reference and retrieve the group's key-value pairs at runtime.
Associates a set of string key-value pairs that make up a property group, which is passed to the Kinesis Analytics application as part of its environment properties for runtime configuration.
Sets the parallelism for a SQL streaming input by specifying the number of in-application streams Kinesis Data Analytics creates to process data.
The number of in-application streams to create from the streaming source, which determines the parallelism of input processing.
Defines an input processing configuration that uses an AWS Lambda function to pre-process records from the streaming source before the SQL application's query analyzes them.
Configures the AWS Lambda function used to preprocess the streaming records for this input, specifying the function's ARN and the IAM role ARN that Kinesis Data Analytics assumes to invoke it.
The ARN of the AWS Lambda function that is used to preprocess records in the input stream before they are processed by the SQL application.
Defines the schema of the streaming input for a SQL application, including column names and types, record encoding (e.g., CSV or JSON), and mapping configuration for how the source data is parsed.
Defines the list of columns that map fields in the streaming input source to named, typed values available to SQL queries in the Kinesis Data Analytics application.
For a Kinesis Analytics SQL application, this field specifies how the record column maps to the source stream data, such as the JSON property name or the zero-based CSV column index.
The name of the column in the in-application input stream, used to reference this field in SQL queries within the Kinesis Data Analytics application.
Specifies the SQL data type (such as INTEGER, VARCHAR, or TIMESTAMP) that the streaming source column is cast to for use in the Kinesis Analytics SQL application's queries.
Specifies the encoding of records in the input stream, such as UTF-8 or BASE64, so the Kinesis Data Analytics application can correctly parse the incoming data.
Specifies the record format (e.g., JSON or CSV) and its mapping parameters used to parse the actual streaming data for the input schema.
Specifies the mapping parameters for the record format, such as the JSON record path or CSV delimiters, used to parse the input records.
Specifies the CSV mapping parameters, including the record row delimiter and record column delimiter, that define how to parse incoming CSV records into the SQL input schema.
The delimiter character or string used to separate columns in each CSV record of the streaming input, such as a comma or pipe, that Kinesis Data Analytics uses to parse the record into fields.
Specifies the delimiter character(s) used to separate rows in the CSV input, such as a newline ('\n') or carriage return/line feed ('\r\n').
Configures JSON record mapping parameters for the input stream, including the record row path that specifies the JSON path to the root element of each record.
Specifies the JSON path (e.g., '$.payload') to the top-level object that contains the record rows in the incoming JSON data, which is used to map JSON records to the input schema columns.
Specifies the record format type for the streaming source input, which must be either CSV or JSON.

Configures a Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream as the streaming source for the SQL application input, specifying the delivery stream's ARN and the IAM role that allows Kinesis Analytics to read from it.
Specifies the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream that serves as the streaming input source for the SQL application in this Kinesis Analytics v2 application.
Configures the input for the SQL application to read from an Amazon Kinesis data stream, specifying the stream's resource ARN and the IAM role ARN that grants access.
The ARN of the Amazon Kinesis data stream that serves as the streaming input source for the SQL application.

Specifies the prefix used to name the in-application stream(s) that Kinesis Data Analytics creates for this input, allowing the SQL application to reference the incoming streaming data via a generated stream name based on this prefix.
The list of security group IDs that the VPC configuration attaches to the VPC endpoint for the Kinesis Analytics application to access resources in the VPC.
Specifies the IDs of the subnets in which the Kinesis Data Analytics application's elastic network interfaces are placed, enabling the application to access resources within the VPC.
Specifies the kind of custom artifact (either 'UDF' for a user-defined function or 'DEPENDENCY_JAR' for a JAR dependency) that is being provided to the Zeppelin application.
Identifies a Maven artifact (by group ID, artifact ID, and version) to be loaded as a custom artifact in the Zeppelin application.

The Maven artifact ID (e.g., the JAR's artifact name) of the custom library to attach to the Zeppelin application as a custom artifact, used with the group ID and version to resolve the artifact from Maven.

The Maven groupId that identifies the organization or project owning the custom artifact (such as a JAR) which Zeppelin will fetch from a Maven repository for the application's custom artifacts configuration.
The version of the Maven artifact referenced for a custom artifact in the Zeppelin application configuration.

Specifies the S3 bucket and object key (and optionally an object version) where the custom artifact, such as a JAR or other dependency, is stored for the Zeppelin application in the Kinesis Analytics Studio notebook.
The ARN of the S3 bucket that stores the custom artifacts (for example, JAR or Python files) used by the Zeppelin application.

The S3 object key (file path/name) within the bucket specified by the parent S3ContentLocation's BucketArn, identifying the custom artifact (e.g., a JAR or notebook) to be used by the Zeppelin application.
The S3 object version ID that identifies a specific version of the custom artifact file (e.g., a Zeppelin notebook) stored in the S3 bucket; if omitted, the latest version of the object is used.

aws_kinesis_analytics_v2_application_clo.text: The name of the Kinesis Data Analytics for Apache Flink application to which this CloudWatch logging option is attached.
Configures the CloudWatch Logs log stream (via its ARN) to which the Kinesis Analytics v2 application sends operational logs and metrics.
The ARN of the CloudWatch log stream that the Kinesis Data Analytics for Apache Flink application writes its diagnostic logs to.

aws_kinesis_analytics_v2_application_out.text: The name of the Kinesis Data Analytics application to which this output is attached.

The unique identifier for the Kinesis Data Analytics v2 application output, computed as a composite of the application name and the output's ID to distinguish multiple outputs on the same application.
Specifies the output destination (Kinesis data stream, Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream, or AWS Lambda function) and the destination schema for the application's SQL results.
Defines the data format (e.g., JSON or CSV) used when Kinesis Data Analytics writes records to the output destination.
Specifies the format type for records written to the output destination, such as 'JSON' or 'CSV', for the Kinesis Data Analytics application output schema.
Configures a Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream as the destination for the application output, including the stream's resource ARN and an IAM role ARN for access.
The ARN of the Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream that the Kinesis Analytics application writes output to.
Configures the application output to write to an Amazon Kinesis data stream by specifying the stream's resource ARN and the IAM role ARN that Kinesis Data Analytics assumes to deliver records.
The ARN of the Kinesis data stream to which the application writes its output.

Specifies the AWS Lambda function destination for the application output, including the Lambda function's ARN (ResourceARN) and the IAM role ARN (RoleARN) that Kinesis Data Analytics assumes to invoke it.
The ARN of the Lambda function that the Kinesis Data Analytics for Apache Flink application writes output to for the stream output destination.
The name of the in-application stream (as defined in your application code) from which this output reads data to send to the destination.

aws_kinesis_analytics_v2_application_ref.text: The name of the Kinesis Data Analytics for Apache Flink application to which the reference data source belongs.

The 'reference_data_source' property defines the reference data source for the Kinesis Data Analytics application, specifying the S3 location and bucket key, the table name, and the reference schema (columns, data types, and mappings) that describe how the application reads the reference data.
The reference schema defines the column names and data types of the reference data source, enabling Kinesis Data Analytics to parse and query the reference data in SQL applications.
Defines the list of columns in the reference data schema, specifying each column's name, SQL type, and mapping to the corresponding field in the source data.
Specifies the mapping from a data element in the reference data source to this column, typically a JSON path (e.g., '$.field') for JSON record formats or a zero-based column index for CSV formats.
Specifies the unique name of a column in the in-application reference data stream schema, which must be a valid SQL identifier.
Specifies the SQL data type of a column in the reference data source schema (e.g., VARCHAR(16), INTEGER, or BIGINT), as used by the SQL application to map incoming reference data records.
Specifies the encoding of records in the reference data source, with UTF-8 being the only supported value.
Specifies the record format (JSON or CSV) used by the reference data source, including the mapping of data elements to the schema columns.
Defines the mapping parameters for the record format, specifying either CSV mapping (delimiters) or JSON mapping (record column path) for the reference data source schema.
Specifies the CSV mapping parameters (including column delimiter and row delimiter) that Kinesis Data Analytics uses to parse reference data source records in CSV format.
Specifies the single-character delimiter (such as a comma) used to separate columns in CSV-formatted reference data records.
Specifies the character or string that separates one row from the next in the CSV reference data, such as a newline, to define how records are parsed.
Defines the JSON mapping parameters, specifically the record row path, that instructs Kinesis Data Analytics how to locate records within a JSON-encoded reference data source payload.
Specifies the JSON path to the root of the array containing the records in the input JSON, such as '$' for the top-level array or '$.data' for a nested field.
Specifies the record format type (such as CSV or JSON) used by the reference data source in the Kinesis Data Analytics application.
Specifies the S3 bucket and object key (and optional IAM role ARN) that contains the reference data for the Kinesis Analytics application.
The ARN of the S3 bucket from which the reference data source is read.
The object key (file name) in the S3 bucket that identifies the reference data file to be loaded by the Kinesis Data Analytics application.
Specifies the name of the in-application table that maps to the reference data source, which can be used in SQL queries within the Kinesis Data Analytics application.

aws_kinesis_firehose_delivery_stream.ama.text: Specifies the configuration for delivering data from the Firehose stream to an Amazon OpenSearch Serverless collection, including the collection endpoint, index name, buffering hints, and authentication details.
Specifies the buffering size (in MB) and interval (in seconds) Kinesis Data Firehose uses before delivering data to the Amazon OpenSearch Serverless destination.
The length of time, in seconds, that Amazon Data Firehose buffers incoming data before delivering it to the Amazon OpenSearch Serverless destination.
Specifies the buffer size in megabytes, ranging from 1 to 100 MB, for incoming data before Amazon Data Firehose delivers it to the OpenSearch Serverless destination.

Defines CloudWatch logging settings (enabled flag, log group name, and log stream name) for the Firehose delivery stream's Amazon OpenSearch Serverless destination, controlling where delivery logs and errors are recorded.
Indicates whether CloudWatch Logs logging is enabled for the Amazon OpenSearch Serverless destination of the Kinesis Firehose delivery stream.
The name of the CloudWatch Logs log group to which Kinesis Data Firehose will deliver its own logs (such as delivery failure logs) for the Amazon OpenSearch Serverless destination.
The name of the CloudWatch Logs log stream used by the Firehose delivery stream to send logs about the Amazon OpenSearch Serverless destination configuration.
Specifies the URL endpoint of the OpenSearch Serverless collection (e.g., https://collection-name.region.aoss.amazonaws.com) that the delivery stream sends data to.
The name of the OpenSearch Serverless index to which Firehose delivers data.
Specifies the data processing configuration (such as Lambda transformation) applied to incoming records before they are delivered to the Amazon OpenSearch Serverless collection.
Whether data processing is enabled for the Amazon OpenSearch Serverless destination's processing configuration.

Specifies the list of data transformation steps (each a processor, typically invoking a Lambda function) that Firehose applies to incoming records before delivering them to the Amazon OpenSearch Serverless destination.

Specifies the key-value configuration parameters for the processor (e.g., Lambda function ARN, number of retries, buffer size) that control the data transformation logic before Firehose delivers to Amazon OpenSearch Serverless.

The name of a processor parameter in the Kinesis Data Firehose transformation pipeline, such as 'LambdaArn' or 'NumberOfRetries', which is used with its corresponding parameter value to configure the processor.

The value assigned to a specific processor parameter (such as the Lambda function ARN or the retry count) within the processing configuration for an Amazon OpenSearch Serverless destination in a Kinesis Firehose delivery stream.

The type of data processor (such as Lambda, RecordDeAggregation, Decompression, or AppendDelimiterToRecord) that Firehose applies to incoming records before delivering them to the Amazon OpenSearch Serverless destination.
Specifies the duration of time (in seconds) during which Kinesis Data Firehose retries to deliver data to the Amazon OpenSearch Serverless destination when the initial attempt fails.
Specifies the number of seconds Kinesis Data Firehose retries delivering data to the OpenSearch Serverless destination after a failure (default is 300).
The ARN of the IAM role that Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose assumes to write data to the Amazon OpenSearch Serverless collection.

Determines which source records are delivered to the S3 backup bucket for the Amazon OpenSearch Serverless destination: 'FailedDocumentsOnly' backs up only documents that fail to index, while 'AllDocuments' backs up all source records.
Defines the S3 bucket and related settings that Firehose uses as both a buffering layer and a backup destination for records that could not be delivered to the Amazon OpenSearch Serverless endpoint.
The ARN of the S3 bucket that Kinesis Data Firehose uses for buffering or backup data before delivering it to the Amazon OpenSearch Serverless destination.

Buffering hints for the S3 destination used by the Amazon OpenSearch Serverless destination configuration, controlling the size (SizeInMBs) and interval (IntervalInSeconds) of incoming data before it is written to S3.

Specifies the number of seconds that Kinesis Data Firehose buffers incoming data to Amazon S3 before delivering a buffered object, used when backing up data from the OpenSearch Serverless destination.
The buffer size in MiB for the S3 configuration of the OpenSearch Serverless destination, causing Firehose to deliver buffered data to S3 once this size threshold is reached.

Specifies CloudWatch logging options for the S3 backup configuration of an Amazon OpenSearch Serverless destination, including whether logging is enabled and the log group and stream names to which Firehose delivery logs are sent.
Indicates whether CloudWatch logging is enabled for the S3 backup configuration associated with the Amazon OpenSearch Serverless destination of the Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream.
The name of the CloudWatch Logs log group where Kinesis Data Firehose delivers error logs for the S3 backup of the Amazon OpenSearch Serverless destination.

The CloudWatch log stream name that the Firehose delivery stream uses to send logs about the S3 backup configuration for the Amazon OpenSearch Serverless destination when CloudWatch logging is enabled.

Specifies the compression format (e.g., UNCOMPRESSED, GZIP, ZIP, SNAPPY) applied to objects written to the S3 backup bucket for the OpenSearch Serverless destination of the Kinesis Firehose delivery stream.

Defines the optional server-side encryption settings (KMS key or no encryption) applied to the backup S3 bucket used by the Firehose delivery stream when its destination is Amazon OpenSearch Serverless.
Specifies the KMS encryption configuration, including the ARN of the AWS KMS key, used to encrypt the S3 backup bucket contents for the Amazon OpenSearch Serverless delivery destination.
The ARN of the AWS KMS key used to encrypt the data in the S3 bucket that backs up or stores failed records for the Amazon OpenSearch Serverless destination of the Firehose delivery stream.
Indicates that no server-side encryption is used for the S3 destination data, and when set, must be the literal value 'NoEncryption'.
The prefix for error output objects that Kinesis Data Firehose writes to the S3 backup bucket when data delivery to Amazon OpenSearch Serverless fails.
The string prefix applied to S3 object keys for the S3 backup configuration of the Amazon OpenSearch Serverless destination, enabling dynamic partitioning by time (e.g., YYYY/MM/DD/HH).
The ARN of the IAM role that Kinesis Data Firehose assumes to write to the S3 bucket used for backup or buffering in the OpenSearch Serverless destination configuration.

Configures the Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) settings, including subnet IDs and security group IDs, that allow the Firehose delivery stream to privately access the Amazon OpenSearch Serverless collection endpoint.

The ARN of the IAM role that grants the Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream permission to access the VPC resources (such as elastic network interfaces) required to deliver data to an Amazon OpenSearch Serverless endpoint in a VPC.

The security group IDs that AWS Kinesis Firehose associates with its elastic network interfaces in your VPC when delivering data to Amazon OpenSearch Serverless, controlling the inbound and outbound traffic allowed to the VPC endpoint.
Specifies the subnet IDs in the customer VPC that the Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream uses for its VPC configuration to access the Amazon OpenSearch Serverless collection.
Specifies the destination configuration for delivering data to Amazon OpenSearch Service, including cluster endpoint, domain ARN, index name, S3 backup configuration, and buffering hints.

Specifies the buffering sizing and interval for the Amazon OpenSearch Service destination, controlling how long and how much incoming data is accumulated before being delivered to the OpenSearch cluster.
Specifies the number of seconds between buffering actions for the Amazon OpenSearch Service destination, controlling how frequently Firehose delivers buffered data to the cluster.
Specifies the size of the buffer (in MBs) that Firehose uses before delivering data to the Amazon OpenSearch Service destination.
Configures CloudWatch Logs logging for the Amazon OpenSearch Service destination, including whether logging is enabled and the log group and log stream names where Firehose delivers error logs.
Whether CloudWatch logging is enabled for the Amazon OpenSearch Service destination of the Kinesis Firehose delivery stream.
The name of the CloudWatch Logs log group where Kinesis Data Firehose delivers operational logs for the Amazon OpenSearch Service destination.
Specifies the CloudWatch Logs log stream name where Kinesis Data Firehose delivers service logs for the Amazon OpenSearch Service destination.
Specifies the cluster endpoint of the Amazon OpenSearch Service destination that Kinesis Data Firehose uses to deliver data, which is mutually exclusive with the domain ARN.
Configures the default document ID format for records delivered to Amazon OpenSearch Service, choosing between Firehose's auto-generated unique ID and omitting the document ID entirely.

Specifies the default document ID format for records indexed into Amazon OpenSearch Service, either letting Firehose generate a unique document ID (FIREHOSE_DEFAULT) or not assigning a document ID (NO_DOCUMENT_ID).
The ARN of the Amazon OpenSearch Service domain to which this Firehose delivery stream sends data.
The name of the Amazon OpenSearch Service index to which Firehose writes incoming data records.

Specifies how often Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose rotates the OpenSearch index name (e.g., NoRotation, OneHour, OneDay, OneWeek, OneMonth), appending a timestamp to the index name to separate data over time.
Specifies whether and how incoming records for the Amazon OpenSearch Service destination are transformed, including Lambda-based data processors and their parameters.
Enables or disables the data processing (e.g., Lambda transformation) for records delivered to the Amazon OpenSearch Service destination.
List of data processors (e.g., AWS Lambda functions) applied to incoming records before they are delivered to the Amazon OpenSearch Service destination.

Defines the list of parameter objects, each with a parameter name and value, that configure the processor (for example, the Lambda function ARN, buffer size, or invocation time) used in the data processing pipeline before records are delivered to the OpenSearch Service destination.

The name of a processor configuration parameter (e.g., `LambdaArn`, `NumberOfRetries`, or `BufferSizeInMBs`) that Firebase uses to define the key in the key-value pair for the processor, such as those used by Lambda or metadata extraction processors in the Firehose delivery stream.

Specifies the value for a processing parameter (e.g., the Lambda function ARN for the Lambda processor, or the number of retries) used by a data transformation processor in the Amazon OpenSearch Service destination of a Firehose delivery stream.

Specifies the type of processor to apply to incoming records (e.g., Lambda, AppendDelimiterToRecord, MetadataExtraction, RecordDeAggregation, or Decompression), determining how Firehose transforms data before delivering it to Amazon OpenSearch Service.
Retry options for the Amazon OpenSearch Service destination, specifying the duration in seconds that Kinesis Data Firehose retries data delivery after an initial failure.
Specifies the duration in seconds that Kinesis Data Firehose retries sending the failed data to the Amazon OpenSearch Service destination before giving up.
The ARN of the IAM role that Kinesis Data Firehose assumes to access the Amazon OpenSearch Service domain and write data to the specified index.
Determines which S3 backup mode to use for the OpenSearch Service destination, such as 'FailedDocumentsOnly' or 'AllDocuments'.

Specifies the S3 bucket configuration (e.g., bucket ARN, prefix, buffering hints, compression) that the Kinesis Firehose stream uses to store records delivered to Amazon OpenSearch Service, required for backup or failed-record handling.
The ARN of the S3 bucket that Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose uses to store backup data or failed delivery records for the Amazon OpenSearch Service destination.
Configures the size (in MB) and interval (in seconds) thresholds that trigger delivery of buffered data to Amazon S3 within the OpenSearch Service destination's S3 configuration.

The number of seconds that Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose buffers incoming data to the S3 bucket before delivering it, as specified in the buffering hints for the S3 configuration of the Amazon OpenSearch Service destination.

Sets the size in megabytes of the buffering hint for the Amazon S3 backup configuration of the OpenSearch Service destination, meaning the maximum amount of data Kinesis Data Firehose accumulates in its internal buffer before writing to S3.

Configures CloudWatch logging for the S3 backup or error-output destination of the Amazon OpenSearch Service delivery stream, enabling you to specify whether logging is enabled and the log group and stream names.
Indicates whether CloudWatch logging is enabled for the S3 backup destination associated with the Amazon OpenSearch Service delivery stream.
The name of the CloudWatch Logs log group where Kinesis Data Firehose delivers logs for the S3 configuration associated with the Amazon OpenSearch Service destination.
The name of the CloudWatch log stream to which Kinesis Data Firehose delivers error logs for the S3 backup destination associated with the Amazon OpenSearch Service destination configuration.
Defines the compression format (such as UNCOMPRESSED, GZIP, ZIP, or SNAPPY) applied to S3 objects written by Firehose for backup or error output from the Amazon OpenSearch Service destination.

Specifies the server-side encryption settings for the S3 bucket used with the Amazon OpenSearch Service destination, including the option to use AWS KMS with a customer-managed key for encrypting the delivered data.
Configures AWS KMS encryption for the S3 staging/backup bucket used by the OpenSearch Service destination, specifying the ARN of the KMS key via its `AWSKMSKeyARN` property.
Specifies the ARN of the AWS KMS key used to encrypt the S3 backup destination for the OpenSearch Service destination of the Kinesis Firehose delivery stream.
When set to 'NoEncryption', disables server-side encryption for the S3 backup destination used by the Amazon OpenSearch Service destination in the Kinesis Firehose delivery stream.
The S3 object key prefix under which records that failed indexing or delivery to the Amazon OpenSearch Service destination are stored.

Specifies the prefix for S3 object key names, enabling you to organize data under a common folder structure and optionally include dynamic partition keys like '!{partitionKeyFromQuery:key}' for data partitioning.
The ARN of the IAM role that Kinesis Data Firehose assumes to access the S3 bucket used for backup or error output described by this s3_configuration block.

The document type name that Kinesis Data Firehose uses when indexing records into the Amazon OpenSearch Service destination, which is required for Elasticsearch 5.x and earlier but optional (or ignored) for Elasticsearch 6.x and OpenSearch.
Configures the VPC settings that allow the delivery stream to access an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain inside a VPC.

The ARN of the IAM role that Kinesis Data Firehose assumes to access the Amazon OpenSearch Service domain and its VPC resources (subnets, security groups) when delivering data through the VPC configuration.
Specifies the security group IDs that allow Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to access the Amazon OpenSearch Service domain inside a VPC.
The list of subnet IDs in which Kinesis Data Firehose places elastic network interfaces to access the Amazon OpenSearch Service domain inside your VPC.

aws_kinesis_firehose_delivery_stream.arn.text: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that uniquely identifies the Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream, such as arn:aws:firehose:region:account:deliverystream/name.

aws_kinesis_firehose_delivery_stream.dat.text: Configures the database source from which the delivery stream pulls data, including the database type, connection endpoint, port, database name, table name, credentials, and optional VPC networking settings.
Lists the specific columns of the database table to be captured by the Firehose delivery stream, allowing you to restrict the data that gets streamed from the database source.
Specifies the list of column names from the database source table that are excluded from the data ingested by the Firehose delivery stream.
Specifies the list of column names from the source database table that Firehose should include when ingesting data, filtering out other columns from the delivered stream.
Specifies the authentication details, including the AWS Secrets Manager secret ARN containing the database credentials, used to connect to the database source for this Firehose delivery stream.
Provides the ARN of the AWS Secrets Manager secret that stores the database credentials used to authenticate to the source database for the Kinesis Firehose delivery stream.
Indicates whether AWS Secrets Manager is used to retrieve the database credentials for the database source.
The ARN of the IAM role that AWS Kinesis Data Firehose assumes to retrieve the database authentication secret from AWS Secrets Manager.
The ARN of the AWS Secrets Manager secret that stores the database credentials used by Firehose to authenticate to the database source.

Configures the VPC settings (VPC ID, subnet IDs, security group IDs, and IAM role ARN) that enable the Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to access the source database within a virtual private cloud.
The name of the VPC endpoint service through which the Firehose delivery stream connects to the database source in your VPC.
This required field lists the names of the databases from which the Kinesis Firehose delivery stream ingests data when configured with a database source.
A list of database names to exclude from the Firehose delivery stream's database source, preventing data from those databases from being ingested and delivered.
This list specifies the names of tables within a database identified by the database source configuration to include in the Firehose delivery stream, so only those tables are ingested.
Specifies the connection endpoint (hostname or IP address) of the source database that Kinesis Data Firehose uses to ingest data, typically the DNS endpoint of an RDS or Aurora database instance.
The TCP port number on the source database server that this Firehose delivery stream connects to when ingesting data from the database source.
The PEM-encoded public certificate used by Kinesis Data Firehose to authenticate the database connection when TLS/SSL is enabled.

Specifies the name of the table in the source database that Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose uses to store the snapshot watermark, enabling it to track the progress of the initial snapshot and resume from where it left off.
Determines the SSL/TLS mode used when connecting to the source database, controlling whether encryption is required and whether the server certificate is verified.
Specifies the list of column names (surrogate keys) in the source database table that Firehose uses to uniquely identify records for change data capture (CDC) operations such as updates and deletes.
Specifies a list of column names to exclude from the database table so that those columns are not included in the data delivered by Kinesis Data Firehose from the database source.
Specifies the names of database tables to include when ingesting data from the source database.
The database engine type (e.g., MySQL or PostgreSQL) that identifies the kind of database from which Kinesis Data Firehose pulls the source data.

aws_kinesis_firehose_delivery_stream.del.text: Configures server-side encryption for the Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream by specifying the AWS KMS key ARN and the key type (AWS-owned or customer-managed).
The ARN of the AWS KMS key used to encrypt the delivery stream's data when server-side encryption is enabled.
Specifies the type of encryption key for the delivery stream, either AWS_OWNED_CMK or CUSTOMER_MANAGED_CMK, where CUSTOMER_MANAGED_CMK requires the KeyArn property.
A name for the Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream; if omitted, CloudFormation generates a unique physical ID to use as the stream name.

Specifies the type of delivery stream, either 'DirectPut' (default) or 'KinesisStreamAsSource', which determines whether the stream can be written to directly or reads from a Kinesis data stream as its source.

aws_kinesis_firehose_delivery_stream.dir.text: Specifies a throughput hint in megabytes per second that Firehose uses as a capacity planning aid when ingesting data from a direct PUT source, helping to provision the delivery stream with adequate resources.

aws_kinesis_firehose_delivery_stream.ela.text: Defines the delivery stream's target as Amazon Elasticsearch Service (now OpenSearch), specifying the domain/endpoint, index and type, buffering and retry behavior, and optional S3 backup for failed records.
Specifies the buffering size (in MB) and buffering interval (in seconds) that govern when Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose flushes incoming data to the Amazon Elasticsearch Service destination.

The number of seconds Kinesis Data Firehose buffers incoming data for the Elasticsearch destination before delivering it, part of the buffering hints configuration (typically between 60 and 900 seconds).

Specifies the buffer size in MBs (between 1 and 100) that Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose uses before delivering data to the Elasticsearch destination, triggering a delivery when the accumulated data reaches this size.
Configures whether the Firehose delivery stream's Elasticsearch destination logs are sent to Amazon CloudWatch Logs, including the CloudWatch log group and log stream name to use.
Indicates whether CloudWatch logging is enabled for the Elasticsearch destination, allowing delivery stream logs to be sent to CloudWatch Logs.
Specifies the name of the CloudWatch Logs log group where Kinesis Data Firehose will deliver logs about the Elasticsearch destination's delivery attempts and errors.
The name of the CloudWatch Logs log stream to which Kinesis Data Firehose sends operational logs for the Elasticsearch destination when CloudWatch logging is enabled.

Specifies the full HTTPS endpoint URL of the Elasticsearch cluster (e.g., https://search-my-domain.us-east-1.es.amazonaws.com) to which Kinesis Data Firehose sends records, used instead of the Amazon ES domain ARN when you want to target an external or self-managed cluster.

Configures the document ID generation strategy for Elasticsearch writes in Firehose, allowing you to use a field from the source record (AdditionalDocumentId) as the Elasticsearch document ID rather than the managed/default randomly generated ID.

Determines whether Kinesis Data Firehose automatically generates a unique document ID for each record sent to Amazon Elasticsearch Service (FIREHOSE_DEFAULT) or preserves the `_id` value from the source record as the document ID (NO_CONVERSION).
The ARN of the Amazon Elasticsearch Service domain that the Kinesis Firehose delivery stream sends data to.
The name of the Elasticsearch index that the delivery stream writes to, which can include time-format placeholders like %{yyyy-MM-dd} for dynamic index naming.
Specifies how often Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose rotates the Elasticsearch index name by appending a timestamp, with allowed values NoRotation, OneHour, OneDay, OneWeek, or OneMonth.

Specifies the processing configuration, including whether it is enabled and the Lambda-based processors, that transform incoming data records before they are delivered to the Elasticsearch destination.
A boolean flag that enables or disables Lambda-based data transformation (processing) for the Elasticsearch destination of this Firehose delivery stream.
List of data transformation processors to apply to incoming records before delivery to the Elasticsearch destination, each defining a processor type and its parameters.

Specifies a list of parameter name-value pairs that configure the processing processor (for example, the Lambda function ARN, number of retries, buffer size, buffer interval, and IAM role ARN) for the Elasticsearch destination of a Kinesis Firehose delivery stream.

Specifies the name of a processor parameter, such as LambdaArn, NumberOfRetries, BufferSizeInMBs, or BufferIntervalInSeconds, that configures the behavior of the processing processor in the Firehose delivery stream.
The value of a processor parameter (e.g., LambdaArn, NumberOfRetries) in the data processing configuration for the Elasticsearch destination of a Kinesis Firehose delivery stream.
Specifies the type of data processor applied to the incoming records before they are delivered to the Elasticsearch destination, such as 'Lambda' or 'AppendDelimiterToRecord'.
Specifies the length of time (in seconds) during which Kinesis Data Firehose retries sending data to the Amazon Elasticsearch Service destination after a delivery failure.

The length of time (in seconds) during which Kinesis Data Firehose retries delivering data to the Elasticsearch destination after a delivery failure, before treating the data as failed and applying the configured backup or error-handling behavior.
The ARN of the IAM role that Kinesis Data Firehose assumes to write to the specified Amazon Elasticsearch Service domain.

Determines whether only failed documents or all documents are backed up to the S3 bucket for the Elasticsearch destination, controlled by the s3_backup_mode value (either 'FailedDocumentsOnly' or 'AllDocuments').
The S3 configuration used to buffer incoming data before delivery to the Elasticsearch destination, specifying the bucket, IAM role, buffering hints, and optional encryption settings.
The ARN of the S3 bucket that Kinesis Data Firehose uses to back up data delivered to the Elasticsearch destination, with the backup scope controlled by the S3 backup mode.
Specifies the buffering size (in MB) and buffering interval (in seconds) for how often data is delivered to the Amazon S3 bucket from the Elasticsearch destination's S3 backup configuration.
The number of seconds for which Kinesis Data Firehose buffers incoming data before delivering it to Amazon S3, used within the S3 buffering hints of an Elasticsearch destination configuration.
Defines the buffer size in megabytes for the S3 backup associated with the Elasticsearch destination, determining how much data is accumulated before being delivered to S3.
Specifies the CloudWatch Logs log group and log stream to which Kinesis Data Firehose should deliver error logs from the S3 destination configuration.
Indicates whether CloudWatch logging is enabled for the S3 backup configuration associated with the Elasticsearch destination of the Kinesis Firehose delivery stream.
The name of the Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group where the Kinesis Firehose delivery stream writes logs for the S3 backup configuration associated with the Elasticsearch destination.
The name of the CloudWatch Logs log stream to which the Firehose delivery stream sends logs about S3 data delivery or backup errors for the Elasticsearch destination.
The compression format applied to the data stored in the S3 backup bucket, such as UNCOMPRESSED, GZIP, ZIP, or SNAPPY.

Defines the AWS KMS encryption configuration for the S3 bucket used as intermediate storage before data is delivered to an Elasticsearch destination in a Kinesis Firehose delivery stream, specifying the KMS key for encrypting buffered data at rest.
Specifies the AWS KMS key (by its ARN) used to encrypt the S3 destination objects for the Elasticsearch delivery stream's S3 backup configuration.
The ARN of the AWS KMS key used to encrypt the S3 objects written by this Elasticsearch destination's S3 configuration.
Sets the S3 encryption mode to no encryption by specifying the string 'NoEncryption', used when you do not want server-side encryption for the delivery stream's S3 destination.
The S3 key prefix used to store records that failed to be delivered to Elasticsearch, separating error output from successfully processed data.
Specifies the S3 object key prefix used by the Firehose delivery stream when writing backup data to S3 for the Elasticsearch destination configuration.
The ARN of the IAM role that Kinesis Data Firehose assumes to write buffered data to the S3 bucket specified in this s3_configuration for the Elasticsearch destination.
Specifies the Elasticsearch document type name that Amazon Kinesis Firehose uses when indexing data into the destination Elasticsearch domain.
Configures VPC settings (subnet IDs, security group IDs, and an IAM role) that allow the Firehose delivery stream to access an Amazon ES domain in a VPC.
The ARN of the IAM role that Kinesis Data Firehose assumes to access resources in the customer's VPC, such as creating and managing elastic network interfaces for the Elasticsearch destination.
The list of VPC security group IDs that AWS Kinesis Data Firehose uses to access the Elasticsearch destination within the VPC via an elastic network interface.
Specifies the subnets in the VPC where Kinesis Data Firehose places its network interfaces to access the Amazon Elasticsearch Service domain, enabling delivery to a VPC-hosted ES cluster.

aws_kinesis_firehose_delivery_stream.ext.text: This configuration defines an Amazon S3 destination for the Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream, with extended options such as data transformation via AWS Lambda, buffering hints, compression, encryption, dynamic partitioning, and CloudWatch error logging.
The ARN of the S3 bucket where Firehose delivers data records when using the extended S3 destination configuration.

Specifies the buffering size (in MB) and buffering interval (in seconds) that Firehose uses to accumulate incoming data before delivering a batch to the S3 destination for this Extended S3 destination configuration.
Sets the number of seconds (60–900) that Kinesis Data Firehose buffers incoming data for the extended S3 destination before flushing it to Amazon S3.

The buffer size in MiBs for incoming data before Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivers a new object to the S3 bucket; when the accumulated data size reaches this value, Firehose flushes the buffer to the destination.
Configures whether CloudWatch Logs logging is enabled for the S3 destination, and optionally specifies the log group and log stream to which Firehose delivers delivery error logs.
Indicates whether CloudWatch logging is enabled for the extended S3 destination of the Kinesis Firehose delivery stream, which when true sends logs to the specified log group and stream.
The name of the CloudWatch Logs log group where Kinesis Data Firehose delivers log entries for the extended S3 destination.
Specifies the CloudWatch Logs log stream name where Kinesis Data Firehose sends logs (such as delivery error logs) for the Extended S3 destination.
Specifies the compression format for data delivered to Amazon S3, such as GZIP, ZIP, SNAPPY, HADOOP_SNAPPY, or UNCOMPRESSED.
Sets the time zone used for timestamp-based S3 object name prefixes and paths in the extended S3 destination, overriding the default UTC.

Configures data format conversion for the extended S3 destination, enabling AWS Kinesis Data Firehose to convert incoming data to formats like Apache Parquet or ORC (via AWS Glue) before delivery to S3.
Whether to enable data format conversion for the delivery stream's S3 destination, allowing source records to be transformed to formats such as Parquet or ORC before being written to S3.
Specifies the input format configuration for data format conversion, including the deserializer (OpenXJsonSerDe or HiveJsonSerDe) used to parse records from the source format.

Specifies the deserializer configuration that defines how incoming source records are parsed (e.g., via OpenXJsonSerDe or HiveJsonSerDe) before converting them to the target output format such as Parquet or ORC in the data format conversion process.
Specifies the Hive JSON SerDe to deserialize JSON input records during data format conversion for the Extended S3 destination, allowing configuration of timestamp formats for parsing.
Specifies a list of timestamp format strings (Java SimpleDateFormat syntax) that the Hive JSON SerDe uses to parse timestamp fields in the incoming JSON data during data format conversion.
Configures the OpenXJsonSerDe deserializer for parsing JSON input during data format conversion, optionally mapping column names to JSON keys.
When enabled, column names in the JSON input are matched to the table schema without regard to case, allowing lowercase and uppercase variants to be treated equivalently.
Specifies a mapping of column names to JSON keys that the OpenXJsonSerDe uses to map fields in the source JSON data to columns in the output format.
When set to true, this option instructs the OpenXJSON SerDe to replace dots in JSON key names with underscores during deserialization, so that keys like 'a.b' are converted to 'a_b'.
Specifies the format (serializer) for the output data after schema and format conversion, such as Parquet or ORC, in the data format conversion configuration for the S3 destination.
Defines the serializer that specifies how converted data is written to S3, allowing either Parquet (ParquetSerDe) or ORC (OrcSerDe) serialization within the output format configuration.

Configures the ORC (Optimized Row Columnar) serializer for the output format conversion in the extended S3 destination, specifying ORC SerDe parameters such as compression type, block size, and stripe size.
The size of each ORC block in bytes, which controls the compression and read performance of ORC files written by Firehose.
Specifies the list of column names for which ORC will create bloom filters, enabling efficient predicate filtering in downstream queries.

Specifies the desired false positive probability for ORC bloom filters used by the ORC SerDe in the data format conversion, balancing filter accuracy against memory usage when writing to the extended S3 destination.
Specifies the compression codec (e.g., SNAPPY, GZIP, DEFLATE) for ORC-format output produced by the Firehose delivery stream's data format conversion.

Specifies the fraction of distinct string keys relative to the total number of rows in a column that, when exceeded, causes the ORC SerDe to disable dictionary encoding for that column in the Firehose output.
When enabled, the ORC serializer pads rows to reduce row index overhead, which can improve compression efficiency at the cost of slightly increased storage size.
Defines the version of the ORC SerDe used when the Firehose delivery stream converts and writes data to ORC format in the extended S3 destination.

Specifies the tolerance for block padding as a decimal fraction of total block size when writing ORC files, controlling how much padding the ORC writer is allowed to add to achieve the desired stripe size.
Specifies the number of rows between index entries in the ORC-encoded output, with a default value of 10000.
The size (in bytes) of each stripe in the ORC output files, controlling how much data is grouped into a stripe and affecting compression and read performance.

Specifies the Parquet serialization settings (such as block size, page size, compression, and dictionary encoding) applied to the output data when the Firehose conversion writes records in Parquet format to S3.
Specifies the size in bytes of each row group (block) in the Parquet output files written by the ParquetSerDe serializer.
Specifies the compression codec (such as UNCOMPRESSED, GZIP, or SNAPPY) that the Parquet serializer applies to data before writing to Amazon S3.
Indicates whether to enable dictionary compression for the Parquet serializer in the output format configuration.
Specifies the maximum amount of padding (in bytes) to apply to the size of rows when the Parquet SerDe serializes data during data format conversion for the Kinesis Firehose extended S3 destination.
Specifies the number of bytes in each page of the Parquet output, which controls the granularity of compression and encoding within the Parquet file produced by the Firehose data format conversion.
Sets the version of the Apache Parquet writer used to serialize the output data (valid values are 'V1' and 'V2'), which controls the Parquet formatting and encoding compatibility.

Defines the schema details (including the IAM role, AWS Glue database and table, region, and optional version) that Firehose uses to interpret incoming records for format conversion (e.g., to Parquet or ORC).
The AWS account ID of the Glue Data Catalog where the schema's source table is defined; defaults to the current account ID if omitted.
Specifies the name of the AWS Glue Data Catalog database that contains the table schema used for the data format conversion in the Firehose delivery stream.
The AWS Region where the schema (e.g., the referenced Glue database or schema) resides, enabling Firehose to locate and apply the appropriate schema during data format conversion.

The IAM role ARN that AWS Kinesis Firehose assumes to access the AWS Glue Data Catalog for retrieving schema information needed for data format conversion (e.g., to Parquet or ORC) in the extended S3 destination.
Specifies the table name in the AWS Glue Data Catalog that defines the schema used for data format conversion.
Specifies the version of the AWS Glue table schema to use for the data format conversion; when omitted, Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose uses the latest schema version.

Configures dynamic partitioning for the extended S3 destination, allowing Firehose to automatically partition incoming data based on keys extracted from the data itself, with an enabled flag and retry options for partitioning backpressure.
Whether dynamic partitioning is enabled for the S3 destination, allowing Firehose to partition data in Amazon S3 by keys extracted from incoming records.

Retry options for the dynamic partitioning process, configuring the maximum duration in seconds that AWS Kinesis Data Firehose retries failed dynamic partitioning operations before the data is discarded or routed to an error bucket.

The length of time (in seconds) during which Kinesis Data Firehose retries to process records when dynamic partitioning fails to determine partition keys, with valid values from 0 to 7200 and a default of 300.
Configures how data written to the S3 bucket is encrypted at rest, allowing either no encryption or KMS-managed server-side encryption with a specified AWS KMS key.
Specifies the AWS KMS key (by ARN) used to encrypt objects in the S3 destination when encryption is enabled for the extended S3 destination.
The ARN of the AWS KMS key used to encrypt data in the extended S3 destination of the Kinesis Firehose delivery stream.
Sets the S3 destination encryption to no encryption; must be the literal string 'NoEncryption'.
Specifies the S3 object key prefix under which Kinesis Data Firehose writes records that failed processing or delivery, capturing error output for troubleshooting.
Specifies the file extension to use for objects delivered to Amazon S3, overriding the default extension for the selected compression format.

Specifies the string prefix prepended to the S3 object names that Kinesis Data Firehose writes to the extended S3 destination, commonly used to organize objects by date/time patterns such as 'YYYY/MM/DD/HH/'.
Configures data transformation, typically via an AWS Lambda function, to process records before they are delivered to the extended S3 destination of the Kinesis Firehose delivery stream.
Indicates whether data processing (such as Lambda transformation) is enabled for the extended S3 destination of this Kinesis Firehose delivery stream.
Defines a list of processors (such as an AWS Lambda function or a delimiter appender) applied to incoming records to transform or enrich them before delivery to the S3 bucket.

Specifies the list of key-value parameter pairs (such as the Lambda function ARN and retry count for a Lambda processor) that configure each data transformation processor in the processing pipeline for the extended S3 destination of a Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream.
Specifies the key name of a processing parameter for the configured processor (e.g., 'LambdaArn' or 'NumberOfRetries'), determining how the processor is configured.
Specifies the value for a processor parameter (such as a Lambda function ARN or retry count) that configures how the Firehose data processing is performed before delivery to S3.

Identifies the type of data processor to apply to the delivery stream (e.g., 'Lambda', 'RecordDeAggregation', 'MetadataExtraction', or 'AppendDelimiterToRecord'), determining how the processing configuration transforms or enriches records.
The ARN of the IAM role that Kinesis Data Firehose assumes to write to the S3 bucket (and invoke any associated Lambda transformation) configured in the extended S3 destination.

Defines the S3 bucket and related settings (such as bucket ARN, prefix, buffering, and encryption) that Kinesis Data Firehose uses to back up delivered data for the extended S3 destination when S3 backup is enabled.
The ARN of the S3 bucket where Firehose stores backup data for the extended S3 destination when backup is enabled.
Specifies the buffering size and interval for the S3 backup destination, controlling when data is buffered and delivered to the backup S3 bucket.
Specifies the buffering interval in seconds for the backup S3 destination, controlling how long Firehose waits before delivering buffered data to the backup bucket (minimum 60, maximum 900).
Specifies the buffer size in MB that Firehose uses to decide when to write incoming data to the backup Amazon S3 bucket, before the buffering interval expires.
Configures CloudWatch logging for the backup S3 destination, including whether logging is enabled and the CloudWatch log group and stream names for delivery of Firehose backup data logs.
Whether to enable CloudWatch logging for the S3 backup destination of the Firehose delivery stream.
The name of the CloudWatch Logs log group where Kinesis Data Firehose delivers logs for the backup S3 destination.
The name of the CloudWatch Logs log stream to which Kinesis Data Firehose sends the S3 backup destination's delivery logs when CloudWatch logging is enabled.
Specifies the compression format (such as UNCOMPRESSED, GZIP, ZIP, or SNAPPY) applied to backup S3 objects that Kinesis Data Firehose delivers to the S3 backup bucket for the extended S3 destination.
Encryption configuration for the S3 backup bucket in a Firehose extended S3 destination, defining whether and how backup data is encrypted, such as with SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS using a specified KMS key.
Specifies the AWS KMS encryption configuration, including the KMS key ARN, used to encrypt data in the backup S3 bucket for the delivery stream's extended S3 destination.
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AWS KMS key used to encrypt the S3 backup destination objects.
Specifies that no server-side encryption (AWS KMS) should be applied to the S3 backup destination; set the value to 'NoEncryption' to explicitly disable encryption for this backup bucket.
Specifies the S3 object key prefix under which error output files (records that failed processing) are stored within the S3 backup destination.
Specifies the object key prefix for the S3 backup bucket, allowing time-based partitioning such as 'YYYY/MM/DD/HH/' to organize backup files.
The ARN of the IAM role that AWS Kinesis Data Firehose assumes to write backup data to the S3 bucket specified in the S3 backup configuration.
Specifies whether Amazon S3 backups for the destination are enabled (Enabled) or disabled (Disabled).

aws_kinesis_firehose_delivery_stream.htt.text: Configuration for the Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to deliver incoming data records to an HTTP/HTTPS endpoint, specifying endpoint settings, request details, buffering, retries, and optional S3 backup.
Configures the buffering size (in MB) and buffering interval (in seconds) for incoming data before it is delivered to the HTTP endpoint destination.
The number of seconds Kinesis Data Firehose buffers incoming data for the HTTP endpoint destination before delivering it, with valid values from 60 to 900 and a default of 300.
The size of the buffer (in MiBs) that Firehose uses to buffer incoming data before delivering it to the HTTP endpoint.
Specifies the CloudWatch Logs logging options for the HTTP endpoint destination, including whether logging is enabled and the log group and log stream to which logs are delivered.
Indicates whether CloudWatch Logs logging is enabled for the HTTP endpoint destination, enabling Firehose to deliver delivery stream logs to a specified CloudWatch Logs group.
The name of the CloudWatch Logs log group where Kinesis Data Firehose delivers the logs (such as delivery errors) for the HTTP endpoint destination.
The name of the CloudWatch Logs log stream to which Firehose delivers the destination's log entries when CloudWatch logging is enabled for the HTTP endpoint destination.
Configures the HTTP endpoint target for Kinesis Data Firehose delivery, including the endpoint URL, name, and optional access key used for authentication.
The access key (username) used for basic authentication to the HTTP endpoint when delivering data to the configured HTTP destination.
Specifies the name of the HTTP endpoint to which Firehose delivers data, used as a friendly identifier for the endpoint within the delivery stream.
The URL of the HTTP endpoint to which Kinesis Data Firehose delivers data.
Configures whether and how incoming records are processed (e.g., by Lambda) for the HTTP endpoint destination, including an Enabled flag and a list of Processors that define the transformation steps.
Indicates whether data transformation through the configured Lambda function is enabled for the HTTP endpoint destination in the Firehose delivery stream.
Specifies the list of data processors, typically AWS Lambda functions, that are invoked to transform incoming records before they are delivered to the HTTP endpoint destination.

Specifies the parameter name-value pairs that configure each processor in the processing configuration, such as the Lambda function ARN and retry settings, for records delivered to the HTTP endpoint destination.
The name of the processor parameter (e.g., LambdaArn, NumberOfRetries) whose value is being set for the data processing configuration of the HTTP endpoint destination.

For the HTTP endpoint destination's processing configuration, this field specifies the value of a processor parameter (such as LambdaArn or NumberOfRetries) whose name is provided by the sibling parameter_name field.

Specifies the type of data processor to apply to incoming records, with valid values including Lambda, AppendDelimiterToRecord, Decompression, CloudWatchLogsProcessing, MetadataExtractor, and RecordDeAggregation, which determines how records are transformed before delivery to the HTTP endpoint.
Specifies the request configuration for the HTTP endpoint destination, including common attributes (custom headers) sent with each request and the content encoding (GZIP or NONE).
Specifies key-value pairs that are included in every HTTP request Firehose sends to the destination endpoint.
The name of a key in a key-value pair that is added to every HTTP endpoint request made by the delivery stream.
The value of the common attribute that is added to each HTTP request sent to the specified HTTP endpoint destination.
Specifies the content encoding (NONE or GZIP) that Kinesis Data Firehose applies to the data in HTTP requests sent to the destination endpoint.
Specifies the retry behavior for failed HTTP endpoint deliveries, including the duration (in seconds) for which Kinesis Data Firehose retries the delivery.
The total amount of time, in seconds, that Kinesis Data Firehose spends retrying delivery to the HTTP endpoint after the initial request fails.
The ARN of the IAM role that Kinesis Data Firehose assumes to access the HTTP endpoint and deliver data to it.
Specifies whether Firehose backs up all data or only data that failed to deliver to the HTTP endpoint to the S3 bucket configured in the S3 destination.
S3 configuration for the HTTP endpoint destination, specifying the bucket, prefix, and IAM role used to back up Firehose-delivered records.

The ARN of the S3 bucket used for backup storage or as a destination for data that could not be delivered to the HTTP endpoint, as specified in the s3_configuration block of the HTTP endpoint destination for this Firehose delivery stream.
Controls the size (in MB) and interval (in seconds) that Firehose buffers incoming data before delivering it to the S3 bucket in the HTTP endpoint destination configuration.
The maximum number of seconds that Kinesis Data Firehose buffers incoming data for the S3 destination before delivering it to Amazon S3, acting as a flush trigger for the buffered data.
The buffer size (in MB) that determines how much data is buffered before Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose writes to the S3 bucket configured as the backup destination for the HTTP endpoint destination.
Configures CloudWatch Logs for the S3 backup/error output of an HTTP endpoint destination, enabling delivery of Firehose logs to a specified CloudWatch log group and stream.
Turns on CloudWatch logging for the S3 backup configuration of the HTTP endpoint destination, causing Firehose to write to the specified CloudWatch log group and stream when set to true.
The name of the CloudWatch Logs log group to which Kinesis Data Firehose sends logs for the S3 backup configuration of the HTTP endpoint destination.
The name of the CloudWatch Logs log stream that Kinesis Data Firehose uses to deliver logs for the S3 backup of the HTTP endpoint destination.
Specifies the compression format (e.g., UNCOMPRESSED, GZIP, ZIP, SNAPPY) applied to Amazon S3 backup objects created by the HTTP endpoint destination's S3 configuration.
Configures the encryption settings for the S3 bucket that Kinesis Data Firehose uses for backup or intermediate delivery, allowing you to specify AWS KMS encryption or no encryption.
Specifies the AWS KMS key (via its ARN) used to encrypt objects stored in the S3 bucket used for backup and error output from the HTTP endpoint destination of the Kinesis Firehose delivery stream.
The ARN of the AWS KMS key used to encrypt the data in the S3 backup bucket for the HTTP endpoint destination of the Kinesis Firehose delivery stream.

Set this field to the literal value 'NoEncryption' to explicitly disable server-side encryption for the S3 destination under the HTTP endpoint configuration; if omitted, encryption is governed by the sibling KMSEncryptionConfig field.
Specifies the S3 object key prefix for error records that are delivered to Amazon S3 when Firehose fails to deliver data to the HTTP endpoint.
Defines the S3 object key prefix used when Firehose writes data to the configured S3 bucket, supporting timestamp expressions and dynamic partition variables.
The ARN of the IAM role that Kinesis Data Firehose assumes to write data to the S3 bucket configured for this HTTP endpoint destination's S3 backup configuration.
Specifies the AWS Secrets Manager configuration used to retrieve the HTTP endpoint's authentication credentials.
Enables or disables the use of AWS Secrets Manager to retrieve the HTTP endpoint destination's access credentials.
The ARN of the IAM role that Kinesis Data Firehose assumes to retrieve the secret from AWS Secrets Manager for the HTTP endpoint destination.
The ARN of an AWS Secrets Manager secret that stores the credentials (such as an API key) used to authenticate requests to the HTTP endpoint.

aws_kinesis_firehose_delivery_stream.ice.text: Specifies how Kinesis Data Firehose writes records to an Apache Iceberg table, including the Glue catalog configuration, database and table names, and buffering options.
Determines whether the Firehose stream writes data to the Iceberg table as append-only inserts (true) or allows operations based on table primary keys such as updates and deletes (false).
Defines the buffering size (in MB) and interval (in seconds) that Firehose waits before delivering accumulated data to the Iceberg destination, controlling the frequency and size of write batches.

The number of seconds that Kinesis Data Firehose buffers incoming data for the Iceberg destination before delivering it, allowing the buffer to fill within this time window (valid range 60 to 900 seconds).
Specifies the buffer size in MiBs that Kinesis Data Firehose accumulates before delivering a batch of data to the Iceberg destination, triggering a write when this size is reached.
Specifies the AWS Glue Data Catalog configuration for the Iceberg destination, including the catalog ARN and warehouse location used to locate and write to the target Iceberg tables.
The ARN of the AWS Glue catalog that the Firehose delivery stream uses to access and manage Iceberg tables.
The Amazon S3 URI (e.g., s3://bucket/prefix) that defines the warehouse location for the Apache Iceberg table, specifying where the table's data and metadata are stored.
CloudWatch Logs logging options for the Iceberg destination, controlling whether delivery stream logs are sent to CloudWatch and specifying the log group and log stream names.
Indicates whether CloudWatch logging is enabled for the Iceberg destination of the Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream.
The name of the CloudWatch Logs log group where Amazon Data Firehose delivers logs for the Iceberg destination configuration.
The name of the CloudWatch Logs log stream where Kinesis Data Firehose delivers diagnostic logs for the Iceberg destination configuration.
Specifies the list of Apache Iceberg destination table configurations (each with a database name and table name) that the delivery stream writes to, enabling routing to multiple Iceberg tables.
The name of the AWS Glue Data Catalog database that contains the Iceberg table to which Firehose delivers records.
The name of the Apache Iceberg table in the destination data catalog (such as AWS Glue) to which Firehose writes the incoming data records.
Specifies the partitioning scheme for the destination Iceberg table, including the list of partition fields and their transforms used to organize incoming records into partitions.

Specifies which columns from the source data are used as partition keys in the Iceberg destination table using identity transforms, so each partition corresponds to the exact value of the listed column.

Specifies the name of the incoming data column whose value is used directly (as an identity transform) for the corresponding Iceberg partition field, so each unique value in that column creates its own partition in the destination table.
Specifies the S3 object key prefix under which records that fail to be written to the Iceberg destination table are stored in the error output bucket for this table configuration.

Specifies the list of column names that serve as the unique key for the destination table, used to determine whether each incoming record is treated as an insert or an update when writing to the Iceberg table.
Specifies the data processing configuration, including any Lambda-based processors, that transforms incoming records before they are written to the Iceberg destination.
Indicates whether data processing (such as a Lambda transformation) is enabled for the Iceberg destination in the Firehose delivery stream.

Specifies the ordered list of data processors (for example, an AWS Lambda function for record transformation or a record format conversion processor) that are applied to incoming data before it is delivered to the Iceberg destination.

Specifies the configuration parameters for a processor as a list of objects, each containing a parameter name and value (for example, the Lambda function ARN, buffer size, and retry options for a Lambda processor).

Specifies the name of a key in a key-value pair that configures a processing processor for a Firehose delivery stream, such as `LambdaArn` or `NumberOfRetries` for an AWS Lambda processor, with the value supplied in the sibling `ParameterValue` field.

The value assigned to a specific processor parameter key (e.g., LambdaArn, NumberOfRetries) within a processing configuration step for the Iceberg destination, where the parameter's data type depends on the parameter key being configured.

This field specifies the type of processor (e.g., Lambda or MetadataExtraction) that determines how Kinesis Data Firehose transforms records in the processing configuration before delivering them to the Iceberg destination.
Defines the maximum duration (in seconds) that Kinesis Data Firehose will retry sending records to the Iceberg destination if the initial delivery attempt fails.
