For a SageMaker shadow production variant, this optional string overrides the variant-level model name for requests routed to that specific instance pool, allowing different models to be served by different instance pools within the same variant.
The priority value of an instance pool within the shadow production variant, determining the order in which the instance pools are selected for routing and scaling inference traffic.
The instance type (e.g., ml.m5.large) used to run the shadow production variant, which receives a copy of traffic for testing before it is promoted to a production variant.

Configures the managed instance scaling limits (such as minimum and maximum instance counts and status) for this shadow production variant, controlling how SageMaker automatically scales the instance count for the endpoint.
The maximum number of instances that SageMaker can provision for the shadow variant when auto-scaling is enabled via managed instance scaling.
Specifies the minimum number of instances that the shadow production variant can scale down to when managed instance scaling is enabled.
Indicates whether Amazon SageMaker automatically manages instance scaling for the shadow production variant by adjusting instance counts based on traffic, with values ENABLED or DISABLED.
Specifies the timeout value, in seconds, to download and extract the model data for this shadow production variant before the endpoint deployment proceeds.
The name of the SageMaker model to deploy for this shadow production variant.
Configures how inference requests are routed to instances of this shadow production variant by selecting a routing strategy (LEAST_OUTSTANDING_REQUESTS or RANDOM).

For shadow production variants in a SageMaker endpoint configuration, this strategy determines how incoming traffic is distributed among the variants, either routing to the variant with the fewest in-flight requests ('LEAST_OUTSTANDING_REQUESTS') or choosing randomly ('RANDOM').
The serverless configuration for the shadow production variant, specifying the memory size and maximum concurrency for serverless inference.
Sets the maximum number of concurrent invocations the serverless shadow variant can handle.
The memory size in megabytes allocated to the serverless endpoint for this shadow production variant, which determines the compute capacity and billable resources for serverless inference.

Specifies the number of provisioned concurrent invocations for the serverless endpoint of the shadow production variant, which determines how many simultaneous requests it can handle for that variant.

Specifies the maximum time (in seconds) that SageMaker waits for an instance to be provisioned for a shadow production variant before considering the operation failed, controlling the provisioning timeout for that variant.
Specifies the unique name for a shadow production variant, which identifies the variant when an Amazon SageMaker endpoint receives shadow traffic for testing a new model.
The size, in GB, of the Amazon EBS volume attached to the inference instance for this shadow production variant.

aws_sage_maker_endpoint_config.tags.text: Defines the list of AWS tag objects (each with a Key and Value) to attach to this SageMaker endpoint configuration, which specifies the model, instance type, and settings for a real-time inference endpoint, enabling cost allocation and resource organization.

aws_sage_maker_endpoint_config.tags.key.text: The key (name) of an individual tag attached to the SageMaker endpoint configuration, used to identify and categorize the resource when paired with its corresponding value.

aws_sage_maker_endpoint_config.tags.valu.text: The value component of a tag attached to the SageMaker endpoint configuration, used to categorize and identify the resource.

aws_sage_maker_endpoint_config.vpc_confi.text: Specifies the VPC configuration for the SageMaker endpoint, including the subnets and security groups that the endpoint will use to access network resources.
The list of security group IDs that define the VPC security groups applied to the SageMaker endpoint's VPC configuration, governing network access to the model container.
The subnets field specifies the list of subnet IDs in the VPC where the SageMaker endpoint's network interfaces are placed.

aws_sage_maker_experiment.tags.key.text: The key of a tag applied to the SageMaker experiment, used to assign custom metadata for organizing, searching, and managing the experiment resource.

aws_sage_maker_experiment.tags.value.text: The value part of a user-defined key-value tag attached to an Amazon SageMaker experiment, used for labeling, categorization, and resource management.

aws_sage_maker_experiment_trial_componen.text: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that uniquely identifies this SageMaker experiment trial component within AWS.
The ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the SageMaker trial component was created, returned as a read-only string.
The human-readable display name of the trial component, which can differ from the automatically generated name and is used for identification in the SageMaker console and API.
The end time of the trial component, specified as an ISO 8601 date-time string (e.g., 2020-06-03T13:45:30Z).
The unique resource identifier for this SageMaker experiment trial component, which is its name as used in the SageMaker API.
The timestamp, formatted as a string, indicating when the SageMaker trial component was last modified.
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the lineage group associated with this SageMaker trial component.
Specifies metadata properties for the trial component, such as a Git commit ID, repository, and project identifier.
Specifies the commit ID of the source code repository associated with the trial component, for tracking lineage and reproducibility.
Identifies the entity (such as a training job or pipeline execution) that generated this trial component, typically specified as its Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for provenance tracking.
The unique identifier of the SageMaker project associated with this trial component, used for tracking the component within a project's lineage.
Specifies the repository URI or URL where the source code for the trial component is stored, as part of the metadata properties.
Specifies the starting time of the SageMaker trial component, typically in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2023-01-01T00:00:00Z), used to record when the component's execution began.
Defines the current status of the SageMaker trial component, including a primary status (e.g., InProgress, Completed, Failed) and an optional human-readable message with additional details.

The message field within the trial component's status object, providing human-readable details such as error descriptions or informational notes about the current state of the SageMaker trial component.
The current lifecycle status of the trial component, such as InProgress, Completed, Failed, Stopping, or Stopped, as tracked by SageMaker.
Associates a list of tag objects (each with Key and Value) with the SageMaker trial component for cost allocation, access control, and resource organization.
The key (name) of a user-defined tag attached to the SageMaker Experiment Trial Component, used to categorize or identify the resource.
The value of a tag assigned to the SageMaker experiment trial component, used for organizing and identifying the resource.
The name of the trial component, a user-defined identifier that must be unique within the AWS account and Region.

aws_sage_maker_feature_group.feature_def.text: Specifies the unique name of a feature (column) within a SageMaker Feature Group's record schema, as part of a feature definition list that defines each attribute and its type.
The data type of the feature, one of Integral, Fractional, or String, which determines how the feature value is stored and processed in the Amazon SageMaker Feature Store.

aws_sage_maker_feature_group.offline_sto.text: Configures the offline store, an S3-backed data store used for batch analytics with Athena and Glue, including S3 storage configuration, Data Catalog settings, and the option to disable the offline store.
Configures the AWS Glue Data Catalog metadata for the offline store feature table by specifying the Glue catalog, database, and table name.
The name of the AWS Glue Catalog (commonly 'aws') that contains the database and table used by the feature group's offline store for managing its data catalog entries.
The name of the AWS Glue database in which the SageMaker Feature Group's offline store data catalog table is registered.
The name of the Glue Data Catalog table (in the specified catalog and database) that stores the offline data for this feature group, allowing it to be queried with Athena or other services.
When set to true, prevents SageMaker from automatically creating the AWS Glue table that the offline store uses in its configured Data Catalog.
Configures Amazon S3 storage for the feature group's offline store, specifying the S3 URI (bucket and prefix) where data is stored and an optional KMS key ID for encryption.
The ID of the AWS KMS key used to encrypt the S3 objects in the offline store of the feature group, allowing customer-managed encryption instead of the default SageMaker-managed key.
The S3 URI (bucket and optional prefix) that defines the location where the feature group's offline store data is written and read.

aws_sage_maker_feature_group.online_stor.text: Configures the online store for the feature group, enabling low-latency reads and writes for real-time inference, and includes settings like whether the online store is enabled and the TTL duration for automatic record expiration.
Determines whether the online store is enabled for the feature group; when false, the feature group only uses the offline store and cannot support real-time inference queries.
Specifies the AWS KMS key ID used to encrypt data in the online store of the SageMaker feature group.
Specifies the AWS KMS key ID used to encrypt the feature group's online store, which provides low-latency access for real-time inference and is typically backed by DynamoDB.

Specifies the storage type for the online store of a SageMaker feature group, either Standard (default, uses Amazon Simple Storage Service) or InMemory (uses SageMaker-managed Redis cluster) to control performance and cost.

aws_sage_maker_feature_group.tags.key.text: The key portion of a tag attached to the SageMaker Feature Group, used for organizing, cost tracking, and access management of the resource.

aws_sage_maker_feature_group.throughput_.text: Defines the read/write throughput configuration for the feature group, specifying either on-demand or provisioned mode with optional capacity units for reads and writes.

aws_sage_maker_hub.tags.key.text: The key of a tag attached to the SageMaker Hub, used to identify and categorize the hub for resource management and cost allocation.

aws_sage_maker_hub.tags.value.text: The value component of a tag attached to the SageMaker Hub, which pairs with the corresponding key to organize, identify, and manage the hub resource within your AWS environment.

aws_sage_maker_human_task_ui.tags.key.text: A user-defined tag key that helps identify, organize, and manage costs for this SageMaker human task UI resource, with the value paired in the same tag list entry.

aws_sage_maker_human_task_ui.tags.value.text: The value of a tag attached to the AWS SageMaker HumanTaskUi resource, used for metadata and cost allocation.

aws_sage_maker_image.tags.key.text: The key portion of a tag assigned to the SageMaker Image resource, enabling you to label the image with custom metadata for cost allocation and operational management.

aws_sage_maker_image.tags.value.text: The value of a tag key-value pair attached to the SageMaker image, used to organize and identify the resource for cost allocation and access control.

aws_sage_maker_inference_component.creat.text: The date and time when the SageMaker inference component was created.

aws_sage_maker_inference_component.deplo.text: Specifies the CloudWatch alarms that trigger automatic rollback of the SageMaker inference component deployment when they enter an alarm state.
A list of CloudWatch alarms that, when triggered, cause the inference component deployment to automatically roll back to the previous configuration.
The name of the CloudWatch alarm that triggers an automatic rollback of the SageMaker inference component deployment when it enters an alarm state.

Specifies whether the maximum batch size for a rolling update to a SageMaker Inference Component is expressed as an instance count or as a percentage of the endpoint's total capacity, determining how many instances are updated concurrently during the deployment.
Specifies the maximum time in seconds that a rolling update of the SageMaker inference component is allowed to run before the update is considered failed and is rolled back.
The type of the maximum batch size for a rollback, either 'COUNT' (a fixed number of instances) or 'PERCENTAGE' (a proportion of the deployment's instances).
Specifies the number of seconds to wait after each batch of instances is updated before the next batch is deployed during a rolling update for the SageMaker inference component.

aws_sage_maker_inference_component.infer.text: Indicates the current lifecycle status of the SageMaker inference component, such as Creating, InService, Updating, Deleting, or Failed.

aws_sage_maker_inference_component.last_.text: The date and time when the SageMaker inference component was last modified.

aws_sage_maker_inference_component.speci.text: Defines the compute resources required for the inference component, including the number of accelerator devices, the number of inference copies, and the minimum and maximum memory (in MB) needed to run the component.

Specifies the maximum amount of memory, in megabytes, that the inference component requires for deployment, which SageMaker uses to place the component on an endpoint and ensure sufficient resources are available.
Specifies the minimum amount of memory, in megabytes, that the SageMaker inference component needs for its model and runtime to operate successfully.
The number of accelerator devices required for the inference component, used to determine the appropriate instance type for deployment.
The exact number of CPU cores that must be allocated to the inference component, used when a fixed compute resource allocation is specified rather than a range.
Specifies the container configuration for the SageMaker inference component, including the Docker image, model artifact URL, and environment variables.
The Amazon S3 URI where the model artifacts for this inference component container are stored.

The `deployed_image` object contains the resolved image URI and the resolution method that SageMaker actually used for the inference component's container after deployment, which may differ from the image originally specified.
The timestamp at which the image URI for the container was resolved to the actual image used for the deployed inference component, as a string.

Specifies startup parameters for the inference component's model container, including the model data download timeout and container startup health check timeout, used to control how the container is launched and validated before it begins serving inference traffic.
The timeout in seconds that SageMaker waits for the container's health check to succeed during component startup.
The maximum time, in seconds, allowed for downloading the model data during inference component startup before the startup is considered failed.

aws_sage_maker_inference_component.tags..text: The key of a tag assigned to the SageMaker inference component, used to identify, organize, and manage the resource.
The value of a tag key-value pair attached to the SageMaker inference component, providing metadata for organizing, managing, and identifying the component.

aws_sage_maker_inference_experiment.mode.text: Specifies the hosting infrastructure (such as the instance type and instance count) for serving this model variant in the inference experiment.
Specifies whether the model variant is hosted on real-time infrastructure or asynchronous inference infrastructure, with allowed values of 'RealTime' or 'Async'.
Specifies the Amazon SageMaker ML instance type and instance count to use for the model variant's real-time inference endpoint in the inference experiment.
Specifies the initial number of ML compute instances to provision for the model variant when serving real-time inference in the SageMaker Inference Experiment.
The ML compute instance type (e.g., ml.m5.large, ml.c5.xlarge) that SageMaker provisions for the real-time inference endpoint of this inference experiment.
Specifies the name of the SageMaker model that this model variant deploys in the inference experiment.
The name of the model variant in a SageMaker Inference Experiment, used to uniquely identify the variant within the experiment's configuration.

aws_sage_maker_inference_experiment.shad.text: The percentage of inference requests that are routed to this shadow model variant for evaluation.
The name of the model variant that receives a copy of production traffic in shadow mode, allowing you to test its performance without impacting the primary endpoint.

aws_sage_maker_inference_experiment.tags.text: The key of a tag attached to the SageMaker inference experiment.
Specifies the value portion of a key-value tag attached to the SageMaker inference experiment, used to organize, identify, and manage the experiment.

aws_sage_maker_mlflow_app.tags.key.text: The key of a tag attached to the SageMaker MLflow App, used to organize, identify, and manage access to the resource.

aws_sage_maker_mlflow_app.tags.value.text: The value of a user-defined tag attached to the SageMaker MLflow App, used to assign metadata such as environment, owner, or cost center for resource management and identification.

aws_sage_maker_mlflow_tracking_server.ta.text: The key part of a key-value tag attached to the SageMaker MLflow Tracking Server, used to identify and organize the resource within AWS.
The arbitrary value for a tag attached to the SageMaker MLflow Tracking Server.

aws_sage_maker_model.containers.containe.text: Specifies the custom hostname assigned to the container within a multi-container SageMaker model, allowing other containers to address it by that hostname.

aws_sage_maker_model.containers.environm.text: A map of environment variable keys and values that are passed to the container when the SageMaker model is deployed.

aws_sage_maker_model.containers.image.text: Specifies the Amazon ECR registry path (image URI) of the Docker image that SageMaker uses to run inference for this container in the model.

aws_sage_maker_model.containers.image_co.text: Configures how the container image is accessed, including the repository access mode (Platform or Vpc) and optional credentials provider ARN for pulling the image from a private registry.
Sets the repository access mode for the container image, with Platform using the default public registry access and Vpc enabling access through your Amazon VPC for private ECR repositories.
Configures authentication for pulling container images from a private repository by specifying the ARN of an AWS Secrets Manager secret that holds the repository credentials.
Specifies the ARN of an AWS Secrets Manager secret that holds the credentials for accessing a private container repository, used by the SageMaker model container's image configuration.

aws_sage_maker_model.containers.inferenc.text: Specifies the name of an inference specification from a model package to use for this container when creating the SageMaker model, enabling selection among multiple inference configurations defined in the model package.

aws_sage_maker_model.containers.mode.text: Determines whether this container serves a single model ('SingleModel', the default) or is configured to host multiple models in a multi-model endpoint ('MultiModel').

aws_sage_maker_model.containers.model_da.text: Provides the model data source configuration for a SageMaker model container, specifying the S3 location (URI and data type) of the model artifact instead of using the direct ModelDataUrl field.
Defines the S3 data source used to point SageMaker at the model artifacts for a container, by specifying the S3 bucket URI and the data type (S3Prefix or S3Object) of the model data.
Specifies the compression type of the model data in Amazon S3, either 'None' or 'Gzip'.
The ARN of the SageMaker Hub content that serves as the model data source when the model is referenced from a hub.
Controls access to the S3 model data by specifying whether to accept the end-user license agreement (EULA) for the model.
Indicates whether to accept the End User License Agreement (EULA) required to access the model artifact from the specified S3 data source.
Specifies whether the S3 data source is an S3 prefix pointing to model artifacts (S3Prefix) or a manifest file that lists the model artifacts (ManifestFile).
The S3 URI that specifies the location of the model artifacts in Amazon S3 for this container, which SageMaker uses to download the model when the data source is an S3DataSource.
Specifies the S3 URL (e.g., s3://bucket/model.tar.gz) of the model artifacts used by this container definition in the SageMaker model.

aws_sage_maker_model.containers.model_pa.text: The name of the model package to use for this container, which references an existing model package registered in Amazon SageMaker Model Registry.

aws_sage_maker_model.containers.multi_mo.text: Configures this container for multi-model endpoints by setting the model cache behavior (e.g., enabling or disabling the cache of models in the container's memory).
Specifies whether SageMaker caches the model artifacts at the endpoint for a multi-model endpoint, with values 'Enabled' or 'Disabled'.

aws_sage_maker_model.tags.key.text: A tag key that, together with a tag value, attaches metadata to the SageMaker model for resource organization, cost allocation, and access control.

aws_sage_maker_model.tags.value.text: The value of a tag attached to the SageMaker model, used to store arbitrary metadata such as cost center or environment for the model.

aws_sage_maker_model_bias_job_definition.text: The numeric probability threshold value used to convert the predicted probability scores in the batch transform input dataset into binary predictions for model bias analysis.

Specifies the numeric probability threshold used for binary classification by the SageMaker Clarify model bias analysis to convert model output probabilities into predicted labels for the endpoint input.

Specifies the S3 bucket URI and local directory path where the model bias monitoring job's results are uploaded, with an optional upload mode (e.g., Continuous or EndOfJob) controlling when the data is copied.
The local directory path on the processing container where the model bias job writes its output files before they are uploaded to the specified S3 URI.
Specifies whether the monitoring output is uploaded to S3 continuously during the job or only at the end of the job, with valid values `Continuous` and `EndOfJob`.
The S3 URI where the results of the model bias monitoring job are stored as output, typically an S3 bucket and prefix path.
The key of a tag attached to the SageMaker model bias job definition, used for organizing and identifying the resource.
The value of a tag assigned to the SageMaker Model Bias Job Definition, used to categorize and manage the resource.

aws_sage_maker_model_card.content.additi.text: Specifies the Additional Information section of the model card content, providing a structured place for supplementary details about the model such as development notes, limitations, or other custom content beyond the standard overview, training, and evaluation sections.

aws_sage_maker_model_card.content.evalua.text: Provides the list of evaluation details for the model card, including each evaluation's name, observation, datasets used, and metric groups with their measured values.
Lists the datasets used for evaluating the model, indicating the data sources on which the evaluation metrics are based.
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of a SageMaker job (such as a processing job) that can be used to reproduce or reference the model evaluation results.

Provides a free-text observation about the model's evaluation results, allowing qualitative insights, caveats, or performance notes to be recorded within the evaluation details section of the SageMaker Model Card.
Stores arbitrary key-value metadata for this model evaluation detail, providing additional context that is not captured by the structured fields such as name and metric groups.
The list of metric groups for this evaluation detail, where each group contains a name and a list of metric data items that organize related evaluation metrics.
List of metric data items (name, value, and optional type/notes) within a metric group for an evaluation detail section of the SageMaker model card.
Specifies the name of a metric (e.g., 'accuracy' or 'F1 score') reported in a metric group within the model card's evaluation details.
Provides additional commentary or context about the metric data point, such as computation notes or caveats, within the SageMaker Model Card's evaluation details.
Specifies the data type of the metric value (e.g., 'Number' or 'String') for the corresponding metric data entry in the SageMaker Model Card's evaluation details.
The measured numeric or categorical result of the evaluation metric (e.g., accuracy, F1-score) recorded in the metric data group of the model card's evaluation details.
Specifies the label or name for the x-axis of a metric chart in the model card's evaluation details, used to describe the independent variable for plotted metric data.
The name of the y-axis for a metric chart, used to label the vertical axis when visualizing metric data in the model card's evaluation details.
The name of a group of related evaluation metrics (e.g., 'Accuracy' or 'Latency') within the model card's evaluation details.
Specifies a user-defined name for an evaluation detail, such as a specific evaluation run or metric set, to identify it within the model card's evaluation details list.

aws_sage_maker_model_card.content.intend.text: A free-form string that provides a detailed explanation or justification for the assigned risk rating within the intended uses section of the SageMaker model card.
Specifies the factors that influence the model's efficiency in deployment, such as hardware constraints, inference latency, throughput, or resource consumption, intended to inform model card readers.

aws_sage_maker_model_card.content.model_.text: Created_by provides the SageMaker user context (including IAM identity, user profile, and domain) of the principal who created the model package referenced in the model card's model_package_details.

Specifies the inference specification of the model package, including the container to use for inference and the inputs and outputs the model supports, as part of the model card's model package details.
Specifies the URI of the container image used for inference in the model package.
The S3 URL of the model artifacts for this container in the model package's inference specification.
The name of the model in the model card's model overview that this inference container is associated with, used to link a specific container to a model.
A list of algorithms used to train the model associated with the model package, where each item specifies the algorithm name and its approval status.
Specifies the name of the algorithm used to create the model in the corresponding source algorithm entry of the model package details in the SageMaker model card.
Specifies the S3 URI where the trained model artifacts for this source algorithm are stored within the model package details.

aws_sage_maker_model_card.content.traini.text: Specifies the optimization direction (e.g., minimize or maximize) of the objective function used during model training.
The name of the objective metric that the model training seeks to optimize, such as 'accuracy' or 'loss', as recorded in the SageMaker Model Card's training details objective function.
The objective function (e.g., loss function) used to train the model, recorded in the training details section of the SageMaker model card.
Provides free-form notes or additional context about the objective function used during model training, such as details about the loss function or optimization metric.

This object specifies the details of the SageMaker training job(s) used to train the model, including the training job name, environment, and training metrics, as part of the training details section of the model card content.
Specifies the list of hyperparameter name-value pairs used to configure the training job for the model, as recorded in the model card's training details.

The name of a hyperparameter (for example, 'learning_rate') recorded for the SageMaker training job, paired with its value in the corresponding hyper_parameters entry within the model card's training details.
The value assigned to a specific hyperparameter for the training job, where the hyperparameter name is the corresponding map key.
Specifies the hardware and software environment (e.g., instance type, GPU, OS, framework, and Python version) used during the model's SageMaker training job, for documentation in the model card.
A list of training metrics (e.g., loss, accuracy) recorded during the model training job, each containing a name and a numeric value.
The name of a specific training metric, such as accuracy or loss, recorded for the training job in the model card's training details.
Adds an optional note to a training metric in the model card, allowing you to document additional context or caveats about that metric's value and how it was measured.
The numerical value of a specific training metric (such as loss or accuracy) recorded during model training for the SageMaker model card, paired with the metric's name in the training metrics list.
Specifies the list of hyperparameter names and values that the user explicitly provided for the training job, stored as part of the training job details in the SageMaker model card.
The name of a user-provided hyperparameter used during the training job, as recorded in the model card's training details.
The value of a user-provided hyperparameter used in the training job, associated with the accompanying key in the user_provided_hyper_parameters list.
A list of user-provided training metrics (name-value pairs) that are included in the model card to document additional or custom performance measurements for the training job.
The name of a user-provided training metric, such as 'accuracy' or 'loss', recorded for the training job.
This field stores free-form notes supplied by the user for a specific training metric recorded in the model card's training job details.
The numeric value of the user-provided training metric, representing the measured result for the associated metric name.
Captures additional observations or notes about the model training process, such as insights or anomalies encountered during training.

aws_sage_maker_model_card.tags.key.text: The key part of a user-defined tag attached to the SageMaker Model Card, enabling metadata for resource organization, access control, and cost allocation.

aws_sage_maker_model_explainability_job_.text: Configures the S3 destination (S3Uri), local processing path (LocalPath), and upload mode (S3UploadMode) that determine where and how the model explainability monitoring job writes its output to Amazon S3.
The local path in the container where the model explainability job writes its output files before they are uploaded to the specified S3 URI.
Specifies the upload mode for the monitoring output to Amazon S3: 'Continuous' streams output during the job, while 'EndOfJob' uploads it after the job completes.
The S3 URI of the bucket where the model explainability monitoring job writes its output artifacts, such as analysis results and reports.
The key portion of a key-value tag attached to this SageMaker model explainability job definition, used for resource categorization and access management.

aws_sage_maker_model_package.additional_.text: Defines the Docker container images and their configurations (e.g., image URI, environment variables, and model data sources) that SageMaker uses for inference when this additional inference specification is selected.
Defines the DNS hostname for this container within the SageMaker model package's inference specification, allowing other containers in a multi-container endpoint or pipeline to address it uniquely.
Environment variables, as key-value string pairs, to configure the container for this additional inference specification.
Specifies the machine learning framework used by the model container, such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or MXNet, within an additional inference specification of the SageMaker model package.
The version of the machine learning framework (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) used to run the model in this additional inference container.
The URI of the Docker container image to use for inference when this additional inference specification is selected.
Specifies the SHA256 digest of the container image, which uniquely identifies the exact image version for the additional inference specification container.

Specifies the S3 source for the model artifacts used by this additional inference container, with an S3DataSource object defining the S3 URI and data type (e.g., S3Prefix or S3Object) as an alternative to ModelDataUrl.
Defines the S3 location (S3Uri) and data type (S3DataType) for the model data source used by the container in this additional inference specification.
Specifies the compression type (e.g., None or Gzip) for the model artifacts stored in the S3 location referenced by the model data source container.
Configures access to the model data in Amazon S3, including whether to accept the end-user license agreement (EULA) required for the model.
Indicates whether you accept the End User License Agreement (EULA) required to access the model data from the S3 source, such as for gated or licensed models.
Specifies whether the S3 data source is a prefix (S3Prefix) that points to all objects under a location or a manifest file (ManifestFile) that explicitly lists the S3 objects to use as model data.
The S3 URI of the model artifacts for the container in the additional inference specification.
The S3 URI that specifies the location of the model artifacts for the container in this additional inference specification of the SageMaker model package.

Specifies the input configuration for the container within an additional inference specification, including the data input configuration string that describes the format and shape of input data for model inference.

Specifies the data input configuration for the model container, as a JSON string that defines the input data format and shape (e.g., '{"input": [1, 3, 224, 224]}'), which the model uses to accept inference requests.
Sets the model name used by SageMaker Edge Manager to identify and package the model in this additional inference specification container for deployment to edge devices.
The description of this additional inference specification, providing details about the variant, such as its intended use or contents.
The name of this additional inference specification, which must be unique within the model package and is used to identify the specification when selecting it for a target environment.

Specifies the list of supported MIME content types (e.g., 'text/csv', 'application/json') for the corresponding additional inference specification of the SageMaker model package, defining which input formats the model can accept for inference.
Specifies the list of SageMaker instance types (e.g., ml.m5.large) that this additional inference specification supports for real-time inference endpoints.
Specifies the list of MIME types that the model can return for inference responses in this additional inference specification, such as 'text/plain' or 'application/json'.
Specifies the types of ML compute instances supported for running batch transform jobs with this additional inference specification.
Defines the container definitions (e.g., Docker image, model data source, environment variables) that make up the additional inference specification being added to the SageMaker model package.
The DNS host name for the container within the additional inference specification, used to route inference requests to the appropriate container in a multi-container endpoint.
A map of environment variable keys to values that are set in the container for the additional inference specification.
The machine learning framework (such as TensorFlow or PyTorch) that this container uses, used to configure the additional inference specification for the model package.

Specifies the version of the machine learning framework (e.g., '1.8' for PyTorch) used by the container in an additional inference specification, which SageMaker uses to select the corresponding prebuilt inference image.
The URI of the Docker container image (typically an Amazon ECR repository path) that SageMaker runs for this additional inference specification of the model package.
The SHA256 digest of the Docker image for the container; when provided, it pins the image to that exact digest in the additional inference specification being added to the SageMaker model package.
Specifies the S3 URI and S3 data type for the model artifacts used by this inference container in the additional inference specification.
Defines the S3 data source (e.g., S3Uri and S3DataType) for the model artifacts of a container within an additional inference specification being added to the SageMaker model package.

For the model artifact stored in Amazon S3, this property specifies the compression type (such as Gzip or None) that SageMaker should use when downloading and decompressing the model data for the container in the additional inference specification.
Specifies access control for the model artifact in S3, primarily including whether to accept the model's end-user license agreement (EULA) via the AcceptEula flag.
Indicates whether to accept the end-user license agreement (EULA) required for accessing this model data source from a third-party model provider.

Determines whether the S3 location contains a manifest file (ManifestFile), a list of S3 prefixes (S3Prefix), or an augmented manifest (AugmentedManifestFile), which controls how SageMaker interprets the model data.
The S3 URI of the model data that SageMaker uses to load the model for this additional inference specification container.
Specifies the Amazon S3 URL (e.g., s3://bucket/prefix/model.tar.gz) containing the model artifacts for a container in an additional inference specification of the SageMaker model package.
Specifies the model input configuration, including data input shapes and format, for the model container in the additional inference specification.

Specifies the input data configuration string (e.g., JSON describing input tensor shapes and formats) for the model container in this additional inference specification, which SageMaker uses to determine the expected input structure for inference.
Specifies the name of the model that this container is most closely associated with, used for model lineage and tracking in the SageMaker Model Registry.
A description of the additional inference specification, providing details about the purpose or distinguishing characteristics of this secondary inference configuration for the model package.
Specifies a unique name for this additional inference specification within the model package, used to identify the specification when deploying the model.
Defines the list of MIME content types (e.g., text/csv, application/json) that the additional inference specification accepts for inference requests.
The allowed Amazon EC2 instance types (e.g., ml.m5.large) for real-time inference when this additional inference specification is used.
Defines the supported MIME types for responses that the additional inference specification can produce.
Specifies the list of ML compute instance types that this additional inference specification supports for running batch transform jobs in SageMaker.

aws_sage_maker_model_package.inference_s.text: Sets the DNS hostname for the container within the inference pipeline, which is used to route requests to this specific container when multiple containers are defined in the inference specification.
Defines the environment variables to set in the inference container of the SageMaker model package, which are passed to the container at runtime to configure the inference code.
The name of the machine learning framework (such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or MXNet) used by the inference container within the SageMaker model package's inference specification.
Specifies the version of the machine learning framework (such as TensorFlow or MXNet) used in the SageMaker model container for this inference specification.
The URI of the Docker container image (typically in Amazon ECR) that SageMaker uses to run inference for this model package container.
The SHA256 digest of the Docker container image, used to uniquely identify the exact image version for this inference container in the SageMaker model package.
Specifies the Amazon S3 source of the model artifacts for this container within the inference specification, using an object that provides the S3 URI and optional data type.

Defines the Amazon S3 data source (including the S3 URI and data type such as S3Prefix or ManifestFile) from which model artifacts are loaded for this container in the SageMaker model package's inference specification.
Specifies the compression type of the model data in the S3 bucket, such as 'None' or 'Gzip', used for the container's model data source.
Specifies the access configuration for the S3 model data source, including an AcceptEula flag that indicates whether you accept the End User License Agreement for the model.
Specifies whether to accept the end-user license agreement (EULA) for the model, which is required to allow Amazon SageMaker to access and deploy the model from the specified S3 data source.
Specifies whether the S3 data source for the model artifacts is a single object ('S3Object') or a prefix ('S3Prefix') containing the model artifacts.
Specifies the S3 URI of the model artifacts in the S3 data source used by this container, from which SageMaker loads the model for inference.
The Amazon S3 URL where the model artifacts (e.g., model.tar.gz) for this inference container are stored.
Defines the input configuration for the model container, including the data input configuration (DataInputConfig) and the input mode (File or Pipe) used for inference.
Defines the model input data configuration, usually a JSON string that specifies input shape, data type, and format expected by the model during inference.

aws_sage_maker_model_package.model_packa.text: Provides the list of validation status items, each describing the name, status (e.g., InProgress, Completed, Failed), and failure reason (if any) for a validation profile or test job associated with the model package.
The reason why the model package validation failed, if applicable.

The name of a validation status item in the model package status details, identifying the specific validation job or stage (e.g., a processing job or evaluation) whose status is reported for the SageMaker model package.
The status of a model package validation job, with possible values InProgress, Completed, or Failed.

aws_sage_maker_model_package.source_algo.text: The name or Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the SageMaker algorithm used to create the model data for this source algorithm entry in the model package.
Specifies the S3 URL (e.g., s3://bucket/prefix/model.tar.gz) where the trained model artifacts for this source algorithm are stored in SageMaker Model Package registration.

aws_sage_maker_model_package.tags.key.text: The key of a tag assigned to the SageMaker model package, used for resource identification, access control, and cost allocation.

aws_sage_maker_model_package.tags.value.text: The value part of a tag attached to the SageMaker model package, providing user-defined metadata corresponding to the tag key.

aws_sage_maker_model_package.validation_.text: Specifies a list of validation profiles, each containing a profile name and a transform job definition, that define how the model package is validated.
The name of a validation profile, used to identify a specific validation job within the validation specification of an AWS SageMaker model package.

Defines the batch transform job configuration (such as input/output data sources, compute resources, and transformation settings) used to validate the SageMaker model package within a validation profile.

Specifies the batch strategy for the batch transform job used in model package validation, indicating whether the transform job sends each record as a single inference request (SingleRecord) or batches multiple records into one request (MultiRecord).
Specifies environment variables passed to the model container when the batch transform job defined in this validation profile runs to validate the model package.
Specifies the maximum number of parallel transform jobs that SageMaker can run concurrently for this transform job definition, controlling resource usage during model validation.
Specifies the maximum size of the payload, in megabytes, that a batch transform job can send to the model associated with this validation profile.
Specifies the input data source (e.g., S3 location, content type, compression type, and split type) for the batch transform job used to validate the model package.
Compression type for the input data of the batch transform job used in the model package validation profile, indicating whether the data is gzip-compressed or uncompressed (None).
The MIME type (e.g., text/csv or application/x-image) of the input data for the batch transform job that validates this model package.
Defines the location and format of the input data (e.g., S3 data source) for the batch transform job used to validate the model package within a validation profile.
Defines the S3 data source, including the S3 URI and data type, for the input data used in the transform job that validates the model package.

Specifies whether the S3 input data is interpreted as a manifest file, an S3 prefix, or an augmented manifest file, determining how SageMaker resolves the data source path for the transform job's input.
This field specifies the S3 URI of the input dataset used for the model validation transform job of the SageMaker model package.
Specifies how the input data is split for the transform job, such as Line, RecordIO, TFRecord, or None.
Specifies the Amazon S3 output location and settings for the results of a transform job used to validate a model package.
Specifies the MIME type (e.g., 'text/csv') that declares the format of the transformed output data produced by the validation transform job.
Determines how the transform job's output is assembled in Amazon S3: 'None' for separate objects per record, or 'Line' to concatenate all records into a single newline-delimited file.
Specifies the AWS KMS key ID used to encrypt the output data of the transform job that validates the model package.
Specifies the S3 URI (bucket and prefix) where the output of the validation batch transform job is stored, used by the model package's validation profile.
Specifies the ML compute instances (instance type and count) used for the batch transform job that validates the model package.
Specifies the number of ML compute instances to launch for the batch transform job during model package validation.
Specifies the ML compute instance type (e.g., ml.m5.xlarge) used by the batch transform job that validates the model package.
The AWS KMS key ID used to encrypt data on the storage volume attached to the ML compute instances running the batch transform job for validating the model package.

aws_sage_maker_model_package_group.model.text: JSON policy document that defines a resource-based access policy for the SageMaker model package group, controlling which AWS accounts or principals can use or manage the group.

aws_sage_maker_model_package_group.tags..text: The key part of an AWS key-value tag that can be attached to a SageMaker model package group for resource identification and access control.
The value of a tag key-value pair assigned to the SageMaker Model Package Group, allowing you to categorize and manage the group.

aws_sage_maker_model_quality_job_definit.text: Number between 0 and 1 that defines the threshold for converting a model's probability scores into binary labels for model quality monitoring on batch transform jobs.
Sets the probability threshold value used by the SageMaker model quality monitoring job to convert the endpoint's model probability outputs into binary predictions for computing quality metrics.
Specifies the S3 output destination for a model quality monitoring job, defining the local path in the container and the S3 URI where results are uploaded.
The local directory path on the processing instance where the model quality monitoring output is written before being uploaded to the specified S3 location.
Specifies how the monitoring output is uploaded to Amazon S3, either continuously ('Continuous') or only after the monitoring job completes ('EndOfJob').
The S3 URI that specifies the destination bucket and prefix where the model quality monitoring job's output artifacts (such as reports and statistics) are saved.

aws_sage_maker_monitoring_schedule.monit.text: Specifies the batch transform input for a SageMaker monitoring job, including the S3 data source and configuration such as the data capture destination and the time after inference when data becomes available.
The S3 URI of the destination bucket where data captured from the batch transform job is stored, used as the input source for the monitoring job.
Specifies the format of the input dataset (e.g., CSV, JSON) for the batch transform input to be monitored, enabling the monitoring job to correctly parse the data.
This object configures the CSV format for the batch transform input, including whether the first line of the dataset is treated as a header.
Indicates whether the CSV file used as the batch transform input for the monitoring job contains a header row, which affects how the monitoring job interprets the dataset columns.

Specifies the JSON format configuration for the batch transform input dataset, including a boolean 'Line' property that indicates whether each line in the file contains a single JSON object (JSON Lines format).
Indicates whether the JSON dataset is formatted as JSON Lines (one JSON object per line) rather than a single monolithic JSON object.
If set to true, this flag specifies that the monitoring job's batch transform input data is formatted as Apache Parquet.
Specifies the name of an attribute in the batch transform input dataset that contains a comma-separated list of feature names to be excluded from SageMaker monitoring analysis.
Specifies the local path in the processing container where the batch transform output files are mounted or written, which the monitoring job reads as its input.

Specifies how the monitoring batch transform job distributes input data from S3 across instances, either 'FullyReplicated' (each instance receives a full copy) or 'ShardedByS3Key' (data is sharded across instances).
Determines how the SageMaker monitoring job reads the S3 input data for batch transform, accepting either 'File' mode (data downloaded to the instance) or 'Pipe' mode (data streamed as a FIFO pipe).
Configures the SageMaker endpoint that the monitoring job watches, including the endpoint's name and the local path in the container where the captured data is stored.
The name of the SageMaker endpoint whose data is to be monitored by this monitoring job.
Specifies a JSONPath expression that identifies the features (attributes) in the endpoint input to exclude from monitoring.
The local path in the monitoring container where the endpoint input data is stored or mounted for the monitoring job to access.

Controls how the captured endpoint data is distributed across the monitoring compute instances, either as 'FullyReplicated' (each instance receives a full copy of all data) or 'ShardedByS3Key' (data is partitioned by S3 key across instances).

Specifies whether the data from the endpoint input is delivered to the monitoring job in File mode (downloaded to local disk) or Pipe mode (streamed directly), controlling how the monitoring job accesses the input data.

Defines the S3 location and upload mode used to store the results of the monitoring job's output, including the S3 URI, local path, and whether outputs are uploaded continuously or at the end of the job.
Sets the local path inside the monitoring job's container where the output is written before being uploaded to the Amazon S3 location defined in the S3Output.
Determines whether the monitoring output is uploaded to the specified S3 location continuously as the job runs or only once at the end of the monitoring job.
The S3 URI (bucket and optional prefix) where SageMaker stores the output artifacts of the monitoring job, such as statistics and constraints JSON files.

aws_sage_maker_monitoring_schedule.tags..text: The value part of a user-defined tag attached to the SageMaker monitoring schedule, used to organize and manage the resource for cost tracking and IAM policies.

aws_sage_maker_notebook_instance.acceler.text: Specifies the Elastic Inference accelerator type(s) to attach to the SageMaker notebook instance for accelerating inference workloads.

aws_sage_maker_notebook_instance.additio.text: Specifies a list of Git repository URLs or names that are cloned into the notebook instance's default SageMaker repository, allowing additional code repositories to be available in the instance.

aws_sage_maker_notebook_instance.default.text: Specifies the default Git repository (as a URL or CodeCommit reference) that SageMaker automatically clones into the notebook instance at creation, making its contents available in the instance and connecting it as the default code repository for the notebook's Git integration.

aws_sage_maker_notebook_instance.direct_.text: Determines whether the notebook instance has direct access to the internet, accepting 'Enabled' or 'Disabled', where 'Disabled' restricts the instance to resources within its VPC.

aws_sage_maker_notebook_instance.id.text: The unique identifier of the SageMaker notebook instance, which is the same as its name.

aws_sage_maker_notebook_instance.instanc.text: Configures the instance metadata service (IMDS) on the SageMaker notebook instance, including the minimum IMDS version (such as 1 or 2) that the instance must support.

Specifies the minimum version of the AWS instance metadata service (IMDS) that the SageMaker notebook instance must support (e.g., '1' or '2'), which forces the instance to use that protocol version or higher for metadata requests.
The ML compute instance type (e.g., ml.t2.medium, ml.m5.xlarge) used for the SageMaker notebook instance.

aws_sage_maker_notebook_instance.kms_key.text: The ID of an AWS KMS key used by SageMaker to encrypt the data on the notebook instance's attached EBS storage volume.

aws_sage_maker_notebook_instance.lifecyc.text: The name of a SageMaker notebook instance lifecycle configuration, which defines shell scripts that run during instance startup and shutdown.

aws_sage_maker_notebook_instance.noteboo.text: Specifies a custom name for the SageMaker notebook instance; if omitted, AWS CloudFormation generates a unique name.

aws_sage_maker_notebook_instance.platfor.text: Specifies the operating system platform for the SageMaker notebook instance, with allowed values 'Linux' (default) and 'Windows'.

aws_sage_maker_notebook_instance.role_ar.text: The IAM role ARN that SageMaker assumes to access AWS services and resources on behalf of the notebook instance.

aws_sage_maker_notebook_instance.root_ac.text: Specifies whether root access is enabled or disabled for the SageMaker notebook instance, with valid values 'Enabled' or 'Disabled'.

aws_sage_maker_notebook_instance.securit.text: Specifies the VPC security group IDs to associate with the SageMaker notebook instance for network access control.

aws_sage_maker_notebook_instance.subnet_.text: Specifies the ID of the subnet in a customer VPC where the SageMaker notebook instance is launched, enabling network isolation within a chosen subnet.

aws_sage_maker_notebook_instance.tags.text: A list of key-value pairs to associate with the SageMaker notebook instance for organizing and identifying the resource.

aws_sage_maker_notebook_instance.tags.ke.text: The key of a tag applied to the SageMaker notebook instance, used to identify and organize the resource for management and cost tracking.

aws_sage_maker_notebook_instance.tags.va.text: The value of a tag key attached to the SageMaker notebook instance, used to organize, track, and manage AWS resources for billing, access control, and operational purposes.

aws_sage_maker_notebook_instance.volume_.text: The size in gigabytes of the EBS ML storage volume attached to the SageMaker notebook instance, which can be set between 5 and 16384 GB and determines the available storage for data and code.

aws_sage_maker_notebook_instance_lifecyc.text: The computed name (identifier) of the SageMaker notebook instance lifecycle configuration, used as the CloudFormation physical resource ID.
The name of the lifecycle configuration, which uniquely identifies it within your AWS account and is used when associating the lifecycle configuration with a notebook instance.
Specifies the lifecycle hooks that run when the notebook instance is created, containing base64-encoded shell script content that executes during instance creation.
The base64-encoded shell script that SageMaker executes on the notebook instance during the creation ('onCreate') lifecycle event, allowing custom setup before the instance becomes available.
Specifies a list of lifecycle configuration scripts (each a base64-encoded shell script) that Amazon SageMaker runs when the notebook instance starts.
The shell script content that AWS SageMaker runs when the notebook instance starts, as defined in the OnStart lifecycle hook of the lifecycle configuration.

aws_sage_maker_pipeline.parallelism_conf.text: Defines the parallelism configuration for the SageMaker pipeline, including the maximum number of execution steps that can run in parallel.

aws_sage_maker_pipeline.pipeline_definit.text: Specifies the SageMaker pipeline definition, as a JSON or YAML string that describes the pipeline's steps, parameters, and configuration.

aws_sage_maker_pipeline.tags.text: A list of key-value pairs attached to an AWS SageMaker pipeline to help organize, identify, and manage it, often used for cost allocation and access control.

aws_sage_maker_pipeline.tags.key.text: The key of a tag attached to the SageMaker pipeline, used to assign metadata for organizing, identifying, and managing the pipeline resource.

aws_sage_maker_processing_job.processing.text: Indicates whether the processing input is managed by the processing application (true) rather than sourced from Amazon S3 (false).
Defines how to generate input data for the processing job by querying Athena or Redshift and storing the result in S3, according to the specified database, SQL query, and output location.

Configures an Athena dataset for the processing job input, specifying the Athena catalog, database, SQL query, query result output location, and format (e.g., PARQUET or CSV) that define the data to be processed.
The name of the AWS Glue data catalog that contains the database and table referenced by the Athena query used in this processing job's dataset definition (e.g., 'AwsDataCatalog').
The name of the Athena database used to query the dataset for this processing job's dataset definition.
The AWS KMS key ID that SageMaker uses to encrypt the Athena query results, which are stored in the S3 output location defined in the AthenaDatasetDefinition.
Specifies the compression format (e.g., GZIP, SNAPPY) applied to the Athena query results stored in the output S3 location for this dataset definition.
Specifies the data format (e.g., PARQUET, ORC, AVRO, JSON, TEXTFILE) in which the Athena query results are written to the output S3 location for the processing job.
The S3 URI (e.g., s3://bucket/path) where the results of the Athena query used to generate the dataset are written, as part of the At, denaDatasetDefinition for the processing job's dataset input.
The SQL query executed against Athena to select the dataset used as input for the SageMaker processing job.
The name of the Athena workgroup to use for the query that reads data from Athena.

Specifies how the input data is distributed across the processing job instances, either 'FullyReplicated' to give every instance a full copy of the data or 'ShardedByS3Object' to partition the S3 objects among the instances.
Specifies the input mode (File or Pipe) for the dataset definition when the processing job input is defined as a dataset, determining how data is streamed or copied to the processing container.
The local path on the processing instance where the dataset defined by the Athena or Redshift dataset definition is made available for use by the processing job.
Configures an Amazon Redshift dataset for the SageMaker processing job input by specifying the Redshift cluster, database, user, query string, and S3 output location for query results.
The identifier of the Amazon Redshift cluster that contains the dataset to be processed by the SageMaker processing job.

The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the IAM role that the Redshift cluster assumes to execute the query and write the resulting dataset to the S3 output location defined in the RedshiftDatasetDefinition.
The name of the Redshift database that contains the data to be queried for the processing job.
Specifies the Redshift database user name used to authenticate the query against the cluster for this dataset definition.
The AWS KMS key ID that Amazon SageMaker uses to encrypt the data retrieved from the Redshift query before writing it to the output S3 location.
Specifies the compression type (for example, NONE, GZIP, BZIP2, or ZSTD) applied to the output data from the Redshift query when it is stored in Amazon S3 for a SageMaker processing job.
Specifies the format (PARQUET or CSV) in which the results of the Redshift query are written to the output S3 location for this processing job's dataset definition.
Specifies the S3 URI where the results of the Redshift query are stored, from which the SageMaker Processing job reads the dataset.
SQL query that defines the data to be fetched from Amazon Redshift for processing.

The name of this processing input, which defines the input channel path inside the processing container (e.g., /opt/ml/processing/input/<input_name>) and must match the channel name expected by the processing script.
Specifies the S3 input source for the processing job, including the S3 URI, local path, data type (e.g., S3Prefix or ManifestFile), and input mode (File or Pipe).
The local path in the container instance where the S3 input data is made available for the processing job.

Specifies the compression type of the S3 input data for the processing job, either 'None' for uncompressed or 'Gzip' for gzip-compressed data, which Amazon SageMaker uses to decompress the input before processing.

Determines how the input data from S3 is distributed among the instances of the processing job: either 'FullyReplicated' (each instance gets a copy of the entire data) or 'ShardedByS3Key' (each instance gets a distinct subset of S3 objects).
The type of S3 data source, either a prefix (S3Prefix) or a manifest file (ManifestFile), used to locate the input data for the processing job.
Specifies the input mode for the S3 data source of this processing job's input channel, either 'File' or 'Pipe', which controls how the data is streamed to the processing container.
The S3 URI (e.g., s3://bucket/prefix) of the input data that SageMaker reads for this processing input.
When set to true, all output operations such as data encryption are managed by the processing job's application rather than by SageMaker; when false (the default), SageMaker manages these operations.
Configures the processing job's output to an Amazon SageMaker Feature Store, specifying the target feature group name and whether to append or overwrite existing records.
The name of the SageMaker Feature Store feature group that this processing job's output is written to and ingested into.
The unique name that identifies this processing output within the SageMaker processing job's output configuration, used to reference the output in the job's specification.
Configures the S3 destination for a processing job output, including the local path in the container and the S3 URI (and optionally the upload mode) where the output is uploaded.
The local path inside the processing container where the output data is written before being uploaded to the configured S3 output location.
Determines whether the processing job uploads output to S3 continuously during execution ('Continuous') or only after the job completes ('EndOfJob').
The S3 URI specifying the bucket and prefix where the processing job writes its output data.

aws_sage_maker_processing_job.tags.key.text: The key portion of a tag that you assign to the SageMaker processing job, used to identify, organize, and control access to the resource.

aws_sage_maker_processing_job.tags.value.text: The value of a tag applied to the SageMaker processing job, paired with the corresponding key to organize and identify AWS resources (e.g., for cost allocation or access control).

aws_sage_maker_project.service_catalog_p.text: The key that identifies a specific provisioning parameter passed to the Service Catalog product when SageMaker provisions the project.
The value for a Service Catalog provisioning parameter key, which SageMaker passes to the provisioned product to configure the project resources.

aws_sage_maker_project.tags.value.text: The value of a tag associated with the SageMaker project, used to assign metadata such as cost center or environment.

aws_sage_maker_project.template_provider.text: Specifies the CloudFormation template provider details for the SageMaker project, including the template location and configuration used to provision the project.
Specifies key-value pairs of provisioning parameters that are passed to the AWS Service Catalog product used to create the SageMaker project, controlling the configuration of the project's resources.
The name of a parameter passed to the CloudFormation template used by the SageMaker project's template provider.
Provides the value for a CloudFormation template parameter that the SageMaker project passes to the referenced CloudFormation template for provisioning.
The IAM role ARN that SageMaker assumes to create and manage the CloudFormation stack resources for this project.
The name of the CloudFormation template used by SageMaker to provision and create the project.
The S3 URL of the AWS CloudFormation template that defines the resources to provision for the SageMaker project.

aws_sage_maker_space.ownership_settings.text: Defines the ownership settings for the SageMaker Space, specifying the user profile that owns the space.

aws_sage_maker_space.ownership_settings..text: The name of the SageMaker user profile that owns this space, which is required to establish the space's owner in the ownership settings.

aws_sage_maker_space.space_display_name.text: Specifies the display name for the SageMaker Space, used to identify the space in the SageMaker Studio user interface.

aws_sage_maker_space.space_settings.app_.text: Specifies the type of SageMaker Studio app that runs in the space, such as JupyterServer or KernelGateway, determining which application interface the space launches.

aws_sage_maker_space.space_settings.code.text: Configures the idle timeout for the Code Editor app in the SageMaker Space, automatically shutting down the app after the specified number of idle minutes.
Specifies idle timeout and automatic shutdown behavior for the Code Editor application within the SageMaker space.
Configures the default instance type and SageMaker image (via a ResourceSpec) used when launching the Code Editor application within the SageMaker Space.

aws_sage_maker_space.space_settings.cust.text: The list of custom file systems (Amazon EFS or FSx for Lustre) that are mounted to the SageMaker space.
Configures an Amazon EFS file system to be attached to the SageMaker Space, specifying the file system ID used for mounting.
The unique identifier of the Amazon EFS file system that SageMaker attaches to this Studio space as a custom file system.
Specifies the FSx for Lustre file system configuration to attach to the SageMaker Space's custom file systems, identifying the file system by its unique ID.
The unique identifier of the Amazon FSx for Lustre file system that is mounted to the SageMaker Space as a custom file system.
Specifies the S3 URI (e.g., s3://bucket-name/prefix) of the S3 file system that is mounted as a custom file system in the SageMaker Space.

aws_sage_maker_space.space_settings.jupy.text: Configures the lifecycle management settings for JupyterLab apps in the SageMaker Space, including idle timeout settings that automatically stop idle apps.
Defines the idle timeout configuration for JupyterLab apps running in the SageMaker Space, controlling when idle apps are automatically shut down to save resources.
The URL of the Git repository that SageMaker clones and mounts in the JupyterLab app of the SageMaker Space.
Defines the default instance type and SageMaker image (via `instance_type` and `sagemaker_image_arn`) used when launching the JupyterLab app for the SageMaker Space.
Specifies the instance type and SageMaker image used for the default Jupyter Server app in the SageMaker space.

aws_sage_maker_space.space_settings.kern.text: The name of the AppImageConfig resource that defines the configuration (such as file system and kernel specification) for the custom image used by the kernel gateway app.
The name of the SageMaker image to be used by the kernel gateway app in the space.
Specifies the version number of the SageMaker image to use for the custom image in the kernel gateway app of the space.
The default resource specification (e.g., SageMaker image ARN and instance type) used to launch the kernel gateway app for the SageMaker space.

aws_sage_maker_space.space_settings.spac.text: This object configures the Amazon EBS storage settings for the SageMaker Studio space, including the EBS volume size in gigabytes via the nested EBS storage settings.
Specifies the size of the Amazon EBS volume, in gigabytes, allocated to the SageMaker Space's storage settings.

aws_sage_maker_space.space_sharing_setti.text: Specifies the sharing settings for the SageMaker Space by providing the ARN of a SageMaker resource (e.g., a project) with which the space is shared.
Defines whether the SageMaker Studio space is private (only the owner) or shared with other users, with allowed values Private and Shared.

aws_sage_maker_space.tags.key.text: The key of a user-defined tag to assign to the SageMaker Space, used for categorizing, cost tracking, and access control on this AWS resource.

aws_sage_maker_space.tags.value.text: The tag value (the variable part of a key-value pair) for a tag attached to the SageMaker Space, used for metadata management and cost allocation.

aws_sage_maker_space.url.text: The URL used to access the SageMaker Studio space in the web interface.

aws_sage_maker_studio_lifecycle_config.t.text: The key of a tag assigned to the SageMaker Studio Lifecycle Configuration resource, used to organize and identify it within AWS.
The value component of a tag assigned to the SageMaker Studio Lifecycle Configuration, used to categorize and manage the resource.

aws_sage_maker_trial_component.tags.key.text: The key of a tag applied to the SageMaker trial component, used to categorize resources for cost allocation and management.

aws_sage_maker_trial_component.tags.valu.text: The value of a tag applied to the SageMaker trial component, forming a key-value pair used to organize, identify, and manage the resource.

aws_sage_maker_user_profile.tags.key.text: The key of a user-defined tag attached to the SageMaker User Profile, used for cost allocation, environment identification, or other organizational metadata.

aws_sage_maker_user_profile.user_setting.text: Configures the idle timeout settings for the Code Editor application, including whether automatic shutdown is enabled and the maximum idle time in minutes before the app is stopped.
Specifies the idle timeout and lifecycle management settings for the Code Editor application in the user profile, controlling when the app enters an idle state or is shut down.
The name of the SageMaker AppImageConfig resource that specifies the container configuration (e.g., environment variables and file system settings) for this custom image used in the Code Editor app.
The name of the custom Docker image to use for the SageMaker Studio Code Editor app, which should correspond to an image available in an Amazon ECR repository.

Specifies the version number of the custom SageMaker image to be used for the Code Editor application in the user profile, allowing you to pin a specific image version when multiple versions are available.
Specifies the default compute instance type and SageMaker image (via ARN) used when launching the Code Editor app for this user profile in SageMaker Studio.
Specifies a list of custom file system configurations (such as Amazon EFS or FSx for Lustre) that the user profile can mount.

Defines Amazon Elastic File System (EFS) settings for a custom file system attached to the SageMaker user profile, including the EFS file system ID (FileSystemId) and the mount path (FileSystemPath) within the file system.
The unique identifier of the Amazon EFS file system to mount for the SageMaker user profile's custom file system configuration.
Specifies the path within the Amazon EFS file system that is mounted and made accessible to the SageMaker user profile, defining the directory to mount for that user.
Specifies the FSx for Lustre file system configuration to attach and mount in the user's private SageMaker workspace, including the file system ID and mount path.
The unique identifier of the FSx for Lustre file system to mount for the SageMaker Studio user profile.

The file system path (e.g., a directory) inside the FSx for Lustre file system that SageMaker mounts for the user profile, defined in the FSxLustreFileSystemConfig of the custom file system configuration.
The absolute path (e.g., '/home/user/mybucket') where the S3 bucket is mounted in the user's SageMaker environment.
Specifies the S3 URI (bucket and optional key prefix) of the Amazon S3 file system that SageMaker mounts for the user profile's custom file system configuration.
Specifies the custom POSIX user ID (UID) and group ID (GID) that the Jupyter server process runs as within this SageMaker User Profile.
The numeric group ID (GID) that SageMaker uses to set filesystem ownership and permissions for the user's JupyterServer or KernelGateway apps when a custom POSIX user configuration is enabled.
Specifies the numeric POSIX user identifier (UID) that SageMaker uses for the execution environment when this custom POSIX user configuration is enabled.
Defines the idle-timeout and lifecycle policy for JupyterLab apps in the user profile, automatically shutting down apps that are idle for a configured period.
Specifies the idle timeout and related configuration that determines when an idle JupyterLab app in SageMaker Studio is automatically shut down for this user profile.
The URL of the Git repository to be associated with the JupyterLab app for the SageMaker user profile, allowing it to be accessed within Studio.
The name of the AppImageConfig that specifies the compute and environment configuration for the custom image used in the JupyterLab app.
The name of the custom SageMaker image to use for JupyterLab apps in this user profile, such as an ECR image name or SageMaker image alias.
Specifies the version number of the custom SageMaker image to use for the JupyterLab application in this user profile.

Defines the default instance type and SageMaker image (via `InstanceType` and `SageMakerImageArn`) used when launching the user's JupyterLab applications, serving as the fallback environment for all JupyterLab sessions started under this user profile.
Specifies the default instance type, EBS volume size, and lifecycle configuration used when launching the Jupyter Server app for this user profile.
The name of the AppImageConfig that defines the kernel gateway app configuration for the custom image in the SageMaker user profile's kernel gateway app settings.
The name of the custom SageMaker image to use for the kernel gateway app in the user profile's kernel gateway settings.
The version number of the SageMaker image specified by the ImageName in the same custom image entry; if omitted, SageMaker uses the latest version of that image.
Specifies the default instance type and SageMaker image configuration used when a kernel gateway app is started for this user profile.
Sets the default size in gigabytes of the Amazon EBS storage volume that SageMaker provisions for a user's Studio space.
Specifies the maximum size in gigabytes for an Amazon EBS volume that can be attached to a SageMaker Studio space for this user profile.
The name of the SageMaker image for which the specified version aliases are hidden in the Studio web portal settings of the user profile.
Specifies a list of SageMaker image version aliases that are hidden from the user in the SageMaker Studio web portal, preventing the user from using those image versions in the Studio interface.

aws_sage_maker_workforce.tags.key.text: The key (name) of a tag attached to the SageMaker workforce, used to organize and identify the resource.

aws_sage_maker_workforce.tags.value.text: Defines a value for a tag attached to the SageMaker Workforce resource, allowing you to categorize and manage the workforce with custom metadata for cost tracking, access control, and operational governance.

aws_sage_maker_workteam.description.text: A description of the SageMaker work team that provides details about the team's purpose or composition.

aws_sage_maker_workteam.id.text: The unique identifier for the SageMaker work team, which is set to the work team's name and is used for state tracking in Terraform.

aws_sage_maker_workteam.member_definitio.text: Defines the list of workers for the SageMaker work team, where each member definition specifies either an Amazon Cognito user pool or an OIDC identity provider to grant worker access.
Configures the Amazon Cognito user group that is granted access to this work team by specifying the cognito user pool, client app, and user group for the member definition.
The client ID of the Amazon Cognito app client used to authenticate members of the SageMaker workteam.
