Specifies a single named query argument (query parameter) in the request URI to inspect for SQL injection patterns, where the argument name is given in the 'Name' property of this object.
The name of the single query argument in the web request that AWS WAF inspects for SQL injection patterns.

In a SQL injection match statement, this specifies the behavior when the URI fragment is absent from the request, accepting 'MATCH' to treat the request as matching or 'NO_MATCH' to treat it as not matching.
Instructs WAF to use the request's URI path (the part of the URL after the host, excluding the query string) as the target for the SQL injection match statement's pattern matching.
A list of text transformations (such as URL_DECODE, HTML_ENTITY_DECODE, or LOWERCASE) that AWS WAF applies to the inspection target before matching it against SQL injection signatures.
The priority setting for this pre-parse text transformation, which determines the order in which it is applied relative to other pre-parse text transformations in the list.
Specifies the transformation type (e.g., NONE, URL_DECODE, LOWERCASE, HTML_ENTITY_DECODE) applied to the request component before the SQL injection parser attempts to match patterns.
Controls the sensitivity level of the SQL injection match statement, with 'HIGH' (the default) detecting a broader range of SQL injection attempts and 'LOW' matching only the most common patterns.

List of text transformations (each with a priority and a transformation type such as URL_DECODE or LOWERCASE) that are applied to the web request content before the SQL injection match statement evaluates it.
Determines the order in which this text transformation is applied relative to other transformations in the same rule, with lower numbers executed first and each priority value required to be unique.
Specifies the type of text transformation to apply to the web request before inspecting for SQL injection patterns, such as URL_DECODE, LOWERCASE, HTML_ENTITY_DECODE, COMPRESS_WHITE_SPACE, or NONE.

aws_wafv2_web_acl.rules.statement.xss_ma.text: Defines the criteria for inspecting web requests for cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks, including the part of the request to inspect (e.g., body, query string) and any text transformations to apply.
Specifies the part of the web request (such as a header, the body, or all query arguments) that the XSS match statement inspects for cross-site scripting patterns.
Configures the XSS match statement to inspect all query string arguments in the request, rather than a specific query argument.
Configures the rule to inspect the body of the incoming HTTP request (with optional control over oversize handling) when evaluating the XSS match statement.
Determines how AWS WAF handles the request body when its size exceeds the limit that WAF can inspect, with allowed values CONTINUE, MATCH, or NO_MATCH.

Specifies how AWS WAF inspects cookies in the web request for the XSS match statement, including the match scope (all, key, or value), the action to take on oversized cookie components, and either all cookies or a named subset of cookies to match.
Determines which cookies to inspect by specifying all, a list of included cookie names, or a list of excluded cookie names.
A boolean that when true makes the cookie match pattern match all cookies in the request, causing the XSS rule to inspect every cookie header for cross-site scripting patterns.
Specifies the names of cookies to exclude from the XSS inspection when the field to match is the request's cookies, so that all cookies except the listed ones are inspected.
Lists the exact cookie names to inspect in the XSS match statement, restricting the rule's cookie evaluation to only those specified cookies.

For an XSS match statement inspecting cookies, this field determines the cookie inspection scope: ALL inspects all cookies, KEY_PREFIX inspects only cookies whose names begin with a prefix defined in the match pattern, and COUNT merely counts the matching cookies instead of inspecting their contents.
Specifies how AWS WAF handles a web request when the cookies in the request are too large to be fully inspected by the XSS match statement, with allowed values CONTINUE, MATCH, or NO_MATCH.
Specifies a sequence of header names that the request must contain in the exact order given, enabling the XSS match statement to evaluate the presence and ordering of HTTP headers.
Specifies how AWS WAF handles an XSS match statement when the header being evaluated for order is larger than the maximum allowed size, with options CONTINUE, MATCH, or NO_MATCH.

In an XSS match statement, configures the set of HTTP request headers to inspect, defining which headers to match (all, included, or excluded), the part of the header (key or value) to evaluate, and the oversize handling behavior.
Specifies which HTTP headers the XSS match statement inspects, by matching all headers, only a list of included header names, or all headers except a list of excluded header names.
A boolean that, when true, causes the header match pattern to match all header values in the request.
The list of HTTP header names to exclude from the XSS inspection when the rule's field-to-match is a set of headers, so that those headers are not examined for cross-site scripting patterns.
The names of the request headers to include in the XSS match inspection, limiting the web request inspection to only the specified headers.

In an AWS WAFv2 web ACL rule's XSS match statement, this field determines whether the XSS pattern is applied to the combined values of the selected headers (ALL) or to the header names themselves (KEY).
Specifies how AWS WAF handles requests when the headers being inspected are larger than the maximum header size limit, with valid values CONTINUE, MATCH, or NO_MATCH.
Specifies that the request is matched against the client's JA3 TLS fingerprint, using the FallbackBehavior property to determine the match result when the fingerprint is unavailable.
Determines whether requests that lack a JA3 fingerprint (e.g., non-TLS traffic) are treated as matching (MATCH) or not matching (NO_MATCH) this XSS statement's field-to-match condition.
Specifies the JA4 TLS fingerprint field to match against in an XSS match statement, with a fallback behavior that determines how AWS WAF handles requests when the JA4 fingerprint is not available.
Specifies how the rule treats requests that don't have a JA4 fingerprint (such as non-TLS traffic), with MATCH causing the rule to match those requests and NO_MATCH causing it not to match them.

Specifies inspection of the request's JSON body for cross-site scripting patterns within an XSS match statement, including configuration for the match scope and how to handle invalid or incomplete JSON payloads.
Specifies how AWS WAF should handle a request whose body is not valid JSON when inspecting it for XSS, treating it as either a match (MATCH) or not a match (NO_MATCH).
Defines which parts of the JSON request body to inspect for cross-site scripting, either all JSON content or a set of included JSON paths via the All or IncludedPaths properties.
When set (as an empty structure), causes the WAF XSS match rule to inspect all fields in the JSON body, rather than only the paths specified in match_pattern.included_paths.
Specifies the list of JSON paths (for example, /foo/bar) within the request body that AWS WAF inspects for cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks.
Determines which part of the JSON request body (all, keys, or values) is inspected for cross-site scripting (XSS) signatures when the match field is a JSON body.
Specifies how AWS WAF handles a JSON body that exceeds the maximum size limit during inspection, with values CONTINUE, MATCH, or NO_MATCH.
Specifies that the XSS match statement should inspect the HTTP request method (e.g., GET or POST) as the part of the web request to match against.
Inspect the entire query string of the web request for cross-site scripting (XSS) attack patterns.
Specifies that AWS WAF inspects a single HTTP header in the web request by its name, for the XSS match evaluation.
The name of the HTTP header to match in the request, such as 'User-Agent' or 'Referer', used when the XSS match statement's field to match is set to a single header.
Specifies the name of a single query string argument to inspect in the web request for XSS matching.
The name of the query argument (for example, 'username') that the XSS match statement inspects for cross-site scripting patterns.
When set, this field makes the XSS match statement inspect the URI fragment (the part of the request URI following the '#') for cross-site scripting patterns.
Determines how AWS WAF treats a web request when the URI fragment is missing (e.g., matches if 'MATCH' or does not match if 'NO_MATCH') for the XSS match statement's field inspection.
Instructs the WAF rule to inspect the URI path of the web request, which is the part of the URL after the hostname and before the query string.
The list of text transformation objects applied to the web request before AWS WAF parses it for cross-site scripting (XSS) attack signatures.
The unique integer that determines the order in which AWS WAF applies this text transformation relative to other transformations in the same XSS match statement, with lower values processed first.
Specifies the type of text transformation to apply to the web request before evaluating the XSS match condition, such as URL_DECODE, HTML_ENTITY_DECODE, or LOWERCASE.

Specifies the ordered text transformations to apply to the inspected web request content before evaluating the XSS match condition, enabling normalization such as lowercase conversion or HTML entity decoding.

The numeric priority that determines the order in which AWS WAF applies this text transformation within the XSS match statement, with lower values processed first and each priority required to be unique among the rule's text transformations.
Specifies the type of text transformation to apply, such as LOWERCASE or URL_DECODE, before evaluating the request content against the XSS match statement.

aws_wafv2_web_acl.rules.visibility_confi.text: Determines whether AWS WAF records metrics and sampled requests for this rule, including the CloudWatch metric name and whether sampled requests are enabled.
When true, AWS WAFv2 publishes the rule's metrics to Amazon CloudWatch, allowing you to monitor the rule's activity and performance.
For a rule in an AWS WAFv2 web ACL, this specifies the unique name of the CloudWatch metric generated for that rule's traffic, enabling per-rule monitoring in CloudWatch.
Indicates whether AWS WAF should store a sample of web requests that match the rule's criteria, allowing inspection and analysis of sampled requests.

aws_wafv2_web_acl.tags.text: A list of key-value pairs to tag the web ACL for cost allocation, access control, and resource identification, where each object contains a Key and Value.

aws_wafv2_web_acl.tags.key.text: The key of a tag assigned to a WAFv2 Web ACL for cost allocation and resource identification.

aws_wafv2_web_acl.tags.value.text: The value of a user-defined tag key attached to the Web ACL, used to store arbitrary metadata for identifying, organizing, and managing the resource.

aws_wafv2_web_acl.visibility_config.clou.text: Indicates whether AWS WAF should publish metrics for this web ACL to Amazon CloudWatch, enabling you to view and analyze traffic patterns and rule performance in CloudWatch.

aws_wafv2_web_acl.visibility_config.metr.text: The name of the CloudWatch metric that AWS WAF publishes for the web ACL's visibility configuration.

aws_wafv2_web_acl.visibility_config.samp.text: Indicates whether AWS WAF should store a sample of web requests that match the web ACL's rules for inspection and analysis.

aws_wafv2_web_aclassociation.resource_ar.text: The ARN of the AWS resource (such as an Application Load Balancer, API Gateway, or Amazon CloudFront distribution) that this WAFv2 web ACL is being associated with.

aws_wafv2_web_aclassociation.web_aclarn.text: The ARN of the AWS WAF v2 web ACL to associate with the specified resource.

aws_well_architected_profile.profile_que.text: The unique identifier of a question from a Well-Architected lens that is included in the profile.
Specifies the IDs of the choices selected for a question, defining the answer(s) included in the profile for that question.

aws_well_architected_profile.tags.key.text: The user-defined key of a tag attached to the Well-Architected Profile, used to organize and identify the profile in AWS Well-Architected.

aws_well_architected_profile.tags.value.text: The value of a tag assigned to the AWS Well-Architected profile, used to identify, organize, or manage the profile.

aws_well_architected_review_template.tag.text: The tag key that, along with its associated value, forms a user-defined tag applied to the AWS Well-Architected Review Template to facilitate resource categorization and cost tracking.
The value part of a key-value tag attached to the Well-Architected review template, used to organize and manage the template resource.

aws_well_architected_workload.tags.key.text: Defines the key (name) of a tag attached to the Well-Architected workload, used to organize, identify, and control access to the workload resource.

aws_well_architected_workload.tags.value.text: The value of a user-defined tag key applied to the AWS Well-Architected workload, used for metadata, cost allocation, or resource management.

aws_wisdom_aiagent.aiagent_arn.text: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that uniquely identifies the Wisdom AI agent.

aws_wisdom_aiagent.aiagent_id.text: The unique identifier assigned by AWS to this AI agent resource in Amazon Wisdom.

aws_wisdom_aiagent.assistant_arn.text: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Wisdom assistant associated with this AI agent, automatically assigned by the service.

aws_wisdom_aiagent.assistant_id.text: The assistant_id specifies the unique identifier of the Amazon Connect Wisdom assistant with which this AI agent is associated.

aws_wisdom_aiagent.configuration.text: The configuration object defines the AI agent's operational behavior and settings, with its structure varying by the agent's type (e.g., self-service, answer generation, automated, or manual) within Amazon Q in Connect (Wisdom).

aws_wisdom_aiagent.configuration.answer_.text: This object configures the AI agent's answer recommendation behavior, specifying model and prompt settings for generating suggested responses to customer queries.
The unique identifier of the Amazon Bedrock guardrail applied during answer generation to filter or moderate the agent's output.
The identifier of the Amazon Q in Connect AI Prompt resource used to generate answers for the AI agent's answer recommendation configuration.

Defines the list of association configurations, each specifying an association type (such as a user segment or knowledge base) and its configuration data, to scope the answer recommendation AI agent's behavior.

Specifies the configuration data for a knowledge base association in an answer recommendation AI agent, including content tag filters, a maximum result limit, and an optional override of the knowledge base search type.

Specifies a tag filter (with a tag key and tag value, compared using an equals operator) that restricts the knowledge base content used by the AI agent for answer recommendations to only those items matching the given tag.
A list of tag conditions that must all be satisfied (logical AND) for a knowledge-base content chunk to be eligible for retrieval by the AI agent.
The tag key that must be present on a content item for it to match this and-condition in the Wisdom AI agent's knowledge base association content tag filter.
Specifies the tag value that must match in the AND condition of the content tag filter used to associate knowledge base content for the answer recommendation AI agent configuration.

Defines a list of tag-based conditions that are combined with OR logic, where a knowledge base content item is included in the AI agent's context if it satisfies any one of the specified tag key-value pairs.
The list of tag conditions that must all match (AND logic) within a given OR branch of the content tag filter, used to determine which knowledge base content is associated with the AI agent.
The tag key that a content document must have for this condition to be true, used in the content tag filter for the knowledge base association in the AI agent's answer recommendation configuration.
Defines the tag value that must be matched (along with its key) by a content tag filter condition to include or exclude knowledge base content for the AI agent's answer recommendations.
Defines a tag condition used to filter knowledge base content for the AI agent's answer recommendation, requiring a content tag that matches a specified key and value.
The tag key that must match the content's tags for the knowledge base content to be included in the association configuration used by the answer recommendation AI agent.
The tag value that must match a content tag for the content to be included in the association when filtering knowledge base content by tag conditions.
Specifies a single tag condition (containing a key and optionally a value) that filters knowledge base content by a specific tag for the AI agent's answer recommendation association.
The content tag key that the tag condition evaluates, used to filter which knowledge base content is associated with the AI agent for answer recommendations.
The tag value used in a content tag filter to match against knowledge base content tags when associating a knowledge base with a Wisdom AI agent's answer recommendation configuration.
Specifies the maximum number of knowledge base search results to retrieve when the AI agent generates an answer recommendation.
Overrides the default knowledge base search type (e.g., semantic or hybrid) used by the associated knowledge base when generating answer recommendations from the AI agent.
The unique identifier of the associated resource (such as a knowledge base) that the AI agent links to for generating answer recommendations in this configuration.
The type of the associated resource (for example, a knowledge base) that the AI agent can use to generate answer recommendations.
Specifies the unique identifier of the AI prompt used to generate intent labels for the answer recommendation configuration of the Wisdom AI agent.
Specifies the language and regional locale (such as en-US) that the answer recommendation AI agent uses to generate and deliver responses.
Specifies the identifier of the AI prompt used to reformulate or clarify user queries before the system generates answer recommendations.

aws_wisdom_aiagent.configuration.case_su.text: This object provides the AWS Wisdom AI agent configuration for case summarization, controlling settings like whether the agent is enabled and whether it includes conversation transcripts in its summaries.
The unique identifier of the Amazon Bedrock guardrail used to enforce content and safety policies for the case summarization AI agent.
The ID of the Wisdom AI Prompt that the case summarization AI agent uses to generate case summaries.
Specifies the locale (such as en-US) that the case summarization AI agent uses when generating case summaries, controlling the language and regional format of the output.

aws_wisdom_aiagent.configuration.email_g.text: Contains the configuration parameters for the email generative answer AI agent, defining how the agent generates answers for email interactions.

This field specifies the list of associations (each containing an association type and resource identifier) that the email generative answer AI agent uses to source contextual knowledge, such as linked knowledge bases, when composing responses.

Provides the concrete payload for an association configuration, such as a knowledge base identifier when the association type is a knowledge base or an integration identifier when the type is an integration.

Specifies the configuration data for associating an Amazon Q in Connect (Wisdom) knowledge base with the AI agent's email generative answer association, including the knowledge base ID and any applicable content filter settings.
Specifies a tag-based filter (with logical AND/OR conditions) that restricts which documents in the associated knowledge base are eligible for use by the AI agent when generating responses.

Specifies a list of tag conditions that must all be met for knowledge base content to match in the content tag filter, applying a logical AND across the criteria in the association configuration data.
The tag key in an AND condition used to filter knowledge base content for association with the AI agent.
The tag value that knowledge base content must match for the and-condition in the content tag filter used for association with the email generative answer AI agent configuration.

This field specifies a list of tag-based conditions in the content tag filter used by the knowledge base association configuration for the email generative answer AI agent, such that the filter matches content if any single condition in the list is satisfied.

This list defines tag key-value conditions that must all match (AND logic) within a single OR condition group, used to filter which knowledge base content is eligible for the AI agent's email generative answer configuration.
The key of a content tag used in an and-condition within an or-conditions group of the knowledge base association's content tag filter, which controls which content is associated with the AI agent.

In the email generative answer AI agent configuration's knowledge base association, this value sets the tag value checked by this and-condition of the content tag filter to decide whether a content item matches the filter.
Defines a tag key and value condition that content must match to be included in the knowledge base association for the email generative answer AI agent configuration.
The tag key that must match a content tag to include the content in the knowledge base association for this OR condition.
The exact tag value that content must have to match the tag condition and be included in the knowledge base association for the AI agent's email generative answer configuration.
Specifies the tag key and value that a content item must match in order to be included by the content tag filter within the knowledge base association configuration of the AI agent.
The tag key used in the tag condition to filter knowledge base content for this email generative answer AI agent configuration.
The value of the tag condition used to filter content from the associated knowledge base in the email generative answer AI agent configuration.
Specifies the maximum number of knowledge base search results to retrieve and use when generating an email response from an AI agent.
Specifies the search type (e.g., 'SEMANTIC' or 'HYBRID') that overrides the default knowledge base search type for the associated knowledge base in the email generative answer AI agent configuration.
The unique identifier of the associated AWS resource (such as a Wisdom knowledge base) that is linked to this email generative answer AI agent configuration.
Specifies the type of association (e.g., `KNOWLEDGE_BASE`) for the association configuration, indicating how the associated resource (such as a knowledge base) should be used with the AI agent.
The identifier of the AI prompt that the email generative answer configuration of this Wisdom AI agent uses to generate email reply content.
Specifies the ID of the AI prompt used to reformulate customer email queries before passing them to the underlying generative model for answering.
The locale (e.g., 'en-US') that specifies the language and regional conventions used by the email generative answer AI agent when producing responses.

aws_wisdom_aiagent.configuration.email_o.text: Defines the topic and the maximum number of email threads to consider when the AI agent generates an overview of an email conversation, used for the EMAIL_OVERVIEW agent type.
Specifies the unique identifier of the Amazon Q in Connect AI prompt used to generate email overviews in the email overview AI agent configuration.
Specifies the locale (e.g., en-US) that the email overview AI agent uses to determine the language and regional format for its generated summaries.

aws_wisdom_aiagent.configuration.email_r.text: This object controls how the Wisdom AI agent composes email responses, including the prompt template that guides the content and style of the generated email reply.
Specifies the association configurations that link the email response AI agent to knowledge bases, which the agent uses to retrieve information when composing email responses.
Defines the resource association data (e.g., the knowledge base ID when the association type is KNOWLEDGE_BASE) for the email response AI agent's association configurations.

Contains the association-specific settings that link a knowledge base to the Wisdom AI agent for use with email response configurations, defining how the agent accesses and uses the knowledge base content.
Defines the tag-based criteria that select which knowledge base content is associated with the AI agent's email response configuration, filtering content by its tag metadata.
Specifies a list of content tag conditions that must all be satisfied (logical AND) to include associated knowledge base content in the AI agent's email response configuration.
The tag key used to filter knowledge base content, where content is included only if it matches this key along with its paired value in the and_conditions list.

The tag value that must match a content tag (along with the condition's key) in a knowledge base for content to be considered in the AI agent's email response association, as part of an AND condition in the content tag filter.
Defines the OR list of tag conditions used by the content tag filter to include knowledge-base content that matches any one of the specified tag key-value pairs.
Specifies a list of tag-based conditions that must all be satisfied (logical AND) within a single OR group, used to filter which knowledge base content is associated with the AI agent.
The tag key used in an And condition of a content tag filter that governs whether knowledge base content is associated with the email response configuration of the Wisdom AI agent.
The tag value to match in an AND condition of the content tag filter, used to select knowledge base content for the email response AI agent association based on tag key-value pairs.

A single tag condition that specifies a content tag key, value, and optional comparison operator, used within the OR conditions of the knowledge base association content tag filter for the AI agent's email response configuration.
Specifies the tag key that must match for a content tag condition in the OR-based content tag filter, used to control which knowledge base content is associated with the email response AI agent.

For a tag condition within an or-condition group of a knowledge base association's content tag filter in an AI agent's email response configuration, this value specifies the tag value that content must match to be included.
Defines the tag condition used to match content in the associated knowledge base, determining which tagged articles are eligible for the AI agent's email response generation.
The tag key that must be present on knowledge base content for the content to be associated with this agent configuration's email response behavior.
Specifies the tag value that must match a content item's tag for the knowledge base association content filter in the email response AI agent configuration.
The maximum number of knowledge base search results to return for this association configuration when the AI agent retrieves information from the attached knowledge base.
Overrides the search type used for the attached knowledge base (e.g., SEMANTIC or HYBRID) when the AI agent queries it, taking precedence over the knowledge base's default search type.
The unique identifier of the specific resource (such as a knowledge base) to associate with the email response AI agent configuration.
Specifies the type of the associated resource in an association configuration for a Wisdom email response AI agent, such as a knowledge base, determining which external resources the agent can use.
The ID of the AI prompt used to reformulate a customer's email query into a search query for retrieving relevant knowledge in the Amazon Q Business (Wisdom) email response configuration.
The unique identifier of the AI prompt that defines the email response behavior for the Wisdom AI agent.
The locale (e.g., en-US) that determines the language and regional formatting used by the AI agent when composing email responses.

aws_wisdom_aiagent.configuration.manual_.text: This object defines the manual search AI agent's configuration, including the answer generation settings that specify the model type and prompt template used for generating responses.
Specifies the identifier of the AI guardrail that constrains or filters the generated answers in the manual search AI agent configuration.
Specifies the unique identifier of the Amazon Wisdom AI prompt used for generating answers within this manual search AI agent configuration.
Defines the list of associations (such as knowledge bases) that the manual search AI agent uses to retrieve information from those sources.
Specifies the configuration data for an association, such as content tags that filter knowledge base documents used by the manual search AI agent.
This object contains data details used when associating a knowledge base with the manual search AI agent, including an optional content tag filter and the maximum number of search results to return.
For knowledge base associations in a manual search AI agent, this object defines tag-based filter conditions that determine which content is eligible for association and use by the agent.
A list of tag key-value conditions, all of which must match the content tags for the knowledge base to be associated with the AI agent’s manual search configuration.
The tag key used in an AND condition to filter knowledge base content for the AI agent's manual search configuration.
The value of a content tag condition used to filter knowledge base associations, where multiple conditions in the same and_conditions array must all match (logical AND).
Defines a list of tag conditions (each with a key and value) used to filter knowledge base content; content matching any of the conditions in the list is included for the AI agent's manual search.
The list of tag key-value conditions that are ANDed together within each OR group to filter knowledge base content by tags for the manual search AI agent.
Specifies the tag key that content in the knowledge base must have (along with a matching tag value) to be included by this and-condition within the manual search AI agent's content tag filter.
The tag value to match when filtering knowledge base content by tags, within an AND condition of a manual search AI agent configuration.

Represents a single tag condition within the OR list of the content tag filter, used to match knowledge base content by a specific tag key and value for the AI agent's manual search association configuration.
The tag key that must match on knowledge base content for it to be associated with the AI agent, evaluated within an OR group of tag conditions in the content tag filter.
The value attribute of a tag condition, specifying the tag value that content must match to be included in the manual search AI agent's knowledge base association.
Specifies the tag key and optional value (or operator) that knowledge base content must match for it to be associated with the AI agent's manual search configuration.
Identifies the tag key that the content tag filter uses to include or exclude knowledge base content for the manual search AI agent configuration.
Specifies the value of a content tag that must be matched for content in the associated knowledge base to be included in the manual search AI agent's search results.
The maximum number of knowledge base search results to return when the manual search AI agent executes a search.
Overrides the search type (e.g., HYBRID or SEMANTIC) used for querying the associated knowledge base in this association configuration.
The unique identifier of the knowledge base (or other data source) associated with this manual search AI agent configuration.
Determines the kind of resource to associate with the manual search AI agent, such as 'KNOWLEDGE_BASE' to reference a knowledge base as the search source.
Specifies the locale (e.g., en-US) for the manual search AI agent, determining the language used to interpret user queries and generate responses.

aws_wisdom_aiagent.configuration.note_ta.text: Configuration for the note-taking AI agent, which controls how the agent automatically generates conversation-based notes (such as a note-to-self) for Wisdom users.
Specifies the locale (such as en-US) that the note-taking AI agent uses to generate and format its notes.
The ID of the guardrail attached to the note-taking AI agent configuration, used to enforce safety and content filtering.
The unique identifier of the AI prompt that defines the note-taking behavior for the AI agent configuration.

aws_wisdom_aiagent.configuration.orchest.text: This block specifies the configuration for an orchestration-type Wisdom agent, including the orchestration prompt and the identifier of the agent used to orchestrate other AI agents.
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Amazon Connect instance that this orchestration AI agent configuration is associated with, used to identify the Connect instance the agent operates within.
The locale for the orchestration AI agent configuration, specifying the language and region (such as 'en-US') used for agent interactions.
The ID of the AI guardrail that defines topic policies and restrictions applied to the orchestrated actions of the Amazon Q Wisdom AI agent.
The ID of the Amazon Wisdom AI prompt used to define the orchestration behavior for the AI agent's orchestration configuration.

Defines the list of tool configurations for the orchestration AI agent, specifying which external tools (such as Salesforce or custom tools) the agent can invoke and their type-specific settings (like Salesforce search mode or the tool's identifier).

In the orchestration AI agent configuration, this field is a dynamic map of key-value annotations attached to each tool configuration, supplying supplementary metadata or guidance for the Wisdom AI agent to reference when using the tool.
The human-readable description of a tool that the Wisdom orchestration AI agent can use, which helps the agent understand the tool's purpose and decide when to invoke it.
The JSON Schema that defines the structure and validation of the arguments the AI agent should generate when invoking the corresponding tool in the orchestration configuration.
The instruction object that tells the orchestration AI agent the intended usage of a particular tool, including any behavioral guidance or constraints.
Provides example user queries or interactions used as few-shot demonstrations to guide the AI agent's tool invocation behavior.
The instruction text that directs how the AI agent should use a specific tool in the orchestrated configuration.
Defines a list of output filters applied to a tool's response within the orchestration AI agent configuration, controlling which portions of the tool output are retained for the agent's use.
Specifies a JSONPath expression that filters or extracts a subset of a tool's output returned during agent orchestration, so the AI agent uses only the relevant data.
Configures how the AWS Wisdom AI agent's output filter selects, formats, or transforms results returned by a tool in the orchestration configuration before they are used by the agent.
Overrides the default variable name used for a tool's output within the output filter's output configuration, enabling the agent to reference the result via a custom variable name.
The output schema for a tool in the orchestration configuration, defining the expected JSON structure of tool results so the AI agent can interpret and process them correctly.
Defines a list of input parameter overrides that the orchestration AI agent uses when invoking a configured tool, allowing fixed values to replace or augment the agent-generated tool arguments.
The JSONPath expression used to select the specific input property of the tool that will be overridden by the configured replacement value.
The value to substitute for a tool's input parameter when the orchestration AI agent configuration overrides that parameter's default value.

The constant property sets a fixed literal value that is passed as the input override for the associated tool parameter, allowing the AI agent to call the tool with a predetermined value rather than a variable from the session or context.
The data type of the constant value used to override a tool configuration's input, determining how the literal is interpreted (e.g., string, number, boolean, or null).
In the AWS Wisdom AIAgent resource's orchestration tool configuration, this field sets the literal string value used for a tool input override when the override is defined as a constant.
The title of a tool configuration within the orchestration AI agent configuration, providing a human-readable name for the tool in the Wisdom AI agent.
The ID of a tool configured for the AI agent's orchestration, corresponding to an existing AWS Wisdom tool resource that the agent can call during a conversation.
The name of the tool that the orchestration AI agent invokes during execution, referencing a specific tool configured within the Amazon Q Business (Wisdom) AI agent.

Configuration object that specifies whether the orchestration AI agent requires user confirmation or additional input when invoking tools, controlling how the agent handles human interaction during tool execution.
Determines whether the AI agent must obtain explicit user confirmation before invoking the associated tool in this orchestration configuration.

aws_wisdom_aiagent.configuration.self_se.text: This configuration specifies the self-service AI agent's behavior in Amazon Q in Connect, including its association configurations and self-service guardrail settings that control automated responses to customer queries.

Specifies a list of associations that link the self-service AI agent to external resources such as knowledge bases, where each configuration includes an association type and the ARN of the associated resource.
Provides the association-type-specific data (e.g., a knowledge base association's content tag filter) for a single association configuration within the self-service AI agent configuration.

The knowledge base association configuration data for the AI agent specifies the knowledge base to associate, including the knowledge base's unique identifier and any related settings for that association.
Defines the tag-based filter used to determine which knowledge base content is associated with the AI agent, so that only content matching the specified tag conditions is available for the agent.

The `and_conditions` list defines a set of tag conditions that must all be satisfied for a knowledge base content item to be eligible for the AI agent's self-service configuration, providing AND logic within the content tag filter.
The tag key that must match on a knowledge base content item for it to be included in the AI agent's association.
The value of a content tag that must match in an AND condition for filtering which knowledge base associations apply to the self-service AI agent.
Specifies a list of tag condition sets for the knowledge base association filter; content is included if its tags match every condition in any one set, so the sets are evaluated with OR semantics.
Defines the list of tag key-value conditions that must all match (logical AND) for a knowledge base content item to be included within each OR condition group of the content tag filter.

Specifies the tag key for a single and-condition within a content tag filter on a knowledge base association for an Amazon Q in Connect (Wisdom) self-service AI agent, determining which knowledge base content is matched by that condition.
Specifies the value of a content tag that must match the operator and key defined in this condition, used to filter which knowledge base content is associated with the AI agent.

Defines a single tag condition that matches knowledge base content by tag key, optional value, and an operator (EQUALS or CONTAINS) within the content tag filter of the Wisdom AI agent's knowledge base association.
The tag key that must match for content to be associated with the AI agent, used in the tag condition filter.

The tag value that must be present on a knowledge base document for the content to be matched by this condition in the content tag filter, determining which documents are associated with the AI agent.
Specifies the tag key and optional value used to filter knowledge base content by a tag when the self-service AI agent processes associated content.
The tag key used to filter content in the associated knowledge base for the self-service AI agent.
The value that knowledge base content tags must match for the tag condition to apply, used to filter which articles are associated with the self-service AI agent.
Limits the maximum number of search results returned from the associated knowledge base when the self-service AI agent queries it, controlling the amount of context supplied for generating responses.
Overrides the default search type used for queries against the associated knowledge base, controlling whether retrieval uses keyword, semantic, or hybrid search for this AI agent.
The identifier of the guardrail that the self-service AI agent uses to enforce content safety and filtering on its responses, as specified in the Wisdom AIAgent configuration.

Specifies the ID or ARN of the Amazon Q in Connect (AWS Wisdom) AI prompt used by the self-service AI agent configuration to generate customer-facing answers, controlling the model's response behavior and style.
The unique identifier of the Amazon Wisdom AI prompt used to pre-process user input in the self-service AI agent configuration before the agent generates a response.

aws_wisdom_aiagent.description.text: The description of the Wisdom AI agent, an optional free-form text field used to explain the agent's intended purpose or behavior.

aws_wisdom_aiagent.modified_time_seconds.text: The Unix epoch time (in seconds) at which the Wisdom AI agent was last modified, as reported by the AWS Wisdom service.

aws_wisdom_aiagent.name.text: Specifies a human-readable name for the Wisdom AI agent, which is displayed in the Amazon Q Connect console and used to reference the agent in CloudFormation outputs and API calls.

aws_wisdom_aiagent.tags.text: A map of key-value pairs to assign to the Wisdom AIAgent resource, enabling tag-based resource management, access control, and cost allocation.

aws_wisdom_aiagent.type.text: The 'type' field is a required discriminator that selects whether the AI agent is of kind 'AGENT' — capable of using tools and performing multi-step tasks — or 'KNOWLEDGE_BASE' — which answers solely from a configured knowledge base.

aws_wisdom_aiagent_version.aiagent_arn.text: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Wisdom AI agent that this version belongs to.

aws_wisdom_aiagent_version.aiagent_id.text: The unique identifier of the Wisdom AI agent for which this version is created.

aws_wisdom_aiagent_version.aiagent_versi.text: The unique identifier assigned to the AI agent version when it is created.

aws_wisdom_aiagent_version.assistant_arn.text: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Wisdom assistant to which this AI agent version belongs, exposed as a computed read-only attribute after the resource is created.

aws_wisdom_aiagent_version.assistant_id.text: The identifier of the Amazon Wisdom assistant to which the AI agent version belongs.

aws_wisdom_aiagent_version.modified_time.text: The Unix epoch time in seconds when the AI agent version was last modified, providing a timestamp to track changes to the version.

aws_wisdom_aiagent_version.version_numbe.text: The version number of the AI agent version, automatically assigned by the service.

aws_wisdom_aiguardrail.aiguardrail_arn.text: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that uniquely identifies the AI guardrail.

aws_wisdom_aiguardrail.aiguardrail_id.text: The unique identifier assigned by AWS Wisdom for this AI guardrail resource.

aws_wisdom_aiguardrail.assistant_arn.text: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Amazon Q (Wisdom) assistant to which this AI guardrail is attached, returned by the service.

aws_wisdom_aiguardrail.assistant_id.text: The identifier of the Amazon Wisdom assistant to which this AI guardrail is associated.

aws_wisdom_aiguardrail.content_policy_co.text: Sets the moderation intensity for filtering user-provided input for this content filter, using an allowed value of NONE, LOW, MEDIUM, or HIGH to control how strictly the guardrail blocks or modifies incoming messages.

Specifies the strength of the content filter applied to the model's output, with allowed values such as NONE, LOW, MEDIUM, or HIGH, determining how aggressively the guardrail blocks or modifies generated content.
The category of harmful content that this filter targets, with allowed values such as PROFANITY, VIOLENCE, SEXUAL, HATE, INSULTS, and MISCONDUCT.

aws_wisdom_aiguardrail.contextual_ground.text: Sets the confidence threshold (0 to 1) at which the contextual grounding filter considers a response grounded in the source, with higher values increasing strictness and blocking more outputs that lack grounding.

The type of the contextual grounding filter, which determines whether the filter validates that the response is grounded in the source information (GROUNDING) or is relevant to the user's query (RELEVANCE).

aws_wisdom_aiguardrail.modified_time_sec.text: This read-only attribute returns the Unix timestamp, in seconds, of the last modification to the Wisdom AI guardrail.

aws_wisdom_aiguardrail.name.text: Sets the friendly name for the AI guardrail, used to identify it in Amazon Q Business console and API operations.

aws_wisdom_aiguardrail.sensitive_informa.text: The action to take on a detected PII entity, either BLOCK to deny the interaction or ANONYMIZE to replace the entity with a placeholder.
This field specifies the type of PII entity to detect and protect against, such as EMAIL or PHONE_NUMBER.
Specifies the enforcement action applied to content matching the regex pattern, such as blocking the content or anonymizing the detected sensitive data.
Provides a descriptive note for a regex configuration in the AI guardrail's sensitive information policy, explaining what kind of sensitive data the regex pattern is intended to detect.
The name of a regex configuration within the sensitive information policy, uniquely identifying the regular expression pattern used by the Wisdom AI guardrail.
The regular expression pattern used to define a custom regex-based rule for detecting sensitive information in the AI guardrail's sensitive information policy.

aws_wisdom_aiguardrail.topic_policy_conf.text: The natural-language definition of the topic, used by the guardrail to match user input and decide whether to allow or deny it according to the topic's type.
The examples field specifies a list of representative phrases for a topic, which the guardrail uses to identify and apply the configured topic policy when input matches those phrases.
Name of the topic entry in the topic policy configuration, used to identify the specific topic that the AI guardrail will allow or deny in conversations.
Specifies the type of the topic, with the only supported value being 'DENY', which causes the guardrail to block any conversation that matches the topic's definition.

aws_wisdom_aiguardrail.word_policy_confi.text: Specifies whether this managed word list is the built-in profanity list (PROFANITY) or a custom list (CUSTOM) that you define in the same object.
The exact word or phrase that the guardrail's word policy is configured to block from appearing in user input or model output.

aws_wisdom_aiguardrail_version.aiguardra.text: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that uniquely identifies this AI guardrail version in Amazon Wisdom.
The unique identifier of the AI guardrail for which this version is created, linking the version to its parent guardrail resource.
The unique identifier assigned by AWS to this specific version of the AI guardrail, used as a read-only reference to the version resource.

aws_wisdom_aiguardrail_version.assistant.text: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Wisdom assistant to which this AI Guardrail version belongs.
The unique identifier of the Amazon Connect Wisdom assistant that owns the AI guardrail version.

aws_wisdom_aiguardrail_version.modified_.text: The Unix epoch timestamp (in seconds) when this AI guardrail version was last modified.

aws_wisdom_aiguardrail_version.version_n.text: The version number assigned by the AWS Wisdom service to this AI Guardrail version, uniquely identifying this version within its guardrail.

aws_wisdom_aiprompt.aiprompt_arn.text: This read-only attribute holds the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that uniquely identifies the AWS Wisdom AI prompt resource.

aws_wisdom_aiprompt.aiprompt_id.text: The unique identifier that AWS Wisdom assigns to the AI prompt, returned by the service after the resource is created.

aws_wisdom_aiprompt.api_format.text: The API format for the AI prompt, indicating whether the model invocation uses TEXT for a single-turn prompt or CHAT for a chat-based multi-turn conversation.

aws_wisdom_aiprompt.assistant_arn.text: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Amazon Wisdom assistant associated with this AI prompt, provided as a read-only computed attribute.

aws_wisdom_aiprompt.assistant_id.text: The unique identifier of the Amazon Wisdom assistant with which this AI prompt is associated.

aws_wisdom_aiprompt.description.text: The description field provides an optional, free-text summary of the AI prompt's intended purpose, which can be used for identification and display within Amazon Q in Connect (Wisdom).

aws_wisdom_aiprompt.model_id.text: The model_id field specifies the identifier (such as an ARN) of the underlying model that the Wisdom AI prompt uses to generate responses.

aws_wisdom_aiprompt.modified_time_second.text: The Unix epoch time, in seconds, when the AI prompt was last modified.

aws_wisdom_aiprompt.name.text: The user-friendly name assigned to the AI prompt, which is used to identify and reference the prompt within the Amazon Wisdom service and its console.

aws_wisdom_aiprompt.template_configurati.text: Defines the prompt template settings for the AI prompt, allowing you to specify either a simple text prompt or a full prompt template with its corresponding type.
Configuration object for the text-based full AI prompt editing template, which contains the prompt text string used as the template content in AWS Wisdom AI prompts.
The prompt template text used in the full AI prompt edit configuration, defining the instructions or content for the AI prompt.

aws_wisdom_aiprompt.template_type.text: Defines whether the AI prompt uses a plain text template or a chat-based template, determining the expected configuration format for the prompt.

aws_wisdom_aiprompt_version.aiprompt_arn.text: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Wisdom AI prompt that this version belongs to.

aws_wisdom_aiprompt_version.aiprompt_id.text: The unique identifier of the AI prompt in Amazon Wisdom that this version belongs to and whose content is versioned.

aws_wisdom_aiprompt_version.aiprompt_ver.text: The unique identifier assigned by Amazon Wisdom to the created version of the AI prompt, returned as a read-only attribute after the resource is created.

aws_wisdom_aiprompt_version.assistant_ar.text: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Wisdom assistant that this AI prompt version belongs to.

aws_wisdom_aiprompt_version.assistant_id.text: The unique identifier of the Amazon Q in Connect (Wisdom) assistant to which this AI prompt version belongs.

aws_wisdom_aiprompt_version.modified_tim.text: The modified_time_seconds field records the Unix epoch time (in seconds) at which the Wisdom AI prompt version was last updated.

aws_wisdom_aiprompt_version.version_numb.text: The version number of this AI prompt version, as assigned by AWS Wisdom, which uniquely identifies the version within the parent AI prompt.

aws_wisdom_assistant.assistant_arn.text: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that uniquely identifies the Wisdom assistant.

aws_wisdom_assistant.assistant_id.text: The unique identifier assigned to the Wisdom assistant, used to reference this assistant in other AWS services and APIs.

aws_wisdom_assistant.description.text: Specifies a human-readable description for the Wisdom Assistant, providing context about its purpose or use case.

aws_wisdom_assistant.name.text: The name of the Amazon Wisdom assistant, which is a required, user-defined identifier for the assistant resource.

aws_wisdom_assistant.server_side_encrypt.text: Specifies the server-side encryption configuration, including the KMS key ARN used to encrypt the Wisdom assistant's data at rest.
The ARN of the KMS key used to encrypt the Wisdom assistant's data; if left unspecified, Amazon Connect Wisdom uses an AWS managed key.

aws_wisdom_assistant.tags.text: A list of tags to associate with the Wisdom assistant, which can be used to manage access and identify the resource.

aws_wisdom_assistant.tags.key.text: The key of a tag attached to the Wisdom assistant, used for identifying and categorizing the resource.

aws_wisdom_assistant.tags.value.text: The value portion of a tag assigned to the Wisdom assistant, allowing you to attach custom metadata such as environment or project labels to the assistant resource.

aws_wisdom_assistant.type.text: Sets the type of the Wisdom assistant, which must be either AGENT or ASSISTANT, controlling whether it serves contact center agents or end users.

aws_wisdom_assistant_association.assista.text: The ARN of the Amazon Wisdom assistant to which this association is attached.
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that uniquely identifies the Wisdom assistant association, assigned by AWS upon creation.
The unique identifier assigned by AWS Wisdom to this assistant association, used to reference the association in API calls and resource relationships.
The unique identifier of the Wisdom assistant to which this association connects, linking the assistant to the associated knowledge base or integration.

aws_wisdom_assistant_association.associa.text: Defines the target of the assistant association by providing the knowledge base identifier for the knowledge base to associate with the Wisdom assistant.
The ARN of the IAM role that grants Amazon Wisdom permission to access the associated Amazon Bedrock knowledge base.
The ARN of the Amazon Bedrock knowledge base that the Amazon Q in Connect (Wisdom) assistant associates with for an external Bedrock knowledge base association.
Identifier of the Amazon Wisdom knowledge base to associate with the assistant, required when the association type is set to KNOWLEDGE_BASE.
The type of resource being associated with the Wisdom assistant, with the only supported value being KNOWLEDGE_BASE for associating a knowledge base.

aws_wisdom_assistant_association.tags.ke.text: The key of a tag assigned to the Wisdom assistant association, serving as the unique identifier for the tag within the resource's tag set.

aws_wisdom_assistant_association.tags.va.text: The value of a tag assigned to the Wisdom assistant association, used to organize and identify the resource for cost allocation and access control.

aws_wisdom_knowledge_base.description.text: An optional description of the knowledge base, providing a human-readable summary of its contents or purpose in Amazon Connect Wisdom.

aws_wisdom_knowledge_base.knowledge_base.text: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) uniquely identifying this Wisdom knowledge base, assigned by AWS upon creation.
The unique identifier for this Amazon Wisdom knowledge base, assigned by AWS upon creation and used to reference the knowledge base in API operations and resource ARNs.
Defines whether the knowledge base is CUSTOM, for content you upload directly, or EXTERNAL, for content connected to an external source such as Salesforce or ServiceNow.

aws_wisdom_knowledge_base.name.text: A required, user-defined name for the knowledge base, used as its display name and identifier within Amazon Wisdom.

aws_wisdom_knowledge_base.rendering_conf.text: Specifies the template URI used to render knowledge base content in the Amazon Q in Connect (Wisdom) console, enabling custom display formatting.
The Amazon S3 URI of a template that Amazon Connect Wisdom uses to render the knowledge base's content when displayed to end users.

aws_wisdom_knowledge_base.server_side_en.text: Configures server-side encryption for the knowledge base by specifying the customer-managed KMS key to use (its ARN).
The identifier (ARN) of the AWS KMS key used to encrypt the knowledge base data at rest.

aws_wisdom_knowledge_base.source_configu.text: Specifies the configuration for the source of the knowledge base content, such as an S3 bucket or an Amazon AppIntegrations configuration that defines where the knowledge base data is ingested from.

Specifies the Amazon AppIntegrations data integration that supplies the knowledge base content, including the ARN of the AppIntegrations integration (e.g., Salesforce or ServiceNow) and optional object fields to import.
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AppIntegrations integration that provides the external data source for this Wisdom knowledge base.
Defines which fields from the integrated application's object (e.g., Salesforce case or account) are ingested into the knowledge base, allowing you to include only the specified attributes.

The managed source configuration is an optional object that, when present, specifies a managed data source (such as a web crawler) for populating the knowledge base, including the web crawler's URL and crawl behavior settings.
Configuration for the managed web crawler source, specifying seed URLs, crawler limits, scope, and inclusion/exclusion filters that govern which web content is ingested into the knowledge base.
Defines the limits for the web crawler source, including the maximum number of pages to crawl and the maximum rate (requests per second) at which the crawler can send requests.
The maximum number of web pages (URLs) the web crawler can fetch per minute from a source site, controlling the crawl rate to prevent overloading the site.
Specifies a list of URL patterns that the web crawler will exclude from crawling, preventing those pages from being ingested into the knowledge base.
Specifies a list of URL patterns that determine which web pages are included in the web crawler's crawl, allowing only matching URLs to be ingested into the knowledge base.
Determines which links the web crawler will follow from the initial seed URL, limiting indexation to pages on the same host, its subdomains, or across the entire web, depending on the chosen scope.
Defines the seed URLs and optional URL filters that determine which web pages the crawler starts from and which URLs are included or excluded during crawling.

Specifies a list of seed URL objects that determine the starting points for the web crawler when creating a managed source for the Wisdom knowledge base, with each object including the URL and its crawl mode.
The URL of a seed page that the web crawler uses as a starting point for crawling the site.

aws_wisdom_knowledge_base.tags.text: Specifies the tags (key-value pairs) attached to the Wisdom knowledge base for metadata, cost allocation, and resource management.

aws_wisdom_knowledge_base.tags.key.text: The key component of a tag applied to the Amazon Wisdom knowledge base, used to label the resource for management and cost allocation.

aws_wisdom_knowledge_base.vector_ingesti.text: Specifies the vector ingestion configuration, including chunking and parsing settings, used when documents are ingested into the knowledge base's vector index.
Specifies how ingested documents are split into chunks (e.g., fixed-size or semantic chunking) before being stored in the knowledge base's vector index.
Specifies the chunking strategy (FIXED_SIZE, SEMANTIC, or NONE) used to split source documents into smaller segments for vector ingestion into the knowledge base.

Configures fixed-size chunking for the knowledge base, which controls how source documents are split into chunks by specifying a maximum token count per chunk and an overlap percentage between adjacent chunks.
The maximum number of tokens to include in each chunk when using fixed-size chunking for the knowledge base.
The percentage of token overlap between consecutive chunks in the fixed-size chunking strategy, controlling how much context is shared between adjacent chunks for retrieval quality.
Defines the hierarchical chunking settings, which split content into parent and child chunks with configurable token limits, used when the chunking strategy is HIERARCHICAL.
Defines the list of hierarchical chunking levels, where each level configuration specifies the maximum token size used to split a document into progressively smaller chunks for the knowledge base.
The maximum number of tokens allowed in a single chunk at this level of the hierarchical chunking configuration, controlling the size of text segments created for indexing.
Specifies the number of tokens that overlap between consecutive chunks in the hierarchical chunking strategy for the knowledge base's vector ingestion configuration.

Semantic chunking configuration for the knowledge base's vector ingestion, which splits source documents into chunks based on natural semantic boundaries determined by a foundation model, using settings like the breakpoint percentile threshold, buffer size, and maximum token length.

Sets the percentile threshold (e.g., 95) used to detect semantic breakpoints in the text, where the chunking algorithm splits content at positions where the semantic distance between adjacent sentences falls above this percentile of all token distances, controlling chunk boundaries for the knowledge base.

Defines the number of tokens to include as a buffer on either side of a semantic breakpoint, so that the chunking algorithm preserves contextual relevance when splitting the document into semantically coherent chunks.
The maximum number of tokens allowed in each semantic chunk when ingesting documents into the Wisdom knowledge base.

Configures how documents are parsed during vector ingestion, including the parsing strategy (e.g., using a foundation model or chunking) and optionally the specific Bedrock foundation model to extract content.
Specifies the Amazon Bedrock foundation model (by ARN) used for parsing document content in the Wisdom knowledge base.
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Bedrock foundation model that is used to parse and extract structured text from source documents when they are ingested into the knowledge base.
Specifies a custom prompt that guides the configured Amazon Bedrock foundation model to parse and extract structured information from the contents of ingested documents for the knowledge base.
The text of the prompt that guides the Bedrock foundation model in parsing uploaded documents to extract structured information for the knowledge base.

Specifies the parsing strategy used to process documents during vector ingestion, such as 'BEDROCK_FOUNDATION_MODEL' for Bedrock foundation model parsing or 'BEDROCK_DATA_AUTOMATION' for Bedrock data automation pipelines.

aws_wisdom_message_template.content.emai.text: The HTML body content of the email message template, used when the email body is formatted as HTML.
The plain text body content for an email message template in AWS Wisdom.
The name of the email header (e.g., a custom header key) in the headers list of the email message template content.
The value of an email header in the AWS Wisdom message template's content, paired with a key to define a custom or standard email header sent with the message.

aws_wisdom_message_template.content.sms_.text: The plain text content of the SMS message body within the message template.

aws_wisdom_message_template.message_temp.text: The unique identifier of the attachment to include in the message template, referencing the attachment's ID in Amazon Connect Wisdom.
The name of an attachment in the Wisdom message template, used to identify and reference the attachment when the template is rendered for customers.
For each attachment in an Amazon Wisdom message template, this field is the Amazon S3 presigned URL that grants temporary, secure access to the attachment's underlying object stored in S3.

aws_wisdom_message_template.tags.key.text: The key of a metadata tag attached to the Wisdom message template, allowing users to organize and identify the template within AWS.

aws_work_spaces_connection_alias.alias_i.text: The unique identifier assigned to the WorkSpaces connection alias when it is created.

aws_work_spaces_connection_alias.associa.text: Returns the computed list of associations for this WorkSpaces connection alias, detailing the directories or resources it is linked to along with their association state and resource identifiers.
The AWS account ID of the account associated with this WorkSpaces connection alias, enabling cross-account redirection for WorkSpaces clients in that account.
The status of the association between the WorkSpaces connection alias and its associated directory, indicating whether the association is pending, available, or failed.
The unique identifier for a connection alias association, which is assigned by AWS when the connection alias is associated with a WorkSpaces directory.
The unique identifier of the WorkSpaces directory that is associated with the connection alias to enable cross-account access.

aws_work_spaces_connection_alias.connect.text: The current lifecycle state of the connection alias, such as CREATING, CREATED, or DELETING.

The fully qualified domain name (FQDN) that serves as the custom connection string for the WorkSpaces connection alias, such as 'www.example.com', which must be a valid domain you own and that users will use to connect to their WorkSpaces.

aws_work_spaces_connection_alias.tags.text: A list of key-value tag pairs assigned to the WorkSpaces Connection Alias to help manage, organize, and identify the alias resource.

aws_work_spaces_connection_alias.tags.va.text: The value of a tag assigned to the WorkSpaces connection alias.

aws_work_spaces_thin_client_environment..text: The tag key to apply to each WorkSpaces Thin Client device created from this environment, used to tag provisioned devices.
The value of a tag that is automatically applied to Thin Client devices created from this environment.
Defines the recurring maintenance window for the environment, specifying the days of the week and the start/end times (in UTC) when AWS can perform maintenance on the thin client environment.
The hour of the day in 24-hour time (0-23) at which a custom maintenance window ends, used when the maintenance window type is set to CUSTOM.
The minute (0-59) of the hour at which the maintenance window ends for scheduling maintenance on the Thin Client environment.
The hour (0-23) of the day, in 24-hour time, at which the maintenance window for applying updates to the WorkSpaces Thin Client environment begins.
The minute of the hour, in UTC, at which the maintenance window starts for this WorkSpaces Thin Client environment.
The value of a tag attached to a WorkSpaces Thin Client environment, used for organizing and identifying the environment (e.g., cost allocation, environment management).

aws_work_spaces_web_browser_settings.add.text: Adds key-value pairs to the AWS KMS encryption context used to encrypt the browser settings resource, enabling additional contextual information for auditing and access control.

aws_work_spaces_web_browser_settings.ass.text: The list of Amazon Resource Names (ARNs) of the WorkSpaces Web portals that are linked to these browser settings, automatically assigned by the service when a portal is associated.

aws_work_spaces_web_browser_settings.bro.text: The JSON-formatted string that defines the browser policy, which controls the browser features and behaviors available to WorkSpaces Web users.
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that uniquely identifies the browser settings resource.

aws_work_spaces_web_browser_settings.cus.text: The ARN of a customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the browser settings, with AWS-managed encryption applied when this optional field is left empty.

aws_work_spaces_web_browser_settings.web.text: Specifies the web content filtering policy for WorkSpaces Web browser settings, defining rules that allow or block web content by category (such as adult content, social media, or advertising) in browser sessions.
Specifies a list of allowed URL patterns that users are permitted to access when the web content filtering policy is enabled, with all other URLs being blocked.
The list of web content category identifiers to block, which prevents users from accessing websites that belong to the specified categories in this WorkSpaces Web browser settings.
The list of URLs that are blocked by the web content filtering policy, preventing end users from accessing those sites in the WorkSpaces Web browser.

aws_work_spaces_web_data_protection_sett.text: Provides additional encryption context key-value pairs that are included in the encryption context for AWS KMS keys used to protect data, enabling finer-grained access control and audit logging.
The list of ARNs of the WorkSpaces Web portals that are currently associated with these data protection settings, populated automatically by AWS.
The date and time when the WorkSpaces Web data protection settings were created, returned as a read-only string.
The ARN of the customer-managed AWS KMS key used to encrypt sensitive data in the WorkSpaces Web data protection settings.
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that uniquely identifies this WorkSpaces Web data protection settings resource, used to reference it in IAM policies and other AWS services.
Provides a user-defined textual summary of the WorkSpaces Web data protection settings, enabling administrators to easily identify and manage the configuration in the AWS console and API.
The display name is a user-friendly, optional identifier for the data protection settings, used to distinguish them in the WorkSpaces Web console.

Configures automatic inline redaction of sensitive data (e.g., PII, financial numbers) by defining a set of redaction patterns and associated settings applied to web content delivered through WorkSpaces Web.

Defines the minimum confidence score (0-100) that detected sensitive data must reach for the inline redaction engine to apply redaction, serving as the default threshold for all rules in the inline redaction configuration.
Specifies a list of URL patterns whose web content always has inline redaction applied, so sensitive data is redacted on those pages even if no other redaction rule matches.
Specifies a list of URL patterns that are exempt from inline redaction, so content on those URLs is not redacted.

Defines the required list of inline redaction patterns, each specifying a regular expression to match sensitive data that should be redacted from web content in this AWS WorkSpaces Web data protection settings resource.

The unique identifier for a built-in redaction pattern (e.g., credit card numbers, US social security numbers) used by this inline redaction rule to detect and redact sensitive information in web content.
The minimum confidence threshold that the inline redaction pattern must meet for a detected sensitive data instance to be considered a match and redacted in WorkSpaces Web data protection settings.

In an AWS WorkSpaces Web data protection inline redaction pattern, the custom_pattern object defines a custom regular expression and the redaction action (e.g., redact or block) used to match and protect sensitive data in web content.
Defines the regular expression used to match keywords that identify the context for applying the custom inline redaction pattern in WorkSpaces Web data protection settings.
Provides a human-readable description for a custom inline redaction pattern, documenting the pattern's intended matching behavior.
The name that identifies this custom inline redaction pattern within the WorkSpaces Web data protection settings.
The regular expression that defines the specific text sequence to be matched and redacted inline when found in web content.
A list of URLs (or URL patterns) on which the inline redaction pattern is enforced, meaning that content matching the pattern will be redacted only when accessed from those URLs.
Specifies a list of URL patterns that are exempt from the inline redaction rule, so content on those URLs will not be redacted.
Defines the placeholder text and type that replace matched content for each inline redaction pattern.
The text string that is inserted in place of the redacted content when a sensitive data pattern matches.

The `redaction_place_holder_type` field determines whether the matched sensitive text is replaced with a custom placeholder string (`CUSTOM`) or left as the original text (`PRESERVED`) when the inline redaction pattern is applied.
Adds one or more tag objects (Key and Value) to the WorkSpaces Web data protection settings resource.

aws_work_spaces_web_identity_provider.id.text: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the identity provider, assigned by AWS and used to uniquely identify it.

Provides the identity provider-specific configuration details, such as SAML metadata or OIDC client credentials (e.g., clientId, clientSecret, authorizeScopes), required to integrate the provider with WorkSpaces Web.
Specifies the user-friendly name for the identity provider used to authenticate users to the WorkSpaces Web portal.
Specifies the type of identity provider (SAML or OIDC) used for this WorkSpaces Web identity provider configuration.

aws_work_spaces_web_identity_provider.po.text: The ARN of the WorkSpaces Web portal to which this identity provider configuration is attached.

aws_work_spaces_web_identity_provider.ta.text: A list of key-value tag pairs to attach to the WorkSpaces Web identity provider, used for identifying and organizing the resource.

aws_work_spaces_web_ip_access_settings.a.text: The additional_encryption_context is a dynamic map of arbitrary key-value pairs that are included as additional encryption context when AWS KMS encrypts the WorkSpaces Web IP access settings using a customer-managed KMS key.
Returns the list of Amazon Resource Names (ARNs) of the WorkSpaces Web portals currently associated with these IP access settings.

aws_work_spaces_web_ip_access_settings.c.text: The date and time when these WorkSpaces Web IP access settings were created.
The ARN of a customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the IP access settings; if not specified, an AWS-managed key is used.

aws_work_spaces_web_ip_access_settings.d.text: Specifies an optional textual description for the IP access settings, providing a human-readable label to identify the resource in the WorkSpaces Web environment.
A human-readable display name for the IP access settings that helps identify this set of rules in the WorkSpaces Web portal.

aws_work_spaces_web_ip_access_settings.i.text: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the IP access settings resource.
Specifies the list of IP rules that define allowed or denied client IP address ranges (in CIDR notation) for accessing the WorkSpaces Web portal.
Specifies a human-readable description for the IP access rule that identifies its purpose or context.
The CIDR block (e.g., 192.0.2.0/24) that defines the IP address range this rule allows or denies access from.

aws_work_spaces_web_ip_access_settings.t.text: The value portion of a key-value tag attached to the AWS WorkSpaces Web IP Access Settings resource.

aws_work_spaces_web_network_settings.ass.text: The list of ARNs of the web portals associated with this network settings resource.

aws_work_spaces_web_network_settings.net.text: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) assigned by AWS to uniquely identify this WorkSpaces Web network settings resource.

aws_work_spaces_web_network_settings.sec.text: One or more security group IDs that define the network traffic rules for the WorkSpaces Web portal, controlling access to the VPC resources it connects to.

aws_work_spaces_web_network_settings.sub.text: The list of subnet IDs in the VPC where the WorkSpaces Web portal's network interfaces are created for the network settings.

aws_work_spaces_web_network_settings.tag.text: Assigns a list of tag objects (each containing a key and value) to the WorkSpaces Web network settings resource for identifying, organizing, and managing the resource.
The value of a tag attached to the Amazon WorkSpaces Web network settings resource, used to categorize and identify the resource.

aws_work_spaces_web_network_settings.vpc.text: The ID of the VPC that this WorkSpaces Web network settings configuration is associated with, used to define the network boundary for the web portal.

aws_work_spaces_web_portal.additional_en.text: Specifies a map of additional encryption context (key-value pairs) that is included in the encryption context when AWS KMS encrypts the portal's data using a customer-managed key.

aws_work_spaces_web_portal.authenticatio.text: Specifies the authentication method for the WorkSpaces Web portal, which can be either 'Standard' or 'IAM Identity Center'.

aws_work_spaces_web_portal.browser_setti.text: The ARN of the browser settings resource that defines the browser configuration and policies applied to this WorkSpaces Web portal.

aws_work_spaces_web_portal.creation_date.text: The timestamp indicating when the WorkSpaces Web portal was created.

aws_work_spaces_web_portal.customer_mana.text: The ARN of the customer managed key used to encrypt the portal's data.

aws_work_spaces_web_portal.data_protecti.text: The ARN of the data protection settings resource to associate with the WorkSpaces Web portal, enabling data loss prevention and session monitoring policies for browser sessions.

aws_work_spaces_web_portal.display_name.text: Specifies the user-visible name for the WorkSpaces Web portal, which appears in the portal's title or header.

aws_work_spaces_web_portal.instance_type.text: Specifies the instance type for the WorkSpaces Web portal's streaming sessions, determining the compute and memory resources available to end users.

aws_work_spaces_web_portal.ip_access_set.text: The ARN of the IP access settings resource that defines the IP allowlist for accessing this WorkSpaces Web portal.

aws_work_spaces_web_portal.max_concurren.text: The maximum number of concurrent user sessions allowed for the WorkSpaces Web portal, capping active sessions to manage resource usage.

aws_work_spaces_web_portal.network_setti.text: The ARN of the network settings that the portal uses to define its VPC and security group configuration.
